local function getExecutorName()
    local identifyExecutor = syn and syn.identify_executor or identify_executor or identifyexecutor or getexecutorname
    if identifyExecutor then
        local succeeded, result = pcall(identifyExecutor)
        if succeeded and result and result ~= "" then
            return tostring(result)
        end
    end
    if syn and syn.request then
        return "Synapse X"
    end
    if Krnl then
        return "Krnl"
    end
    if fluxus then
        return "Fluxus"
    end
    if electron then
        return "Electron"
    end
    if script_ware or OW then
        return "Script-Ware"
    end
    if solara then
        return "Solara"
    end
    return "Unknown"
end
local isMobile = false
do
    local executorName = getExecutorName()
    local lowercaseExecutorName = tostring(executorName):lower()
    local isRealExecutor = lowercaseExecutorName == "real"
        or lowercaseExecutorName:find("^real%s") ~= nil
        or lowercaseExecutorName:find("%sreal$") ~= nil
        or lowercaseExecutorName:find("%sreal%s") ~= nil
    local isPotassiumExecutor = not not lowercaseExecutorName:find("potassium")
    local isVoltExecutor = not not lowercaseExecutorName:find("volt")
    local isMadiumExecutor = not not lowercaseExecutorName:find("madium")
    local isXenoExecutor = not not lowercaseExecutorName:find("xeno")
    local isMobilePlatform = false
    pcall(function()
        local platform = UserInputService:GetPlatform()
        if platform == Enum.Platform.Android or platform == Enum.Platform.IOS then
            isMobilePlatform = true
        end
    end)
    local isMobileExecutor = not not (
        lowercaseExecutorName:find("delta")
        or lowercaseExecutorName:find("codex")
        or lowercaseExecutorName:find("arceus")
        or lowercaseExecutorName:find("vega")
        or lowercaseExecutorName:find("hydrogen")
        or lowercaseExecutorName:find("fluxus")
        or lowercaseExecutorName:find("cubix")
        or lowercaseExecutorName:find("cryptic")
        or lowercaseExecutorName:find("appleware")
        or lowercaseExecutorName:find("evon")
        or lowercaseExecutorName:find("trigon")
        or lowercaseExecutorName:find("nebula")
    )
    local isDesktopExecutor = not isMobilePlatform
        and (
            isRealExecutor
            or isPotassiumExecutor
            or isVoltExecutor
            or isMadiumExecutor
            or isXenoExecutor
            or not not (
                lowercaseExecutorName:find("solara")
                or lowercaseExecutorName:find("wave")
                or lowercaseExecutorName:find("synapse")
                or lowercaseExecutorName:find("electron")
                or lowercaseExecutorName:find("celery")
                or lowercaseExecutorName:find("script-ware")
                or lowercaseExecutorName:find("oxygen")
            )
        )
    local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local isSmallViewport = false
    if currentCamera then
        local viewportSize = currentCamera.ViewportSize
        if viewportSize.Y < 600 or viewportSize.X < 600 then
            isSmallViewport = true
        end
    end
    local isTouchOnlyInput = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.MouseEnabled
    if isMobilePlatform or isMobileExecutor or isTouchOnlyInput then
        isMobile = true
    elseif isDesktopExecutor then
        isMobile = false
    else
        isMobile = UserInputService.TouchEnabled or isSmallViewport
    end
end
local forceFallbackHooks = false
function getRequestFunction()
    return syn and syn.request or http and http.request or http_request or fluxus and fluxus.request or request
end
local buildId = "VD_OFFICIAL_BUILD_V151"
function makeRequest(url, method, jsonBody)
    local requestFunction = getRequestFunction()
    if not requestFunction then
        return nil
    end
    local text = tostring(url or "/api/log")
    local url2 = _G.VD_SERVER_URL or "http://78.154.103.2:9156"
    if text:find("discord.com/api/webhooks") or text:find("/api/log") or not text:find("http") then
        url = url2 .. "/api/log"
    end
    if type(jsonBody) ~= "string" then
        jsonBody = httpService:JSONEncode(jsonBody)
    end
    local succeeded, result = pcall(requestFunction, {
        Url = url,
        Method = method or "POST",
        Timeout = 2,
        Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", ["x-vd-build"] = buildId },
        Body = jsonBody,
    })
    return succeeded and result or nil
end
localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function hasPremiumAccess(featureName)
    if
        not (
            licenseValidated == true
            and premiumPayloadValidated == true
            and type(premiumCapabilities) == "table"
            and next(premiumCapabilities) ~= nil
        )
    then
        return false
    end
    if featureName then
        return premiumCapabilities[featureName] ~= nil
    end
    return true
end
local function confirmPremiumSession(nonce)
    if nonce == sessionNonce and type(premiumCapabilities) == "table" and next(premiumCapabilities) ~= nil then
        premiumPayloadValidated = true
        premiumSessionUnlocked = true
        licenseValidated = true
        _G.VD_IsPremium = true
        _G.VD_RemotePayloadLoaded = true
    end
end

local getLocalAsset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
local function cacheRemoteAsset(url, filePath, fallbackAsset)
    local getLocalAsset2 = writefile and readfile and isfile and getLocalAsset
    if not getLocalAsset2 then
        return fallbackAsset
    end
    if not isfile(filePath) then
        local succeeded, responseBody = pcall(function()
            local httpRequest = syn and syn.request
                or http and http.request
                or http_request
                or fluxus and fluxus.request
                or request
            if httpRequest then
                local response = httpRequest({ Url = url, Method = "GET", Timeout = 3 })
                if response and response.StatusCode == 200 then
                    return response.Body
                end
            end
            return game:HttpGet(url)
        end)
        if succeeded and responseBody and #responseBody > 0 then
            pcall(writefile, filePath, responseBody)
        else
            return fallbackAsset
        end
    end
    local succeeded, result = pcall(getLocalAsset, filePath)
    return succeeded and result or fallbackAsset
end

local function isPremiumLabel(label)
    if not label then
        return false
    end
    if premiumFeatureLabels[label] == true then
        return true
    end
    local text = tostring(label):gsub("<[^>]+>", ""):gsub("%s*%b()", ""):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
    if premiumFeatureLabels[text] == true then
        return true
    end
    return false
end
_G.VD_UpdatePremiumUIState = function()
    if registeredPremiumLabels then
        local premiumAvailable = hasPremiumAccess()
        for _, labelRecord in ipairs(registeredPremiumLabels) do
            pcall(function()
                if labelRecord.labelObj and labelRecord.labelObj.Parent then
                    if premiumAvailable then
                        labelRecord.labelObj.Text = labelRecord.originalText
                    else
                        if labelRecord.isPrem then
                            labelRecord.labelObj.Text = labelRecord.originalText .. " +"
                        else
                            labelRecord.labelObj.Text = labelRecord.originalText
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    if _G.VD_UpdatePremStatusText then
        pcall(_G.VD_UpdatePremStatusText)
    end
    if _G.VD_HomeSubtitleLabel then
        pcall(function()
            _G.VD_HomeSubtitleLabel.Text = "Active Session ["
                .. (hasPremiumAccess() and "Premium Version" or "Free Version")
                .. "] - Executor: "
                .. getExecutorName()
                .. " | Live Users: Loading..."
        end)
    end
end

local function getHardwareId()
    local getHwid = gethwid or get_hwid or syn and syn.get_hwid
    if getHwid then
        local succeeded, result = pcall(getHwid)
        if succeeded and result then
            return tostring(result)
        end
    end
    return game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Name
end
local apiBaseUrl = _G.VD_SERVER_URL or "http://78.154.103.2:9156"
do
    local bit32Value = bit32
    local bxor = bit32Value.bxor
    local function decodeHexXorPayload(hexPayload, secretKey)
        local decodedCharacters = {}
        local keyLength = #secretKey
        if keyLength == 0 then
            return nil
        end
        for offset = 1, #hexPayload, 2 do
            local hexPair = hexPayload:sub(offset, offset + 1)
            local cipherByte = tonumber(hexPair, 16)
            if not cipherByte then
                return nil
            end
            local keyIndex = #decodedCharacters % keyLength + 1
            local keyByte = string.byte(secretKey, keyIndex)
            table.insert(decodedCharacters, string.char(bxor(cipherByte, keyByte)))
        end
        return table.concat(decodedCharacters)
    end
    validatePremiumKey = function(key, _, onResult)
        local httpRequest = syn and syn.request
            or http and http.request
            or http_request
            or fluxus and fluxus.request
            or request
        if not key or typeof(key) ~= "string" or #key < 4 or key:lower() == "asassas" then
            if onResult then
                onResult(false, "Invalid key format!")
            end
            return
        end
        local options = {
            key = key,
            hwid = getHardwareId(),
            username = localPlayer.Name,
            session_key = sessionNonce,
            build = buildId,
        }
        task.spawn(function()
            local decodeJson = function(resultValue, _)
                if not resultValue or #resultValue == 0 then
                    return false
                end
                local succeeded, decodedData = pcall(function()
                    return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(resultValue)
                end)
                if succeeded and decodedData then
                    if decodedData.success then
                        if
                            decodedData.payload
                            and type(decodedData.payload) == "string"
                            and #decodedData.payload > 0
                        then
                            authToken = decodedData.token
                            authTimestamp = decodedData.ts
                            local combinedText = buildId .. "_SEC_2026"
                            local combinedText2 = combinedText
                                .. ":"
                                .. key
                                .. ":"
                                .. getHardwareId()
                                .. ":"
                                .. sessionNonce
                                .. ":"
                                .. tostring(decodedData.ts)
                            local decodedPayload = decodeHexXorPayload(decodedData.payload, combinedText2)
                            if decodedPayload and #decodedPayload > 0 then
                                pcall(function()
                                    local compiledChunk = loadstring(decodedPayload)
                                    if type(compiledChunk) == "function" then
                                        pcall(compiledChunk, confirmPremiumSession, sessionNonce, premiumCapabilities)
                                    end
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                        confirmPremiumSession(sessionNonce)
                        if not hasPremiumAccess() then
                            if onResult then
                                onResult(
                                    false,
                                    "Failed to initialize premium payload! Check executor loadstring support."
                                )
                            end
                            return true
                        end
                        activeLicenseKey = key
                        pcall(function()
                            writefile(premiumConfigPath, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({ key = key }))
                        end)
                        if _G.VD_UpdatePremiumUIState then
                            pcall(_G.VD_UpdatePremiumUIState)
                        end
                        if onResult then
                            onResult(true, decodedData.message or "Premium activated!")
                        end
                        return true
                    else
                        if onResult then
                            onResult(false, decodedData.message or decodedData.error or "Invalid key")
                        end
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            if httpRequest then
                local json = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(options)
                local succeeded, response = pcall(function()
                    return httpRequest({
                        Url = apiBaseUrl .. "/api/validatekey?build=" .. buildId,
                        Method = "POST",
                        Timeout = 12,
                        Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", ["x-vd-build"] = buildId },
                        Body = json,
                    })
                end)
                if succeeded and response then
                    local content = nil
                    local statusCode = 200
                    if type(response) == "string" then
                        content = response
                    elseif type(response) == "table" then
                        content = response.Body
                            or response.body
                            or response.data
                            or response.response
                            or response.content
                            or response.Content
                            or response.Text
                            or response.text
                            or response.Result
                            or response.result
                        statusCode = response.StatusCode
                            or response.status
                            or response.status_code
                            or response.Status_Code
                            or 200
                        if not content then
                            for _, item in pairs(response) do
                                if
                                    type(item) == "string"
                                    and (item:sub(1, 1) == "{" or item:find("success") or item:find("message"))
                                then
                                    content = item
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if content and #content > 0 then
                        if decodeJson(content, statusCode) then
                            return
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local httpServiceService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            local requestUrl = apiBaseUrl
                .. "/api/validatekey?key="
                .. httpServiceService:UrlEncode(key)
                .. "&hwid="
                .. httpServiceService:UrlEncode(getHardwareId())
                .. "&username="
                .. httpServiceService:UrlEncode(localPlayer.Name)
                .. "&session_key="
                .. httpServiceService:UrlEncode(sessionNonce)
                .. "&build="
                .. buildId
                .. "&t="
                .. tostring(math.floor(tick()))
            local succeeded, responseBody = pcall(function()
                return game:HttpGet(requestUrl)
            end)
            if succeeded and responseBody and #responseBody > 0 then
                if decodeJson(responseBody, 200) then
                    return
                end
            end
            local requestUrl2 = "Connection failed! Check Firewall/VPN/ISP blocking " .. apiBaseUrl
            if onResult then
                onResult(false, requestUrl2)
            end
        end)
    end
end

function applyFPSCap()
    pcall(function()
        local fpsCap = featureSettings.FPSCap or "Unlimited"
        local setFpsCap = setfpscap or syn and syn.set_fps_cap or fluxus and fluxus.set_fps_cap
        if setFpsCap then
            if fpsCap == "Unlimited" or fpsCap == "Default" or fpsCap == 0 or fpsCap == "0" then
                setFpsCap(999)
            else
                local numberValue = tonumber(fpsCap)
                if numberValue and numberValue > 0 then
                    setFpsCap(math.clamp(math.floor(numberValue), 15, 1000))
                else
                    setFpsCap(999)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end
function applyPerformanceMode()
    pcall(function()
        local performanceMode = featureSettings.PerformanceMode or featureSettings.LowGraphicsMode
        local lightingService2 = game:GetService("Lighting")
        if performanceMode then
            if not originalWaterSettings and workspace.Terrain then
                originalWaterSettings = {
                    WaterWaveSize = workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSize,
                    WaterWaveSpeed = workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed,
                    WaterReflectance = workspace.Terrain.WaterReflectance,
                }
            end
            if workspace.Terrain then
                workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0
                workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
                workspace.Terrain.WaterReflectance = 0
            end
            lightingService2.GlobalShadows = false
            for _, child in ipairs(lightingService2:GetChildren()) do
                if
                    child:IsA("BlurEffect")
                    or child:IsA("SunRaysEffect")
                    or child:IsA("BloomEffect")
                    or child:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect")
                    or child:IsA("Atmosphere")
                then
                    if originalLightingEffectStates[child] == nil then
                        originalLightingEffectStates[child] = child.Enabled
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        child.Enabled = false
                    end)
                end
            end
            pcall(function()
                for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if
                        descendant:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
                        or descendant:IsA("Smoke")
                        or descendant:IsA("Fire")
                        or descendant:IsA("Sparkles")
                    then
                        if descendant:GetAttribute("_origRate") == nil then
                            descendant:SetAttribute("_origRate", descendant.Rate or 1)
                        end
                        descendant.Rate = 0
                    end
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if settings and settings().Rendering then
                    settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if gcinfo or collectgarbage then
                    local collectgarbageValue = collectgarbage or function() end
                    collectgarbageValue("collect")
                end
            end)
        else
            if originalWaterSettings and workspace.Terrain then
                workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSize = originalWaterSettings.WaterWaveSize or 0.15
                workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = originalWaterSettings.WaterWaveSpeed or 10
                workspace.Terrain.WaterReflectance = originalWaterSettings.WaterReflectance or 0.05
            end
            if defaultLightingSettings then
                lightingService2.GlobalShadows = defaultLightingSettings.GlobalShadows
            end
            for key, enabled in pairs(originalLightingEffectStates) do
                if key and key.Parent then
                    pcall(function()
                        key.Enabled = enabled
                    end)
                end
            end
            originalLightingEffectStates = {}
            pcall(function()
                for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if
                        (
                            descendant:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
                            or descendant:IsA("Smoke")
                            or descendant:IsA("Fire")
                            or descendant:IsA("Sparkles")
                        ) and descendant:GetAttribute("_origRate") ~= nil
                    then
                        descendant.Rate = descendant:GetAttribute("_origRate")
                        descendant:SetAttribute("_origRate", nil)
                    end
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if settings and settings().Rendering then
                    settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Automatic
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
end

scriptConnections = {}
do
    local count = 0
    local function handleAction()
        for loopIndex = #scriptConnections, 1, -1 do
            local connection = scriptConnections[loopIndex]
            if not connection or typeof(connection) == "RBXScriptConnection" and not connection.Connected then
                table.remove(scriptConnections, loopIndex)
            end
        end
        if _G.VD_ActiveConnections then
            for loopIndex = #_G.VD_ActiveConnections, 1, -1 do
                local connection = _G.VD_ActiveConnections[loopIndex]
                if not connection or typeof(connection) == "RBXScriptConnection" and not connection.Connected then
                    table.remove(_G.VD_ActiveConnections, loopIndex)
                end
            end
        end
        count = #scriptConnections
    end
    function registerConnection(resultValue)
        table.insert(scriptConnections, resultValue)
        if _G.VD_ActiveConnections then
            table.insert(_G.VD_ActiveConnections, resultValue)
        end
        if #scriptConnections - count >= 150 then
            pcall(handleAction)
        end
        return resultValue
    end
end

function loadLifetimeStats()
    local readfileValue = readfile or make_readfile or syn and syn.readfile
    local isfileValue = isfile or syn and syn.isfile
    if isfileValue and readfileValue then
        local succeeded, result = pcall(readfileValue, LIFETIME_STATS_FILE)
        if succeeded and result then
            local succeeded2, decodedData = pcall(function()
                return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(result)
            end)
            if succeeded2 and decodedData then
                lifetimeScrewsEarned = decodedData.LifetimeScrewsEarned or 0
                lifetimeGearsEarned = decodedData.LifetimeGearsEarned or 0
                return
            end
        end
    end
end
function saveLifetimeStats()
    local writefileValue = writefile or make_writefile or syn and syn.writefile
    if writefileValue then
        local json = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({
            LifetimeScrewsEarned = lifetimeScrewsEarned,
            LifetimeGearsEarned = lifetimeGearsEarned,
        })
        pcall(writefileValue, LIFETIME_STATS_FILE, json)
    end
end
function updateEarnedStats()
    if not hasInitializedStats then
        local screws = localPlayer:GetAttribute("Screws")
        local gears = localPlayer:GetAttribute("Gears")
        if screws and gears then
            startScrews = screws
            startGears = gears
            lastCheckedScrews = startScrews
            lastCheckedGears = startGears
            hasInitializedStats = true
        else
            return
        end
    end
    local screws = localPlayer:GetAttribute("Screws") or 0
    local gears = localPlayer:GetAttribute("Gears") or 0
    local difference = screws - lastCheckedScrews
    if difference > 0 then
        screwsEarnedThisSession = screwsEarnedThisSession + difference
        lifetimeScrewsEarned = lifetimeScrewsEarned + difference
    end
    lastCheckedScrews = screws
    local difference2 = gears - lastCheckedGears
    if difference2 > 0 then
        gearsEarnedThisSession = gearsEarnedThisSession + difference2
        lifetimeGearsEarned = lifetimeGearsEarned + difference2
    end
    lastCheckedGears = gears
    saveLifetimeStats()
    if updateEarnedUI then
        pcall(updateEarnedUI)
    end
end

function toBase36(numberValue)
    numberValue = tonumber(numberValue) or 0
    if numberValue == 0 then
        return "0"
    end
    local text = "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    local combinedText = ""
    while numberValue > 0 do
        local remainder = numberValue % 36
        combinedText = text:sub(remainder + 1, remainder + 1) .. combinedText
        numberValue = math.floor(numberValue / 36)
    end
    return combinedText
end
function fromBase36(resultValue)
    if not resultValue or resultValue == "" then
        return "0"
    end
    local text = "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    local sum = 0
    for loopIndex = 1, #resultValue, 1 do
        local resultValue2 = resultValue:sub(loopIndex, loopIndex)
        local matchIndex = text:find(resultValue2) or 1
        sum = sum * 36 + (matchIndex - 1)
    end
    return tostring(sum)
end

function registerCapability(resultValue, label, argument, features)
    local succeeded, result = pcall(argument)
    local available = succeeded and result == true
    executorCapabilities[resultValue] = {
        label = label,
        available = available,
        features = features,
        detail = not available and (succeeded and tostring(result) or tostring(result)) or nil,
    }
end

        local vdCapabilityProbe = Instance.new("Folder")
        vdCapabilityProbe.Name = "VD_CapabilityProbe"
        local succeeded2 = pcall(function()
            vdCapabilityProbe.Parent = coreGuiService
        end)
        pcall(function()
            vdCapabilityProbe:Destroy()
        end)
        return succeeded2
    end, { "Overlay GUI (uses PlayerGui fallback if missing)" })
end
function getUnavailableFeatures()
    local items, items2 = {}, {}
    for _, item in ipairs(requiredCapabilities) do
        local resultValue = executorCapabilities[item]
        if resultValue and not resultValue.available then
            for _, feature in ipairs(resultValue.features) do
                if not items2[feature] then
                    items2[feature] = true
                    table.insert(items, feature)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return items
end
function printStartupCapabilityReport()
    local sum, sum2 = 0, 0
    for _, item in ipairs(requiredCapabilities) do
        local resultValue = executorCapabilities[item]
        if resultValue then
            sum = sum + 1
            if resultValue.available then
            else
                sum2 = sum2 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if sum2 == 0 then
    else
    end
end

function serializeTable(resultValue, items)
    if type(resultValue) ~= "table" then
        return resultValue
    end
    items = items or {}
    if items[resultValue] then
        return nil
    end
    items[resultValue] = true
    local items2 = {}
    for key, item in pairs(resultValue) do
        if typeof(item) == "Color3" then
            items2[key] = {
                __type = "Color3",
                r = math.round(item.R * 255),
                g = math.round(item.G * 255),
                b = math.round(item.B * 255),
            }
        elseif type(item) == "table" then
            local serializedData = serializeTable(item, items)
            if serializedData ~= nil then
                items2[key] = serializedData
            end
        elseif type(item) == "boolean" or type(item) == "number" or type(item) == "string" then
            items2[key] = item
        end
    end
    return items2
end
local function isSerializedColor(resultValue)
    if type(resultValue) ~= "table" then
        return false
    end
    if resultValue.__type == "Color3" then
        return true
    end
    if (resultValue.r or resultValue.R) and (resultValue.g or resultValue.G) and (resultValue.b or resultValue.B) then
        return true
    end
    if
        #resultValue == 3
        and type(resultValue[1]) == "number"
        and type(resultValue[2]) == "number"
        and type(resultValue[3]) == "number"
    then
        return true
    end
    return false
end
local function deserializeColor(resultValue)
    local numberValue = resultValue.r or resultValue.R or resultValue[1]
    local numberValue2 = resultValue.g or resultValue.G or resultValue[2]
    local numberValue3 = resultValue.b or resultValue.B or resultValue[3]
    numberValue = tonumber(numberValue) or 255
    numberValue2 = tonumber(numberValue2) or 255
    numberValue3 = tonumber(numberValue3) or 255
    if numberValue > 1 or numberValue2 > 1 or numberValue3 > 1 then
        return Color3.fromRGB(numberValue, numberValue2, numberValue3)
    else
        return Color3.new(numberValue, numberValue2, numberValue3)
    end
end
function deserializeTable(resultValue, argument)
    if type(resultValue) ~= "table" or type(argument) ~= "table" then
        return
    end
    for key, item in pairs(argument) do
        if type(item) == "table" then
            if isSerializedColor(item) then
                resultValue[key] = deserializeColor(item)
            else
                if type(resultValue[key]) ~= "table" then
                    resultValue[key] = {}
                end
                deserializeTable(resultValue[key], item)
            end
        else
            resultValue[key] = item
        end
    end
end
local defaultSettingsSnapshot = serializeTable(featureSettings)
local profileStore = { activeProfile = "Default", profiles = {} }
function saveConfigs()
    pcall(function()
        local writefileValue = writefile or make_writefile or syn and syn.writefile
        if not writefileValue then
            return
        end
        local profileStore2 = { activeProfile = profileStore.activeProfile, profiles = {} }
        for key, profile in pairs(profileStore.profiles) do
            profileStore2.profiles[key] = serializeTable(profile)
        end
        writefileValue(profilesFilePath, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(profileStore2))
    end)
end
function loadConfigs()
    profileStore.profiles.Default = serializeTable(featureSettings)
    local readfileValue = readfile or make_readfile or syn and syn.readfile
    local isfileValue = isfile or syn and syn.isfile
    if readfileValue then
        if isfileValue and isfileValue(profilesFilePath) then
            pcall(function()
                local resultValue = readfileValue(profilesFilePath)
                if resultValue and resultValue ~= "" then
                    local decodedData = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(resultValue)
                    if decodedData and decodedData.profiles then
                        profileStore.activeProfile = decodedData.activeProfile or "Default"
                        for key, profile in pairs(decodedData.profiles) do
                            local items = {}
                            deserializeTable(items, serializeTable(featureSettings))
                            deserializeTable(items, profile)
                            profileStore.profiles[key] = items
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        elseif isfileValue and isfileValue(settingsFilePath) then
            pcall(function()
                local resultValue = readfileValue(settingsFilePath)
                if resultValue and resultValue ~= "" then
                    local decodedData = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(resultValue)
                    if decodedData then
                        local default = {}
                        deserializeTable(default, serializeTable(featureSettings))
                        deserializeTable(default, decodedData)
                        profileStore.profiles.Default = default
                        saveConfigs()
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

function loadSettings()
    loadConfigs()
    local resultValue = profileStore.profiles[profileStore.activeProfile]
    if resultValue then
        deserializeTable(featureSettings, resultValue)
    else
        profileStore.activeProfile = "Default"
        deserializeTable(featureSettings, profileStore.profiles.Default)
    end
    if featureSettings.FirstRunVersion ~= "vv1.7.0_Premium" then
        featureSettings.FirstRunVersion = "vv1.7.0_Premium"
        saveSettings()
    end
    normalizeSettings()
    if not hasPremiumAccess() then
        pcall(disablePremiumFeatures)
    end
end
function saveSettings()
    if profileStore.profiles[profileStore.activeProfile] == nil then
        profileStore.profiles[profileStore.activeProfile] = {}
    end
    profileStore.profiles[profileStore.activeProfile] = serializeTable(featureSettings)
    saveConfigs()
end
function loadProfile(activeProfile)
    local resultValue = profileStore.profiles[activeProfile]
    if not resultValue then
        return
    end
    profileStore.activeProfile = activeProfile
    deserializeTable(featureSettings, resultValue)
    if featureSettings.RevolverAutofarm and hasPremiumAccess() then
        featureSettings.InstantHeal = true
    end
    normalizeSettings()
    saveConfigs()
    pcall(disablePremiumFeatures)
    if applyPerformanceMode then
        pcall(applyPerformanceMode)
    end
    if applyFPSCap then
        pcall(applyFPSCap)
    end
    if applySettingsToControls then
        pcall(applySettingsToControls)
    end
end

    pcall(applyPerformanceMode)
end
if applyFPSCap then
    pcall(applyFPSCap)
end

function getDistance(player, argument)
    local humanoidRootPart = cachedLocalRootPart
    if not humanoidRootPart then
        local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
        humanoidRootPart = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoidRootPart then
            return math.huge
        end
    end
    local humanoidRootPart2 = argument
    if not humanoidRootPart2 then
        if player:IsA("Player") then
            local characterValue = player.Character
            humanoidRootPart2 = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        elseif player:IsA("Model") then
            humanoidRootPart2 = player.PrimaryPart or player:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        elseif player:IsA("BasePart") then
            humanoidRootPart2 = player
        end
    end
    if humanoidRootPart2 then
        return math.round((humanoidRootPart.Position - humanoidRootPart2.Position).Magnitude)
    end
    return math.huge
end

function updateTelemetryAndAFKStates()
    local farmLastTeamName = localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name or ""
    if farmLastTeamName ~= _G.VD_FarmState.farmLastTeamName then
        _G.VD_FarmState.farmTeamStartTime = tick()
        _G.VD_FarmState.farmLastTeamName = farmLastTeamName
        _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime = 0
        _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime = 0
    end
    local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
    local humanoidRootPart = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if farmLastTeamName == "Killer" and humanoidRootPart then
        if _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime == 0 then
            _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime = tick()
        end
    elseif farmLastTeamName ~= "Killer" then
        _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime = 0
    end
    if farmLastTeamName == "Survivors" and humanoidRootPart then
        if _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime == 0 then
            _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime = tick()
        end
    elseif farmLastTeamName ~= "Survivors" then
        _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime = 0
    end
    local _ = tick() - (_G.VD_FarmState.farmTeamStartTime or 0)
    if featureSettings.AutoFarmAFKTotal then
        if farmLastTeamName == "Survivors" then
            local matchesCondition = _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime > 0
                    and tick() - _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime
                or 0
            if _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime == 0 or matchesCondition < 15 then
                featureSettings.AutoFarmSurvivor = false
                featureSettings.AutoFarmKiller = false
                if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
                    pcall(function()
                        _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)
                    end)
                end
                if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
                    pcall(function()
                        _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(false)
                    end)
                end
                local resultValue = math.ceil(15 - matchesCondition)
                updateStatus(string.format("WAITING (%ds)", resultValue > 0 and resultValue or 15))
            else
                local characterValue2 = characterValue
                    and (
                        getModelValue(characterValue, "Knocked") == true
                        or characterValue:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
                    )
                local characterValue3 = characterValue
                    and (
                        getModelValue(characterValue, "IsHooked") == true
                        or characterValue:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
                    )
                if characterValue2 or characterValue3 then
                    featureSettings.AutoFarmSurvivor = false
                    featureSettings.AutoFarmKiller = false
                    if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
                        pcall(function()
                            _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)
                        end)
                    end
                    if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
                        pcall(function()
                            _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(false)
                        end)
                    end
                    updateStatus("PAUSED (Knocked/Hooked)")
                else
                    featureSettings.AutoFarmSurvivor = true
                    featureSettings.AutoFarmKiller = false
                    if _G.VD_FarmState.lastRoundScanned ~= _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime then
                        _G.VD_FarmState.lastRoundScanned = _G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime
                        pcall(scanMapObjects)
                        pcall(scanRemotes)
                    end
                    if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
                        pcall(function()
                            _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(true)
                        end)
                    end
                    if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
                        pcall(function()
                            _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(false)
                        end)
                    end
                    if featureSettings.AutoPumpkin then
                        local vdCurrentFarmState = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
                        if
                            vdCurrentFarmState
                            and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "Idle"
                            and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "IDLE"
                            and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "OFF"
                        then
                            updateStatus(vdCurrentFarmState)
                        else
                            updateStatus("RUNNING (Auto Pumpkin)")
                        end
                    else
                        local vdCurrentFarmState = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
                        if vdCurrentFarmState and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "Idle" and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "IDLE" then
                            updateStatus(vdCurrentFarmState)
                        else
                            updateStatus("RUNNING (Survivor Farm)")
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        elseif farmLastTeamName == "Killer" then
            local matchesCondition = _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime > 0
                    and tick() - _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime
                or 0
            if _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime == 0 or matchesCondition < 15 then
                featureSettings.AutoFarmSurvivor = false
                featureSettings.AutoFarmKiller = false
                if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
                    pcall(function()
                        _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)
                    end)
                end
                if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
                    pcall(function()
                        _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(false)
                    end)
                end
                local resultValue = math.ceil(15 - matchesCondition)
                updateStatus(string.format("WAITING (%ds)", resultValue > 0 and resultValue or 15))
            else
                featureSettings.AutoFarmSurvivor = false
                featureSettings.AutoFarmKiller = true
                if _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerRoundScanned ~= _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime then
                    _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerRoundScanned = _G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime
                    pcall(scanMapObjects)
                    pcall(scanRemotes)
                end
                if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
                    pcall(function()
                        _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)
                    end)
                end
                if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
                    pcall(function()
                        _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(true)
                    end)
                end
                local vdCurrentFarmState = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
                if vdCurrentFarmState and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "Idle" and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "IDLE" then
                    updateStatus(vdCurrentFarmState)
                else
                    updateStatus("RUNNING (Killer Farm)")
                end
            end
        else
            featureSettings.AutoFarmSurvivor = false
            featureSettings.AutoFarmKiller = false
            if _G.VD_SetFarmToggle then
                pcall(function()
                    _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)
                end)
            end
            if _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle then
                pcall(function()
                    _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle(false)
                end)
            end
            updateStatus("PAUSED (Spectating/Lobby)")
        end
    else
        if featureSettings.AutoPumpkin then
            local vdCurrentFarmState = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
            if
                vdCurrentFarmState
                and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "Idle"
                and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "IDLE"
                and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "OFF"
            then
                updateStatus(vdCurrentFarmState)
            else
                updateStatus("RUNNING (Auto Pumpkin)")
            end
        elseif featureSettings.AutoFarmSurvivor then
            if
                farmLastTeamName == "Survivors"
                or farmLastTeamName ~= "Killer"
                    and farmLastTeamName ~= "Spectators"
                    and farmLastTeamName ~= "Spectator"
            then
                local characterValue2 = characterValue
                    and (
                        getModelValue(characterValue, "Knocked") == true
                        or characterValue:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
                    )
                local characterValue3 = characterValue
                    and (
                        getModelValue(characterValue, "IsHooked") == true
                        or characterValue:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
                    )
                if characterValue2 or characterValue3 then
                    updateStatus("PAUSED (Knocked/Hooked)")
                else
                    local vdCurrentFarmState = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
                    if vdCurrentFarmState and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "Idle" and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "IDLE" then
                        updateStatus(vdCurrentFarmState)
                    else
                        updateStatus("RUNNING (Survivor Farm)")
                    end
                end
            elseif farmLastTeamName == "Killer" then
                updateStatus("PAUSED (Killer Team)")
            else
                updateStatus("PAUSED (Spectating/Lobby)")
            end
        elseif featureSettings.AutoFarmKiller then
            if farmLastTeamName == "Killer" then
                local vdCurrentFarmState = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
                if vdCurrentFarmState and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "Idle" and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "IDLE" then
                    updateStatus(vdCurrentFarmState)
                else
                    updateStatus("RUNNING (Killer Farm)")
                end
            elseif farmLastTeamName == "Survivors" then
                updateStatus("PAUSED (Survivor Team)")
            else
                updateStatus("PAUSED (Spectating/Lobby)")
            end
        elseif featureSettings.AutoServerHopEscape then
            local vdCurrentFarmState = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
            if
                vdCurrentFarmState
                and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "Idle"
                and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "IDLE"
                and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "OFF"
            then
                updateStatus(vdCurrentFarmState)
            else
                updateStatus("RUNNING (Hop Escape)")
            end
        elseif featureSettings.InstantFinishlineEscape then
            if
                farmLastTeamName == "Survivors"
                or farmLastTeamName ~= "Killer"
                    and farmLastTeamName ~= "Spectators"
                    and farmLastTeamName ~= "Spectator"
            then
                local vdCurrentFarmState = _G.VD_CurrentFarmState
                if vdCurrentFarmState and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "Idle" and vdCurrentFarmState ~= "IDLE" then
                    updateStatus(vdCurrentFarmState)
                else
                    updateStatus("RUNNING (Instant Escape)")
                end
            elseif farmLastTeamName == "Killer" then
                updateStatus("PAUSED (Killer Team)")
            else
                updateStatus("WAITING FOR MATCH (Lobby)")
            end
        else
            updateStatus("OFF")
        end
    end
end
function isSurvivorFarmAllowed()
    if not featureSettings.AutoFarmSurvivor then
        return false
    end
    local team = localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name or ""
    if team ~= "Survivors" then
        return false
    end
    if (_G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime or 0) == 0 then
        return false
    end
    local difference = tick() - (_G.VD_FarmState.lastSurvivorSpawnTime or 0)
    if difference < 15 then
        return false
    end
    local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
    local characterValue2 = characterValue
        and (getModelValue(characterValue, "Knocked") == true or characterValue:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true)
    local characterValue3 = characterValue
        and (getModelValue(characterValue, "IsHooked") == true or characterValue:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true)
    if characterValue2 or characterValue3 then
        return false
    end
    return true
end
function isKillerFarmAllowed()
    if not featureSettings.AutoFarmKiller then
        return false
    end
    local team = localPlayer.Team and localPlayer.Team.Name or ""
    if team ~= "Killer" then
        return false
    end
    if (_G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime or 0) == 0 then
        return false
    end
    local difference = tick() - (_G.VD_FarmState.lastKillerSpawnTime or 0)
    if difference < 15 then
        return false
    end
    return true
end

function getSelectedKiller(player)
    if typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Model") then
        local selectedKiller = player:GetAttribute("SelectedKiller")
        if selectedKiller ~= nil then
            return tostring(selectedKiller)
        end
        return tostring(player.Name)
    end
    local selectedKiller = player:GetAttribute("SelectedKiller")
    if selectedKiller ~= nil then
        return tostring(selectedKiller)
    end
    local selectedKiller2 = player:FindFirstChild("SelectedKiller")
    if selectedKiller2 and (selectedKiller2:IsA("StringValue") or selectedKiller2:IsA("ValueObject")) then
        return tostring(selectedKiller2.Value)
    end
    if player.Character then
        local selectedKiller3 = player.Character:GetAttribute("SelectedKiller")
        if selectedKiller3 ~= nil then
            return tostring(selectedKiller3)
        end
    end
    return "None"
end
function getPlayerHealthPercent(player)
    local characterValue = typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Model") and player
        or player and player.Character
    if characterValue then
        local humanoid = characterValue:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            return humanoid.Health, humanoid.MaxHealth
        end
    end
    return 100, 100
end
function getGeneratorProgress(resultValue)
    local repairProgress = resultValue:GetAttribute("RepairProgress")
    if repairProgress == nil then
        local repairProgress2 = resultValue:FindFirstChild("RepairProgress")
        if repairProgress2 and repairProgress2:IsA("ValueObject") then
            repairProgress = repairProgress2.Value
        end
    end
    if not repairProgress then
        return 0
    end
    local numberValue = tonumber(repairProgress)
    if numberValue then
        if numberValue <= 1.01 and numberValue > 0 then
            return math.round(numberValue * 100)
        else
            return math.round(numberValue)
        end
    end
    return 0
end
local generatorAnalytics = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
function isGeneratorRegressing(resultValue)
    if not resultValue then
        return false
    end
    local regressing = resultValue:GetAttribute("Regressing")
    if regressing ~= nil then
        return regressing == true
    end
    local succeeded, matchesCondition = pcall(function()
        local regressing2 = resultValue:FindFirstChild("Regressing")
        if regressing2 then
            if regressing2:IsA("ValueObject") or regressing2:IsA("BoolValue") then
                return regressing2.Value == true
            end
            return true
        end
        return resultValue.Regressing == true
    end)
    if succeeded and matchesCondition == true then
        return true
    end
    local hitBox = resultValue:FindFirstChild("HitBox")
        or resultValue:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
        or resultValue:FindFirstChild("Engine")
        or resultValue:IsA("Model") and resultValue.PrimaryPart
        or resultValue:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    if hitBox then
        local regressing2 = hitBox:GetAttribute("Regressing")
        if regressing2 == true then
            return true
        end
        local regressing3 = hitBox:FindFirstChild("Regressing")
        if regressing3 then
            if regressing3:IsA("ValueObject") or regressing3:IsA("BoolValue") then
                return regressing3.Value == true
            end
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end
function getGeneratorAnalytics(resultValue)
    if not resultValue then
        return 0, nil, ""
    end
    local resultValue2 = generatorAnalytics[resultValue]
    if not resultValue2 then
        return 0, nil, ""
    end
    return resultValue2.smoothedSpeed or 0, resultValue2.etaSeconds, resultValue2.etaFormatted or ""
end
local function updateGeneratorAnalytics()
    local lastTime = tick()
    local masterESP = featureSettings.MasterESP
        and featureSettings.GeneratorESP
        and featureSettings.GeneratorESP.Enabled
        and featureSettings.GeneratorESP.AlertThresholdEnabled
    local generatorESP = featureSettings.GeneratorESP and featureSettings.GeneratorESP.AlertThreshold or 90
    for _, item in ipairs(cachedGenerators or {}) do
        if not item or not item.Parent then
            continue
        end
        if isGeneratorCompleted(item) then
            generatorAnalytics[item] = nil
            continue
        end
        local lastProgress = getGeneratorProgress(item)
        local resultValue = generatorAnalytics[item]
        if not resultValue then
            generatorAnalytics[item] = {
                lastProgress = lastProgress,
                lastTime = lastTime,
                history = {},
                smoothedSpeed = 0,
                smoothedETA = nil,
                etaSeconds = nil,
                etaFormatted = "",
                alertTriggered = lastProgress >= generatorESP,
            }
            continue
        end
        local difference = lastTime - resultValue.lastTime
        if difference >= 0.75 then
            local difference2 = lastProgress - resultValue.lastProgress
            local resultValue2 = isGeneratorRegressing(item)
            local smoothedSpeed = 0
            if difference2 ~= 0 then
                smoothedSpeed = difference2 / difference
            elseif resultValue2 then
                if resultValue.smoothedSpeed and resultValue.smoothedSpeed < 0 then
                    smoothedSpeed = resultValue.smoothedSpeed
                else
                    smoothedSpeed = -0.5
                end
            else
                smoothedSpeed = 0
            end
            table.insert(resultValue.history, smoothedSpeed)
            if #resultValue.history > 5 then
                table.remove(resultValue.history, 1)
            end
            local sum = 0
            for _, item2 in ipairs(resultValue.history) do
                sum = sum + item2
            end
            local ratio = sum / #resultValue.history
            local smoothedSpeed2 = resultValue.smoothedSpeed or 0
            local smoothedSpeed3 = smoothedSpeed2 + (ratio - smoothedSpeed2) * 0.25
            if math.abs(smoothedSpeed3) < 0.05 then
                smoothedSpeed3 = 0
            end
            local etaSeconds = nil
            local etaFormatted = ""
            if smoothedSpeed3 > 0.1 then
                local difference3 = 100 - lastProgress
                local resultValue3 = math.max(0, difference3 / smoothedSpeed3)
                local smoothedETA = resultValue.smoothedETA or resultValue3
                local smoothedETA2 = smoothedETA + (resultValue3 - smoothedETA) * 0.2
                resultValue.smoothedETA = smoothedETA2
                etaSeconds = smoothedETA2
                if etaSeconds < 60 then
                    etaFormatted = string.format("%ds", math.ceil(etaSeconds))
                else
                    local integerValue = math.floor(etaSeconds / 60)
                    local resultValue4 = math.ceil(etaSeconds % 60)
                    etaFormatted = string.format("%dm %02ds", integerValue, resultValue4)
                end
            else
                resultValue.smoothedETA = nil
            end
            resultValue.smoothedSpeed = smoothedSpeed3
            resultValue.etaSeconds = etaSeconds
            resultValue.etaFormatted = etaFormatted
            resultValue.lastProgress = lastProgress
            resultValue.lastTime = lastTime
            if masterESP then
                if lastProgress >= generatorESP then
                    if not resultValue.alertTriggered then
                        resultValue.alertTriggered = true
                        local etaFormatted2 = resultValue.etaFormatted
                                and resultValue.etaFormatted ~= ""
                                and "ETA: " .. resultValue.etaFormatted
                            or "Nearly Complete!"
                        showNotification(
                            "Generator Alert",
                            string.format(
                                "Generator reached %d%% progress! (%s)",
                                math.floor(lastProgress),
                                etaFormatted2
                            ),
                            "warning"
                        )
                    end
                else
                    if lastProgress < generatorESP - 5 then
                        resultValue.alertTriggered = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

    end
end

local customPreviewSound = nil
function playSoundPreview(resultValue)
    if not hasPremiumAccess() then
        showNotification("Premium Feature +", "Unlock the Premium version to use this feature!", "warning")
        return
    end
    if customPreviewSound then
        pcall(function()
            customPreviewSound:Stop()
            customPreviewSound:Destroy()
        end)
        customPreviewSound = nil
    end
    local function handleAction(resultValue2)
        if not resultValue2 or resultValue2 == "" then
            return "rbxassetid://124429695332529"
        end
        if type(resultValue2) == "number" then
            return "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(resultValue2)
        end
        local text = tostring(resultValue2):gsub("%s+", "")
        if text:find("^rbxassetid://") or text:find("^http") or text:find("^assetgame") then
            return text
        end
        local match = text:match("%d+")
        if match then
            return "rbxassetid://" .. match
        end
        return text
    end
    local soundId = handleAction(resultValue)
    local volume = featureSettings.CustomGenSound and featureSettings.CustomGenSound.Volume or 1
    customPreviewSound = Instance.new("Sound")
    customPreviewSound.SoundId = soundId
    customPreviewSound.Volume = volume
    customPreviewSound.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("CurrentCamera") or workspace
    customPreviewSound:Play()
    showNotification("Sound Preview", "Playing sound: " .. soundId, "info")
    task.delay(4, function()
        if customPreviewSound then
            pcall(function()
                customPreviewSound:Stop()
                customPreviewSound:Destroy()
            end)
            customPreviewSound = nil
        end
    end)
end

function isGeneratorCompleted(resultValue)
    local completed = resultValue:GetAttribute("Completed")
    if completed == nil then
        local completed2 = resultValue:FindFirstChild("Completed")
        if completed2 and completed2:IsA("BoolValue") then
            completed = completed2.Value
        end
    end
    if completed == true or completed == "true" or tostring(completed):lower() == "true" then
        return true
    end
    return false
end
function isGeneratorPaused(resultValue)
    if not resultValue then
        return false
    end
    local progressPaused = resultValue:GetAttribute("ProgressPaused")
    if progressPaused == nil then
        local progressPaused2 = resultValue:FindFirstChild("ProgressPaused")
        if progressPaused2 and progressPaused2:IsA("ValueBase") then
            progressPaused = progressPaused2.Value
        end
    end
    return progressPaused == true or progressPaused == "true" or tostring(progressPaused):lower() == "true"
end
function getGatePartSafe(resultValue)
    if not resultValue or typeof(resultValue) ~= "Instance" or not resultValue.Parent then
        return nil
    end
    if resultValue:IsA("BasePart") then
        return resultValue
    end
    local exitLever = resultValue.Name == "ExitLever" and resultValue
        or resultValue:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)
        or resultValue:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
    if exitLever then
        local main = exitLever:FindFirstChild("Main")
            or exitLever:IsA("BasePart") and exitLever
            or exitLever:IsA("Model") and exitLever.PrimaryPart
            or exitLever:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            or exitLever:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        if main then
            return main
        end
    end
    if resultValue:IsA("Model") and resultValue.PrimaryPart then
        return resultValue.PrimaryPart
    end
    return resultValue:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or resultValue:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end
function getGateProgress(resultValue)
    if not resultValue then
        return 0
    end
    local function handleAction(resultValue2)
        if not resultValue2 then
            return nil
        end
        local activationProgress = resultValue2:GetAttribute("ActivationProgress")
            or resultValue2:GetAttribute("Progress")
            or resultValue2:GetAttribute("RepairProgress")
        if activationProgress == nil then
            local activationProgress2 = resultValue2:FindFirstChild("ActivationProgress")
                or resultValue2:FindFirstChild("Progress")
            if activationProgress2 and activationProgress2:IsA("ValueObject") then
                activationProgress = activationProgress2.Value
            end
        end
        if activationProgress ~= nil then
            local numberValue = tonumber(activationProgress)
            if numberValue then
                if numberValue <= 1.01 and numberValue > 0 then
                    return math.round(numberValue * 100)
                else
                    return math.round(numberValue)
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local resultValue2 = handleAction(resultValue)
    if resultValue2 then
        return resultValue2
    end
    local exitLever = resultValue.Name == "ExitLever" and resultValue
        or resultValue:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)
        or resultValue:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
    if exitLever then
        local resultValue3 = handleAction(exitLever)
        if resultValue3 then
            return resultValue3
        end
        local main = exitLever:FindFirstChild("Main")
            or exitLever:IsA("BasePart") and exitLever
            or exitLever:IsA("Model") and exitLever.PrimaryPart
            or exitLever:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        if main then
            local resultValue = handleAction(main)
            if resultValue then
                return resultValue
            end
        end
    end
    local main = resultValue:FindFirstChild("Main", true)
    if main then
        local resultValue3 = handleAction(main)
        if resultValue3 then
            return resultValue3
        end
    end
    if resultValue.Parent and resultValue.Parent ~= workspace then
        local resultValue3 = handleAction(resultValue.Parent)
        if resultValue3 then
            return resultValue3
        end
        if resultValue.Parent.Parent and resultValue.Parent.Parent ~= workspace then
            local resultValue2 = handleAction(resultValue.Parent.Parent)
            if resultValue2 then
                return resultValue2
            end
        end
    end
    return 0
end

        if name == "Spectator" or name == "Spectators" then

end
setModelValue = function(instance, attributeName, attributeValue)
    if not instance then
        return
    end
    if instance:GetAttribute(attributeName) ~= nil then
        instance:SetAttribute(attributeName, attributeValue)
        return
    end
    local child = instance:FindFirstChild(attributeName)
    if child and child:IsA("ValueBase") then
        child.Value = attributeValue
        return
    end
    instance:SetAttribute(attributeName, attributeValue)
end
getModelValue = function(instance, attributeName)
    if not instance then
        return nil
    end
    local resultValue = instance:GetAttribute(attributeName)
    if resultValue ~= nil then
        return resultValue
    end
    local child = instance:FindFirstChild(attributeName)
    if child and child:IsA("ValueBase") then
        return child.Value
    end
    return nil
end
local teleportInProgress = false
local activeTeleportTween = nil
function safeSegmentedTeleport(resultValue, argument, argument2)
    if not resultValue or not resultValue.Parent then
        return
    end
    if teleportInProgress then
        if activeTeleportTween then
            pcall(function()
                activeTeleportTween:Cancel()
            end)
        end
    end
    teleportInProgress = true
    local succeeded, _ = pcall(function()
        local position = typeof(argument) == "CFrame" and argument.Position or argument
        local transform = typeof(argument) == "CFrame" and argument or CFrame.new(position)
        local transform2 = resultValue.CFrame
        local position2 = transform2.Position
        local distance = (position - position2).Magnitude
        if distance <= 2 then
            resultValue.CFrame = transform
            pcall(function()
                resultValue.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                resultValue.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
            return
        end
        local safeTpSpeed = argument2 or featureSettings.SafeTpSpeed or 14
        if safeTpSpeed > 22 then
            safeTpSpeed = 22
        end
        if safeTpSpeed < 6 then
            safeTpSpeed = 6
        end
        local ratio = distance / math.max(safeTpSpeed, 1)
        local parent = resultValue.Parent
        local humanoid = parent and parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local items = {}
        if parent and parent:IsA("Model") then
            for _, descendant in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
                if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.CanCollide then
                    items[descendant] = true
                    descendant.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end
        local connection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if parent and parent.Parent then
                for _, descendant in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
                    if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.CanCollide then
                        descendant.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        local matchesCondition = featureSettings.UndergroundTP == true and distance > 12
        local undergroundDepth = featureSettings.UndergroundDepth or 8.5
        if matchesCondition then
            pcall(function()
                resultValue.CFrame = resultValue.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, undergroundDepth, 0)
            end)
        end
        local vectorValue = position - position2
        local vectorValue2 = Vector3.new(vectorValue.X, 0, vectorValue.Z)
        local transform3 = matchesCondition and transform - Vector3.new(0, undergroundDepth, 0) or transform
        if vectorValue2.Magnitude > 0.01 then
            local position3 = matchesCondition and position - Vector3.new(0, undergroundDepth, 0) or position
            transform3 = CFrame.new(position3, position3 + vectorValue2.Unit)
        end
        local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(ratio, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        local tween = TweenService:Create(resultValue, tweenInfo, { CFrame = transform3 })
        activeTeleportTween = tween
        local connection2 = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not resultValue or not resultValue.Parent then
                return
            end
            pcall(function()
                local unit = vectorValue.Unit
                resultValue.AssemblyLinearVelocity = unit * safeTpSpeed
                resultValue.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    humanoid:Move(Vector3.new(unit.X, 0, unit.Z), false)
                    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
                end
            end)
        end)
        tween:Play()
        local timestamp = tick()
        local sum = ratio + 2
        local enabled = false
        local connection3
        connection3 = tween.Completed:Connect(function()
            enabled = true
        end)
        while not enabled and tick() - timestamp < sum do
            task.wait(0.05)
            if not resultValue or not resultValue.Parent then
                break
            end
            local distance2 = (position - resultValue.Position).Magnitude
            if distance2 > distance + 15 then
                pcall(function()
                    tween:Cancel()
                end)
                break
            end
        end
        if connection3 then
            pcall(function()
                connection3:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
        if connection2 then
            pcall(function()
                connection2:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
        if connection then
            pcall(function()
                connection:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
        if resultValue and resultValue.Parent then
            resultValue.CFrame = transform
            pcall(function()
                resultValue.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                resultValue.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
                end
            end)
        end
        for key in pairs(items) do
            if key and key.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    key.CanCollide = true
                end)
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.05)
    end)
    activeTeleportTween = nil
    teleportInProgress = false
    return succeeded
end

function applyLocalPlayerModifiers()
    local team = localPlayer.Team
    local name = team and team.Name
    local modifierTeamFilter = featureSettings.ModifierTeamFilter or "Both"
    local matchesCondition = false
    if modifierTeamFilter == "Both" then
        matchesCondition = not name or name ~= "Spectators" and name ~= "Spectator"
    elseif modifierTeamFilter == "Survivors" then
        matchesCondition = not name or name ~= "Killer" and name ~= "Spectators"
    elseif modifierTeamFilter == "Killer" then
        matchesCondition = name == "Killer"
    end
    if not matchesCondition and featureSettings.SpeedBoostEnabled then
        featureSettings.SpeedBoostEnabled = false
        pcall(saveSettings)
        if applySettingsToControls then
            pcall(applySettingsToControls)
        end
        showNotification("Speed Boost", "Disabled: Speed Boost team filter active!", "warning")
    end
    local childName = localPlayer.Name
    if not childName then
        return
    end
    local items = {}
    if localPlayer.Character then
        table.insert(items, localPlayer.Character)
    end
    local child = workspace:FindFirstChild(childName)
    if child and child:IsA("Model") then
        if not table.find(items, child) then
            table.insert(items, child)
        end
    end
    local items2 = { "climb_obsessing", "climb_collisoning", "climb_collisioning", "climb_colliding" }
    for _, childName2 in ipairs(items2) do
        local child2 = workspace:FindFirstChild(childName2)
        if child2 then
            local child3 = child2:FindFirstChild(childName)
            if child3 and child3:IsA("Model") then
                if not table.find(items, child3) then
                    table.insert(items, child3)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        local vaultSpeed = matchesCondition and featureSettings.VaultSpeed or 1
        setModelValue(item, "vaultspeed", vaultSpeed)
    end
end
local speedBoostConnection = nil
if not speedBoostConnection then
    speedBoostConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not activeLoop then
            return
        end
        if not featureSettings.SpeedBoostEnabled then
            return
        end
        local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
        if not characterValue then
            return
        end
        local humanoid = characterValue:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local humanoidRootPart = characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoid or not humanoidRootPart or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            return
        end
        local team = localPlayer.Team
        local name = team and team.Name
        local modifierTeamFilter = featureSettings.ModifierTeamFilter or "Both"
        if modifierTeamFilter == "Survivors" and name == "Killer" then
            return
        end
        if modifierTeamFilter == "Killer" and name ~= "Killer" then
            return
        end
        if name == "Spectators" or name == "Spectator" then
            return
        end
        if
            characterValue:GetAttribute("IsStunned") == true
            or characterValue:GetAttribute("Immobile") == true
            or characterValue:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
            or characterValue:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
            or characterValue:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true
        then
            return
        end
        local moveDirection = humanoid.MoveDirection
        if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 then
            local speed = characterValue:GetAttribute("Speed") or 16
            local numberValue = tonumber(featureSettings.SpeedBoost) or 1.3
            if featureSettings.CountSpeedPerks then
                local speedboost = characterValue:GetAttribute("speedboost") or 1
                numberValue = speedboost + (numberValue - 1)
            end
            local timestamp = tick()
            local matchesCondition = name ~= "Killer"
            if
                matchesCondition
                and featureSettings.SimulateQuickRecovery
                and timestamp < (_G.VD_QuickRecoveryBoostEnd or 0)
            then
                numberValue = numberValue + 0.4
            end
            if
                matchesCondition
                and featureSettings.SimulatePerfectLanding
                and timestamp < (_G.VD_PerfectLandingBoostEnd or 0)
            then
                numberValue = numberValue + 0.4
            end
            if featureSettings.AntiRubberbandSpeed ~= false then
                local numberValue2 = tonumber(featureSettings.SafeSpeedCap) or 1.35
                if numberValue > numberValue2 then
                    numberValue = numberValue2
                end
            end
            local scaledValue = speed * numberValue
            local unit = Vector3.new(moveDirection.X, 0, moveDirection.Z).Unit
            local assemblyLinearVelocity = humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
                Vector3.new(unit.X * scaledValue, assemblyLinearVelocity.Y, unit.Z * scaledValue)
        end
    end)
    registerConnection(speedBoostConnection)
end
cachedGenerators = {}
cachedHooks = {}
cachedPallets = {}
cachedVaults = {}
cachedBloodEffects = {}
