local function cacheMapObject(instance)
    if not instance or not instance.Parent then
        return
    end
    local className = instance.ClassName
    if className ~= "Model" and className ~= "Part" and className ~= "Folder" then
        return
    end
    local name = instance.Name
    if name == "Generator" and instance:IsA("Model") then
        if not table.find(cachedGenerators, instance) then
            table.insert(cachedGenerators, instance)
        end
    elseif
        instance:IsA("Model")
        and (
            instance.Parent and instance.Parent.Name == "Pallets"
            or instance.Name == "Pallet"
            or instance:FindFirstChild("Intact")
        )
    then
        if not table.find(cachedPallets, instance) then
            table.insert(cachedPallets, instance)
        end
    elseif name == "Window" or name:lower():find("window") or name == "Vault" or name:lower():find("vault") then
        local enabled = false
        local enabled2 = false
        local enabled3 = false
        for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
            local lowercaseText = descendant.Name:lower()
            if lowercaseText == "bottom" then
                enabled = true
            elseif lowercaseText == "inviswall" then
                enabled2 = true
            elseif lowercaseText == "vaulttrigger" then
                enabled3 = true
            end
        end
        if enabled and enabled2 and enabled3 then
            if not table.find(cachedVaults, instance) then
                table.insert(cachedVaults, instance)
            end
        end
    elseif name == "VaultTrigger" or name:lower():find("vaulttrigger") then
        local parent = instance.Parent
        if parent and (parent:IsA("Model") or parent:IsA("Folder")) then
            local enabled = false
            local enabled2 = false
            for _, descendant in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
                local lowercaseText = descendant.Name:lower()
                if lowercaseText == "bottom" then
                    enabled = true
                elseif lowercaseText == "inviswall" then
                    enabled2 = true
                end
            end
            if enabled and enabled2 then
                if not table.find(cachedVaults, parent) then
                    table.insert(cachedVaults, parent)
                end
            end
        end
    elseif name == "BloodEffect" and instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        if not table.find(cachedBloodEffects, instance) then
            table.insert(cachedBloodEffects, instance)
        end
    elseif name == "Hook" or name == "HookPoint" then
        local players = Players:GetPlayers()
        local items = {}
        for _, player in ipairs(players) do
            if player.Character then
                items[player.Character] = true
            end
        end
        local enabled = false
        local parent = instance
        while parent and parent ~= workspace do
            if items[parent] then
                enabled = true
                break
            end
            parent = parent.Parent
        end
        if not enabled then
            local hookPoint = nil
            if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                hookPoint = instance
            elseif instance:IsA("Model") or instance:IsA("Folder") then
                hookPoint = instance:FindFirstChild("HookPoint")
                    or instance:IsA("Model") and instance.PrimaryPart
                    or instance:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                    or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            end
            if hookPoint then
                if not table.find(cachedHooks, hookPoint) then
                    table.insert(cachedHooks, hookPoint)
                end
            end
        end
    elseif
        (name == "ExitLever" or instance:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true) or instance:FindFirstChild("ExitLever"))
        and not (
            name:lower():find("spot")
            or name:lower():find("spawn")
            or name:lower():find("marker")
            or name:lower():find("point")
        )
    then
        local exitLever = instance.Name == "ExitLever" and instance
            or instance:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)
            or instance:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
        if exitLever and not table.find(cachedGates, exitLever) then
            table.insert(cachedGates, exitLever)
        end
    elseif name == "BearTrap" or CollectionService and CollectionService:HasTag(instance, "BearTrap") then
        if not table.find(cachedBearTraps, instance) then
            table.insert(cachedBearTraps, instance)
        end
    elseif
        instance.Parent and instance.Parent.Name == "Pumpkins"
        or name:lower():find("pumpkin") and name ~= "Pumpkins"
    then
        if not instance:IsA("Folder") then
            local instance2 = instance:IsA("Model") and instance or instance:IsA("BasePart") and instance
            if instance2 and not table.find(cachedPumpkins, instance2) then
                table.insert(cachedPumpkins, instance2)
            end
        end
    end
end
local function uncacheMapObject(instance)
    if not instance then
        return
    end
    local name = instance.Name
    if name == "Generator" then
        local matchIndex = table.find(cachedGenerators, instance)
        if matchIndex then
            table.remove(cachedGenerators, matchIndex)
        end
        pcall(function()
            removeModelESP(instance, "Generator")
        end)
    elseif
        name == "Pallet"
        or instance.Parent and instance.Parent.Name == "Pallets"
        or table.find(cachedPallets, instance)
    then
        local matchIndex = table.find(cachedPallets, instance)
        if matchIndex then
            table.remove(cachedPallets, matchIndex)
        end
        pcall(function()
            removeModelESP(instance, "Pallet")
        end)
    elseif name == "Window" or name:lower():find("window") or name == "Vault" or name:lower():find("vault") then
        local matchIndex = table.find(cachedVaults, instance)
        if matchIndex then
            table.remove(cachedVaults, matchIndex)
        end
        pcall(function()
            removeModelESP(instance, "Vault")
        end)
    elseif name == "VaultTrigger" or name:lower():find("vaulttrigger") then
        local parent = instance.Parent
        if parent then
            local matchIndex = table.find(cachedVaults, parent)
            if matchIndex then
                table.remove(cachedVaults, matchIndex)
            end
            pcall(function()
                removeModelESP(parent, "Vault")
            end)
        end
    elseif name == "BloodEffect" then
        local matchIndex = table.find(cachedBloodEffects, instance)
        if matchIndex then
            table.remove(cachedBloodEffects, matchIndex)
        end
        pcall(function()
            removeModelESP(instance, "BloodEffect")
        end)
    elseif name == "Hook" or name == "HookPoint" then
        local matchIndex = table.find(cachedHooks, instance)
        if matchIndex then
            table.remove(cachedHooks, matchIndex)
            pcall(function()
                removeModelESP(instance, "Hook")
            end)
        else
            for loopIndex = #cachedHooks, 1, -1 do
                local resultValue = cachedHooks[loopIndex]
                if resultValue == instance or resultValue:IsDescendantOf(instance) then
                    table.remove(cachedHooks, loopIndex)
                    pcall(function()
                        removeModelESP(resultValue, "Hook")
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    elseif name == "Gate" or name == "ESCAPEGATE" or name == "ExitLever" or table.find(cachedGates, instance) then
        local matchIndex = table.find(cachedGates, instance)
        if matchIndex then
            table.remove(cachedGates, matchIndex)
        end
        pcall(function()
            removeModelESP(instance, "Gate")
        end)
    elseif name == "BearTrap" then
        local matchIndex = table.find(cachedBearTraps, instance)
        if matchIndex then
            table.remove(cachedBearTraps, matchIndex)
        end
        pcall(function()
            removeModelESP(instance, "BearTrap")
        end)
    elseif
        name == "Pumpkin"
        or instance.Parent and instance.Parent.Name == "Pumpkins"
        or table.find(cachedPumpkins, instance)
    then
        local matchIndex = table.find(cachedPumpkins, instance)
        if matchIndex then
            table.remove(cachedPumpkins, matchIndex)
        end
        pcall(function()
            removeModelESP(instance, "Pumpkins")
        end)
    end
end
registerConnection(workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(resultValue)
    pcall(cacheMapObject, resultValue)
end))
registerConnection(workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(resultValue)
    pcall(uncacheMapObject, resultValue)
end))
for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    pcall(cacheMapObject, descendant)
end
registerConnection(workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(resultValue)
    if resultValue.Name == "Map" then
        task.delay(0.35, function()
            pcall(scanMapObjects)
            pcall(refreshTPMenu)
        end)
    end
end))
registerConnection(workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(resultValue)
    if resultValue.Name == "Map" then
        cachedGenerators = {}
        cachedHooks = {}
        cachedPallets = {}
        cachedVaults = {}
        cachedBloodEffects = {}
        cachedGates = {}
        cachedBearTraps = {}
        cachedPumpkins = {}
        if cleanupAllMapESP then
            pcall(cleanupAllMapESP)
        end
    end
end))

local cachedScpTargets = {}
function updateSCPCache()
    local items = {}
    local items2 = {}
    local function handleAction(resultValue)
        if resultValue and not items2[resultValue] then
            items2[resultValue] = true
            table.insert(items, resultValue)
        end
    end
    local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
    if map then
        for _, childName in ipairs({ "1", "2" }) do
            local child = map:FindFirstChild(childName)
            if child then
                for _, child2 in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
                    if child2:IsA("Model") then
                        handleAction(child2)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local function handleAction2(resultValue)
            return string.match(resultValue:lower(), "^scp%d*$") ~= nil
        end
        for _, child in ipairs(map:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name ~= "1" and child.Name ~= "2" then
                if child:IsA("Model") and handleAction2(child.Name) then
                    handleAction(child)
                elseif child:IsA("Folder") or child:IsA("Model") then
                    for _, child2 in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
                        if child2:IsA("Model") and handleAction2(child2.Name) then
                            handleAction(child2)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for _, child in ipairs(map:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Model") and child ~= localPlayer.Character then
                local cured = child:GetAttribute("Cured")
                if tonumber(cured) == 3 then
                    handleAction(child)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    cachedScpTargets = items
end
local cachedMapInstance = nil
local cachedMapName = "Unknown Map"
function getMapName()
    local succeeded, text = pcall(function()
        return game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Darkness.Frame.MapInfo.MapTitle.Text
    end)
    if succeeded and text and text ~= "" then
        if text:upper() == "NOSTROMO" then
            return "Loading..."
        end
        return text
    end
    local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
    if not map then
        cachedMapInstance = nil
        cachedMapName = "Unknown Map"
        return cachedMapName
    end
    local model = map:FindFirstChildOfClass("Model") or map:FindFirstChildOfClass("Folder") or map
    if model == cachedMapInstance and cachedMapName ~= "Unknown Map" then
        return cachedMapName
    end
    cachedMapInstance = model
    if map:FindFirstChild("HooksMeat", true) then
        cachedMapName = "BLOODBATH! Club"
        return cachedMapName
    end
    if map:FindFirstChild("Rooftop", true) then
        cachedMapName = "Mercy Hospital Rooftop"
        return cachedMapName
    end
    if map:FindFirstChild("inviswallasylum", true) then
        cachedMapName = "Mount Massive Asylum"
        return cachedMapName
    end
    if map:FindFirstChild("Tesla", true) then
        cachedMapName = "Site 68"
        return cachedMapName
    end
    if map:FindFirstChild("Breakwater", true) then
        cachedMapName = "The Bay Harbor"
        return cachedMapName
    end
    if map:FindFirstChild("RockVar0", true) then
        cachedMapName = "Woodview Cabin"
        return cachedMapName
    end
    local model2 = map:FindFirstChild("Model", true)
    if model2 then
        local position = model2:GetPivot().Position
        if (position - Vector3.new(-811.4, 212.8, -7774.5)).Magnitude < 100 then
            cachedMapName = "Firelink Shrine"
            return cachedMapName
        end
        if (position - Vector3.new(1114.67, -16.92, -12.99)).Magnitude < 100 then
            cachedMapName = "Valdelobos Village"
            return cachedMapName
        end
    end
    cachedMapName = "Unknown Map"
    return cachedMapName
end
function applyBlockInteractions()
    pcall(function()
        local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        remotes = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Window")
        remotes = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("VaultEvent")
        if remotes then
            for _, vault in ipairs(cachedVaults) do
                if vault and vault.Parent then
                    for _, descendant in ipairs(vault:GetDescendants()) do
                        if descendant.Name == "VaultTrigger" then
                            remotes:FireServer(descendant, true)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        remotes = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Pallet")
        remotes = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("PalletSlideEvent")
        if remotes then
            for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
                if pallet and pallet.Parent then
                    for _, descendant in ipairs(pallet:GetDescendants()) do
                        if descendant.Name == "PalletPointSlide" or descendant.Name:find("Slide") then
                            remotes:FireServer(descendant, true)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end
function releaseBlockInteractions()
    _G.VD_ReleasingBlockInteractions = true
    pcall(function()
        local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        remotes = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Window")
        remotes = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("VaultCompleteEvent")
        if remotes then
            local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
            local map2 = map or workspace
            for _, descendant in ipairs(map2:GetDescendants()) do
                if descendant.Name == "VaultTrigger" then
                    remotes:FireServer(descendant, false)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    _G.VD_ReleasingBlockInteractions = false
    pcall(function()
        local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        remotes = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Pallet")
        remotes = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("PalletSlideCompleteEvent")
        if remotes then
            for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
                if pallet and pallet.Parent then
                    for _, descendant in ipairs(pallet:GetDescendants()) do
                        if descendant.Name == "PalletPointSlide" or descendant.Name:find("Slide") then
                            remotes:FireServer(descendant)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end
do
    local enabled = false
    function scanMapObjects()
        if enabled then
            return
        end
        enabled = true
        task.spawn(function()
            local items, items2, items3, items4, items5, items6, items7 = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
            local items8 = {}
            pcall(updateSCPCache)
            pcall(function()
                obstaclePartCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
                vaultRootPartCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "kv" })
                if originalCanCollide then
                    for key, _ in pairs(originalCanCollide) do
                        if not key or not key.Parent then
                            originalCanCollide[key] = nil
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            local players = Players:GetPlayers()
            local items9 = {}
            for _, player in ipairs(players) do
                if player.Character then
                    items9[player.Character] = true
                end
            end
            local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
            local descendants = map and map:GetDescendants() or workspace:GetDescendants()
            for loopIndex, item in ipairs(descendants) do
                if loopIndex % 300 == 0 then
                    task.wait()
                end
                local name = item.Name
                if (name == "Generator" or name:lower():find("generator")) and item:IsA("Model") then
                    table.insert(items, item)
                elseif
                    item:IsA("Model")
                    and (
                        item.Parent and item.Parent.Name == "Pallets"
                        or item.Name == "Pallet"
                        or item:FindFirstChild("Intact")
                    )
                then
                    table.insert(items3, item)
                elseif item.Name == "BearTrap" or CollectionService and CollectionService:HasTag(item, "BearTrap") then
                    table.insert(items7, item)
                elseif
                    name == "Window"
                    or name:lower():find("window")
                    or name == "Vault"
                    or name:lower():find("vault")
                then
                    local bottom = item:FindFirstChild("bottom") or item:FindFirstChild("Bottom")
                    local inviswall = item:FindFirstChild("inviswall") or item:FindFirstChild("Inviswall")
                    local vaulttrigger = item:FindFirstChild("vaulttrigger") or item:FindFirstChild("VaultTrigger")
                    if not (bottom and inviswall and vaulttrigger) then
                        for _, child in ipairs(item:GetChildren()) do
                            local lowercaseText = child.Name:lower()
                            if lowercaseText == "bottom" then
                                bottom = true
                            elseif lowercaseText == "inviswall" then
                                inviswall = true
                            elseif lowercaseText == "vaulttrigger" then
                                vaulttrigger = true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if bottom and inviswall and vaulttrigger then
                        table.insert(items4, item)
                    end
                elseif name == "BloodEffect" and item:IsA("BasePart") then
                    table.insert(items5, item)
                elseif name == "Hook" or name == "HookPoint" then
                    local enabled = false
                    local parent = item
                    while parent and parent ~= workspace and parent ~= map do
                        if items9[parent] then
                            enabled = true
                            break
                        end
                        parent = parent.Parent
                    end
                    if not enabled then
                        local hookPoint = nil
                        if item:IsA("BasePart") then
                            hookPoint = item
                        elseif item:IsA("Model") or item:IsA("Folder") then
                            hookPoint = item:FindFirstChild("HookPoint")
                                or item:IsA("Model") and item.PrimaryPart
                                or item:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                                or item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                        end
                        if hookPoint and not items8[hookPoint] then
                            items8[hookPoint] = true
                            table.insert(items2, hookPoint)
                        end
                    end
                elseif
                    (name == "ExitLever" or item:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true) or item:FindFirstChild("ExitLever"))
                    and not (
                        name:lower():find("spot")
                        or name:lower():find("spawn")
                        or name:lower():find("marker")
                        or name:lower():find("point")
                    )
                then
                    local exitLever = item.Name == "ExitLever" and item
                        or item:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)
                        or item:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
                    if exitLever and not table.find(items6, exitLever) then
                        table.insert(items6, exitLever)
                    end
                end
            end
            cachedGenerators = items
            cachedHooks = items2
            cachedPallets = items3
            cachedVaults = items4
            cachedBloodEffects = items5
            if map then
                for _, child in ipairs(map:GetChildren()) do
                    local lowercaseText = child.Name:lower()
                    local matchIndex = lowercaseText:find("spot")
                        or lowercaseText:find("spawn")
                        or lowercaseText:find("marker")
                        or lowercaseText:find("point")
                    if not matchIndex then
                        local exitLever = child.Name == "ExitLever" and child
                            or child:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)
                            or child:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
                        if exitLever and not table.find(items6, exitLever) then
                            table.insert(items6, exitLever)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local items10 = {}
            local pumpkins = map and map:FindFirstChild("Pumpkins")
            if pumpkins then
                for _, child in ipairs(pumpkins:GetChildren()) do
                    if not child:IsA("Folder") then
                        local child2 = child:IsA("Model") and child or child:IsA("BasePart") and child
                        if child2 and not table.find(items10, child2) then
                            table.insert(items10, child2)
                        end
                    else
                        for _, child2 in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
                            local child = child2:IsA("Model") and child2 or child2:IsA("BasePart") and child2
                            if child and not table.find(items10, child) then
                                table.insert(items10, child)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, descendant in ipairs(map:GetDescendants()) do
                if
                    descendant.Name ~= "Pumpkins"
                    and descendant.Name:lower():find("pumpkin")
                    and not descendant:IsA("Folder")
                then
                    local descendant2 = descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant
                        or descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant
                    if descendant2 and not table.find(items10, descendant2) then
                        table.insert(items10, descendant2)
                    end
                end
            end
            cachedPumpkins = items10
            cachedGates = items6
            cachedBearTraps = items7
            if refreshTPMenu then
                pcall(refreshTPMenu)
            end
            enabled = false
        end)
    end
end
refreshEspStyles = function()
    local sum = 3.5 + (featureSettings.ESPPositionY or 0)
    local font = Enum.Font[featureSettings.ESPFont] or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    local font2 = featureSettings.ESPFont == "GothamBold" and Enum.Font.Ubuntu or font
    local textStrokeColor3 = featureSettings.ESPTextOutlineColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    local textColor = featureSettings.ESPTextColorMode == "Custom" and featureSettings.ESPTextColor or nil
    for _, player in pairs(ActiveESP.Players) do
        player.LastESPStyle = nil
        player.LastHighlightColor = nil
        player.LastNameColor = nil
        if player.Billboard then
            player.Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, sum, 0)
        end
        if player.NameLabel then
            player.NameLabel.Font = font
            player.NameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = textStrokeColor3
            if textColor then
                player.NameLabel.TextColor3 = textColor
            end
        end
        if player.InfoLabel then
            player.InfoLabel.Font = font2
            player.InfoLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = textStrokeColor3
            if textColor then
                player.InfoLabel.TextColor3 = textColor
            end
        end
    end
    for _, item in pairs({
        ActiveESP.Generators,
        ActiveESP.Hooks,
        ActiveESP.Pallets,
        ActiveESP.Vaults,
        ActiveESP.BloodEffects,
        ActiveESP.Gates,
        ActiveESP.SCPs,
        ActiveESP.BearTraps,
        ActiveESP.Pumpkins,
    }) do
        for _, item2 in pairs(item) do
            item2.LastESPStyle = nil
            item2.LastHighlightColor = nil
            if item2.Billboard then
                item2.Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, sum, 0)
            end
            if item2.NameLabel then
                item2.NameLabel.Font = font
                item2.NameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = textStrokeColor3
                if textColor then
                    item2.NameLabel.TextColor3 = textColor
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
function createPlayerESP(resultValue)
    if ActiveESP.Players[resultValue] then
        return
    end
    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.FillTransparency = featureSettings.ESPFillTransparency or 0.6
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = featureSettings.ESPOutlineTransparency or 0.1
    highlight.Enabled = false
    highlight.Parent = highlightParent

    billboardGui.Parent = billboardParent

    container.Name = "Container"
    container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    container.BorderSizePixel = 0
    container.Parent = billboardGui
    local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

    uiCorner.Parent = container
    local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

    uiStroke.Transparency = 1
    uiStroke.Parent = container

    local font2 = featureSettings.ESPFont == "GothamBold" and Enum.Font.Ubuntu or font
    local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    textLabel.TextColor3 = featureSettings.ESPTextColorMode == "Custom" and featureSettings.ESPTextColor

    textLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4

        Highlight = highlight,
        Billboard = billboardGui,
        Container = container,
        ContainerStroke = uiStroke,
        NameLabel = textLabel,
        InfoLabel = textLabel2,
        Tracer = nil,
        CurrentCharacter = nil,
        LastAuraEnabled = nil,
        LastHighlightColor = nil,

        LastInfoText = nil,
        LastHookedProgressVal = nil,
        LastHookedChangeTime = 0,
        LastESPStyle = nil,
        LastIsMobile = nil,
    }
end
local function setEspTracerVisible(espData, visible)
    local tracer = espData.Tracer
    if not tracer then
        return
    end
    pcall(function()
        if type(tracer) == "table" then
            if not tracer.Remove then
                for _, guiObject in pairs(tracer) do
                    guiObject.Visible = visible
                end
            else
                tracer.Visible = visible
            end
        else
            tracer.Visible = visible
        end
    end)
end
function removePlayerESP(resultValue)
    local resultValue2 = ActiveESP.Players[resultValue]
    if resultValue2 then
        if resultValue2.Highlight then
            pcall(function()
                resultValue2.Highlight:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        if resultValue2.Billboard then
            pcall(function()
                resultValue2.Billboard:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        if resultValue2.Tracer then
            pcall(function()
                if type(resultValue2.Tracer) == "table" then
                    if resultValue2.Tracer.Remove then
                        resultValue2.Tracer:Remove()
                    else
                        for _, item in pairs(resultValue2.Tracer) do
                            pcall(function()
                                item:Remove()
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                else
                    resultValue2.Tracer:Destroy()
                end
            end)
            resultValue2.Tracer = nil
        end
        ActiveESP.Players[resultValue] = nil
    end
end

                    end
                elseif lastESPStyle == "Minimal" then
                    local matchesCondition3 = isKiller and featureSettings.KillerESP.Distance
                        or isSurvivor and featureSettings.SurvivorESP.Distance
                    if matchesCondition3 then
                        text2 = string.format("[%s]", formattedText)
                    else
                        if matchesCondition2 then
                            text2 = vdSpoofedNames2:sub(1, 4)
                        else
                            text2 = ""
                        end
                    end
                end
                local enabled = true
                if lastESPStyle == "Minimal" or lastESPStyle == "Compact" then
                    if text2 == "" then
                        enabled = false
                    end
                else
                    if text2 == "" and text3:gsub("%s+", "") == "" then
                        enabled = false
                    end
                end
                if resultValue.LastBillboardEnabled ~= enabled then
                    resultValue.Billboard.Enabled = enabled
                    resultValue.LastBillboardEnabled = enabled
                end
                if resultValue.LastNameText ~= text2 then
                    resultValue.NameLabel.Text = text2
                    resultValue.LastNameText = text2
                end
                if resultValue.LastNameColor ~= textColor then
                    resultValue.NameLabel.TextColor3 = textColor
                    resultValue.LastNameColor = textColor
                end
                if lastESPStyle == "Standard" or lastESPStyle == "Old" then
                    if resultValue.LastInfoText ~= text3 then
                        resultValue.InfoLabel.Text = text3
                        resultValue.LastInfoText = text3
                    end
                end
                local isKiller2 = true
                if featureSettings.TracerTarget == "Killers Only" then
                    isKiller2 = isKiller
                elseif featureSettings.TracerTarget == "Survivors Only" then
                    isKiller2 = isSurvivor
                end
                local espTracers = featureSettings.ESPTracers
                    and enabled2
                    and humanoidRootPart
                    and adornee
                    and isKiller2
                local frame = resultValue.Tracer
                if espTracers then
                    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                    local vectorValue, resultValue2 = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(humanoidRootPart.Position)
                    if resultValue2 then
                        local from = Vector2.new(camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, camera.ViewportSize.Y)
                        if featureSettings.TracerOrigin == "Center" then
                            from = Vector2.new(camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
                        elseif featureSettings.TracerOrigin == "Top" then
                            from = Vector2.new(camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, 0)
                        end
                        local from2 = Vector2.new(vectorValue.X, vectorValue.Y)
                        local difference = 1
                        if featureSettings.ESPDistanceFade and distance then
                            if distance >= featureSettings.ESPFadeMax then
                                difference = 0
                            elseif distance > featureSettings.ESPFadeStart then
                                local difference2 = featureSettings.ESPFadeMax - featureSettings.ESPFadeStart
                                local difference3 = distance - featureSettings.ESPFadeStart
                                difference = 1 - difference3 / difference2
                            end
                        end
                        local color = textColor
                        if featureSettings.TracerColorMode == "Custom" then
                            color = getESPColor("Tracer")
                        end
                        local transparency = 0.8
                        if featureSettings.ESPDistanceFade and featureSettings.ESPDistanceFadeTracers then
                            transparency = 0.8 * difference
                        end
                        local visible = transparency > 0.01
                        if Drawing then
                            local enabled5 = false
                            if not frame or type(frame) ~= "table" or frame.Remove then
                                enabled5 = true
                            elseif featureSettings.TracerStyle == "Arrow" and (not frame.Left or not frame.Right) then
                                enabled5 = true
                            elseif featureSettings.TracerStyle == "Line" and (frame.Left or frame.Right) then
                                enabled5 = true
                            end
                            if enabled5 then
                                if frame then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        if type(frame) == "table" then
                                            if frame.Remove then
                                                frame:Remove()
                                            else
                                                for _, item in pairs(frame) do
                                                    pcall(function()
                                                        item:Remove()
                                                    end)
                                                end
                                            end
                                        else
                                            pcall(function()
                                                frame:Destroy()
                                            end)
                                        end
                                    end)
                                end
                                if featureSettings.TracerStyle == "Arrow" then
                                    frame = {
                                        Line = Drawing.new("Line"),
                                        Left = Drawing.new("Line"),
                                        Right = Drawing.new("Line"),
                                    }
                                    frame.Line.Thickness = 1.5
                                    frame.Left.Thickness = 1.5
                                    frame.Right.Thickness = 1.5
                                else
                                    frame = { Line = Drawing.new("Line") }
                                    frame.Line.Thickness = 1.5
                                end
                                resultValue.Tracer = frame
                            end
                            for _, guiObject in pairs(frame) do
                                guiObject.Color = color
                                guiObject.Transparency = transparency
                                guiObject.Visible = visible
                            end
                            if visible then
                                if featureSettings.TracerStyle == "Arrow" then
                                    local unit = (from2 - from).Unit
                                    if unit.Magnitude > 0 then
                                        local vectorValue2 = Vector2.new(-unit.Y, unit.X)
                                        local numberValue2 = 10
                                        local to = from2 - unit * numberValue2
                                        local to2 = to + vectorValue2 * (numberValue2 * 0.5)
                                        local to3 = to - vectorValue2 * (numberValue2 * 0.5)
                                        frame.Line.From = from
                                        frame.Line.To = to
                                        frame.Left.From = from2
                                        frame.Left.To = to2
                                        frame.Right.From = from2
                                        frame.Right.To = to3
                                    else
                                        frame.Line.From = from
                                        frame.Line.To = from2
                                        frame.Left.Visible = false
                                        frame.Right.Visible = false
                                    end
                                else
                                    frame.Line.From = from
                                    frame.Line.To = from2
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            if not frame or type(frame) ~= "userdata" or frame.Parent == nil then
                                if type(frame) == "table" then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        for _, item in pairs(frame) do
                                            pcall(function()
                                                item:Remove()
                                            end)
                                        end
                                    end)
                                end
                                frame = Instance.new("Frame")
                                frame.Name = "Tracer_" .. player.Name
                                frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
                                frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
                                frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                                frame.ZIndex = 2
                                frame.Parent = _G.VD_TracerContainer
                                resultValue.Tracer = frame
                            end
                            local vectorValue2 = from2 - from
                            local distance2 = vectorValue2.Magnitude
                            local resultValue2 = math.atan2(vectorValue2.Y, vectorValue2.X)
                            local vectorValue = (from + from2) / 2
                            frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, distance2, 0, 1.2)
                            frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, vectorValue.X, 0, vectorValue.Y)
                            frame.Rotation = math.deg(resultValue2)
                            frame.BackgroundColor3 = color
                            local backgroundTransparency = 0.2
                            if featureSettings.ESPDistanceFade and featureSettings.ESPDistanceFadeTracers then
                                backgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.8 * difference
                            end
                            frame.BackgroundTransparency = backgroundTransparency
                            frame.Visible = backgroundTransparency < 0.99
                        end
                    else
                        if frame then
                            setEspTracerVisible(resultValue, false)
                        end
                    end
                else
                    if frame then
                        setEspTracerVisible(resultValue, false)
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            if resultValue.LastAuraEnabled ~= false then
                resultValue.Highlight.Enabled = false
                resultValue.LastAuraEnabled = false
            end
            if resultValue.LastBillboardEnabled ~= false then
                resultValue.Billboard.Enabled = false
                resultValue.LastBillboardEnabled = false
            end
            if resultValue.Tracer then
                setEspTracerVisible(resultValue, false)
            end
            resultValue.CurrentCharacter = nil
        end
    end
    for key, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.Players) do
        if typeof(key) == "Instance" and key:IsA("Player") then
            if not Players:FindFirstChild(key.Name) then
                removePlayerESP(key)
            end
        elseif typeof(key) == "Instance" and key:IsA("Model") then
            if not key.Parent or not key:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
                removePlayerESP(key)
            else
                local humanoid = key:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if
                    humanoid
                    and humanoid.Health <= 0
                    and not (key:GetAttribute("Knocked") or key:GetAttribute("IsHooked"))
                then
                    removePlayerESP(key)
                end
            end
        else
            removePlayerESP(key)
        end
    end
end

function getModelTargetPart(resultValue)
    if resultValue:IsA("Model") then
        local intact = resultValue:FindFirstChild("Intact")
        if intact then
            if intact:IsA("BasePart") then
                return intact
            end
            if intact:IsA("Model") then
                return intact.PrimaryPart or intact:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            end
        end
        return resultValue.PrimaryPart or resultValue:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    end
    if resultValue:IsA("BasePart") then
        return resultValue
    end
    return nil
end
function getVaultHighlightPart(resultValue)
    local bottom = resultValue:FindFirstChild("Bottom")
    if not bottom or not bottom:IsA("BasePart") then
        local modelTargetPart = getModelTargetPart(resultValue)
        if modelTargetPart and modelTargetPart:IsA("BasePart") then
            return modelTargetPart
        end
        if resultValue:IsA("BasePart") then
            return resultValue
        end
        return resultValue:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or resultValue
    end
    local descendant = nil
    local huge = math.huge
    for _, descendant2 in ipairs(resultValue:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant2:IsA("BasePart") and descendant2 ~= bottom and descendant2.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
            if descendant2.Transparency < 1 then
                local distance = (descendant2.Position - bottom.Position).Magnitude
                if distance < huge then
                    huge = distance
                    descendant = descendant2
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return descendant or bottom
end
function disableMapESPData(resultValue)
    resultValue.CurrentAlpha = 0
    if resultValue.LastAuraEnabled ~= false then
        if resultValue.Highlight and resultValue.Highlight:IsA("Highlight") then
            resultValue.Highlight.Enabled = false
        elseif resultValue.Highlight and resultValue.Highlight:IsA("BoxHandleAdornment") then
            resultValue.Highlight.Visible = false
        end
        if resultValue.PuddleHighlight and resultValue.PuddleHighlight:IsA("Highlight") then
            resultValue.PuddleHighlight.Enabled = false
        end
        resultValue.LastAuraEnabled = false
    end
    if resultValue.LastBillboardEnabled ~= false then
        resultValue.Billboard.Enabled = false
        resultValue.LastBillboardEnabled = false
    end
end
function createModelESP(resultValue, argument)
    local resultValue2 = mapEspDescriptors[argument]
    if not resultValue2 then
        return
    end
    local resultValue3 = resultValue2.espList()
    if resultValue3[resultValue] then
        return
    end
    local espColor = getESPColor(argument)
    local boxHandleAdornment
    if argument == "Vault" then
        boxHandleAdornment = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
        boxHandleAdornment.AlwaysOnTop = true
        boxHandleAdornment.ZIndex = 5
        boxHandleAdornment.Transparency = featureSettings.ESPFillTransparency or 0.6
        boxHandleAdornment.Color3 = featureSettings.ESPFillColorMode == "Custom" and featureSettings.ESPFillColor
            or espColor
        boxHandleAdornment.Visible = false
        boxHandleAdornment.Parent = highlightParent
    else
        boxHandleAdornment = Instance.new("Highlight")
        boxHandleAdornment.FillTransparency = featureSettings.ESPFillTransparency or 0.6
        boxHandleAdornment.OutlineTransparency = featureSettings.ESPOutlineTransparency or 0.1
        boxHandleAdornment.FillColor = featureSettings.ESPFillColorMode == "Custom" and featureSettings.ESPFillColor
            or espColor
        boxHandleAdornment.OutlineColor = featureSettings.ESPOutlineColorMode == "Custom"
                and featureSettings.ESPOutlineColor
            or espColor
        boxHandleAdornment.Enabled = false
        boxHandleAdornment.Parent = highlightParent
    end
    local billboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboardGui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.5 + (featureSettings.ESPPositionY or 0), 0)
    billboardGui.Enabled = false
    billboardGui.Parent = billboardParent
    local container = Instance.new("Frame")
    container.Name = "Container"
    container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    container.BorderSizePixel = 0
    container.Parent = billboardGui
    local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    uiCorner.Parent = container
    local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    uiStroke.Thickness = 1
    uiStroke.Transparency = 1
    uiStroke.Parent = container
    local font = Enum.Font[featureSettings.ESPFont] or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    textLabel.TextColor3 = featureSettings.ESPTextColorMode == "Custom" and featureSettings.ESPTextColor or espColor
    textLabel.Font = font
    textLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = featureSettings.ESPTextOutlineColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    textLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
    textLabel.Parent = container
    local targetPart = getModelTargetPart(resultValue)
    local model = resultValue
    local highlight = nil
    local cartoonyBloodPuddle = nil
    if argument == "Gate" then
        local gatePartSafe = getGatePartSafe(resultValue)
        local exitLever = resultValue.Name == "ExitLever" and resultValue
            or resultValue:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)
            or resultValue:FindFirstChild("ExitLever")
        if gatePartSafe then
            targetPart = gatePartSafe
            model = exitLever and exitLever:IsA("Model") and exitLever or gatePartSafe
        end
    elseif argument == "BearTrap" then
        if resultValue:IsA("Folder") then
            model = targetPart
                or resultValue:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")
                or resultValue:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        end
    elseif argument == "Pumpkins" then
        if
            resultValue:IsA("BasePart")
            and resultValue.Parent
            and resultValue.Parent:IsA("Model")
            and resultValue.Parent ~= workspace
            and resultValue.Parent.Name ~= "Pumpkins"
        then
            model = resultValue.Parent
        end
    elseif argument == "Vault" then
        model = getVaultHighlightPart(resultValue)
    elseif argument == "Hook" then
        local parent = resultValue
        local parent2 = nil
        local model2 = nil
        while parent and parent ~= workspace do
            if parent.Name == "Hook" then
                parent2 = parent
                break
            end
            parent = parent.Parent
        end
        if not parent2 then
            if resultValue.Parent and (resultValue.Parent.Name == "Hook" or resultValue.Parent.Name == "Model") then
                parent2 = resultValue.Parent.Name == "Hook" and resultValue.Parent or resultValue.Parent.Parent
            end
        end
        if parent2 then
            cartoonyBloodPuddle = parent2:FindFirstChild("Cartoony Blood Puddle")
                or parent2:FindFirstChild("CartoonyBloodPuddle")
                or parent2:FindFirstChild("Blood Puddle")
                or parent2:FindFirstChild("BloodPuddle")
            if parent2:IsA("Model") then
                model = parent2
            else
                model2 = parent2:FindFirstChild("Model") or parent2:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")
                model = model2 or resultValue
            end
        else
            local parent3 = resultValue
            while parent3 and parent3 ~= workspace do
                if parent3.Name == "Model" and parent3:IsA("Model") then
                    model2 = parent3
                    break
                end
                parent3 = parent3.Parent
            end
            if model2 then
                model = model2
                if model2.Parent then
                    cartoonyBloodPuddle = model2.Parent:FindFirstChild("Cartoony Blood Puddle")
                end
            end
        end
        if cartoonyBloodPuddle and (model ~= parent2 or not (parent2 and parent2:IsA("Model"))) then
            highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
            highlight.FillTransparency = featureSettings.ESPFillTransparency or 0.6
            highlight.OutlineTransparency = featureSettings.ESPOutlineTransparency or 0.1
            highlight.FillColor = featureSettings.ESPFillColorMode == "Custom" and featureSettings.ESPFillColor
                or espColor
            highlight.OutlineColor = featureSettings.ESPOutlineColorMode == "Custom" and featureSettings.ESPOutlineColor
                or espColor
            highlight.Adornee = cartoonyBloodPuddle
            highlight.Enabled = false
            highlight.Parent = highlightParent
        end
    end
    resultValue3[resultValue] = {
        Highlight = boxHandleAdornment,
        PuddleHighlight = highlight,
        BloodPuddle = cartoonyBloodPuddle,
        Billboard = billboardGui,
        Container = container,
        ContainerStroke = uiStroke,
        NameLabel = textLabel,
        TargetPart = targetPart,
        TargetAdornee = model,
        CachedPosition = targetPart and targetPart.Position or Vector3.new(),
        LastAdornee = nil,
        LastAuraEnabled = nil,
        LastHighlightColor = nil,
        LastBillboardAdornee = nil,
        LastBillboardEnabled = nil,
        LastText = nil,
        LastESPStyle = nil,
        LastIsMobile = nil,
    }
end
function removeModelESP(resultValue, argument)
    local resultValue2 = mapEspDescriptors[argument]
    if not resultValue2 then
        return
    end
    local resultValue3 = resultValue2.espList()
    local resultValue4 = resultValue3[resultValue]
    if resultValue4 then
        if resultValue4.Highlight then
            pcall(function()
                resultValue4.Highlight:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        if resultValue4.PuddleHighlight then
            pcall(function()
                resultValue4.PuddleHighlight:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        if resultValue4.Billboard then
            pcall(function()
                resultValue4.Billboard:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        resultValue3[resultValue] = nil
    end
end
local disabledMapEspTypes = {}
function updateMapESP(resultValue, argument)
    local resultValue2 = mapEspDescriptors[resultValue]
    if not resultValue2 then
        return
    end
    if not featureSettings.MasterESP or not resultValue2.isEnabled() then
        if not disabledMapEspTypes[resultValue] then
            local resultValue3 = resultValue2.espList()
            for _, item in pairs(resultValue3) do
                disableMapESPData(item)
            end
            disabledMapEspTypes[resultValue] = true
        end
        return
    end
    disabledMapEspTypes[resultValue] = nil
    debug.profilebegin("Helper_UpdateMapESP_" .. tostring(resultValue))
    local resultValue3 = resultValue2.espList()
    local items = {}
    for key, _ in pairs(resultValue3) do
        if not key or not key.Parent or not key:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
            table.insert(items, key)
        end
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        pcall(function()
            removeModelESP(item, resultValue)
        end)
    end
    local espColor = getESPColor(resultValue)
    local lastESPStyle = featureSettings.ESPStyle or "Standard"
    local humanoidRootPart = cachedLocalRootPart
    if not humanoidRootPart then
        local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
        humanoidRootPart = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(argument) do
        if not item or not item.Parent then
            continue
        end
        if resultValue2.shouldSkip(item) then
            removeModelESP(item, resultValue)
            continue
        end
        createModelESP(item, resultValue)
        local resultValue4 = resultValue3[item]
        if not resultValue4 then
            continue
        end
        local color = espColor
        local cachedPosition = resultValue4.CachedPosition
        if resultValue == "Hook" then
            local cachedPosition2 = cachedPosition
            if cachedPosition2 then
                for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if player ~= localPlayer and player.Character then
                        local characterValue = player.Character
                        local matchesCondition = characterValue:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
                        if matchesCondition then
                            local humanoidRootPart2 = characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            if humanoidRootPart2 and (humanoidRootPart2.Position - cachedPosition2).Magnitude <= 15 then
                                color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 20, 20)
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        elseif resultValue == "Pallet" then
            color = espColor
        end
        local targetPart = resultValue4.TargetPart
        if not targetPart or not targetPart.Parent then
            if resultValue == "Gate" then
                targetPart = getGatePartSafe(item)
            else
                targetPart = getModelTargetPart(item)
            end
            resultValue4.TargetPart = targetPart
            if resultValue == "Gate" and targetPart then
                resultValue4.TargetAdornee = item:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)
                        and item:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true):IsA("Model")
                        and item:FindFirstChild("ExitLever", true)
                    or targetPart
            end
        end
        local cachedPosition2 = targetPart and targetPart.Position or cachedPosition
        resultValue4.CachedPosition = cachedPosition2
        local huge = humanoidRootPart
                and cachedPosition2
                and math.round((humanoidRootPart.Position - cachedPosition2).Magnitude)
            or math.huge
        local matchesCondition = huge <= featureSettings.ESPRange
        if targetPart and matchesCondition then
            local adornee = resultValue4.TargetAdornee
            if resultValue4.LastAdornee ~= adornee then
                resultValue4.Highlight.Adornee = adornee
                resultValue4.LastAdornee = adornee
                if resultValue == "Vault" and adornee and adornee:IsA("BasePart") then
                    resultValue4.Highlight.Size = adornee.Size
                    resultValue4.Highlight.CFrame = CFrame.new()
                end
            end
            if
                resultValue4.PuddleHighlight
                and resultValue4.BloodPuddle
                and resultValue4.PuddleHighlight.Adornee ~= resultValue4.BloodPuddle
            then
                resultValue4.PuddleHighlight.Adornee = resultValue4.BloodPuddle
            end
            local resultValue5 = resultValue2.showAura()
            local distanceOpacityFactor = 1
            local enabled = false
            if featureSettings.ESPDistanceFade and featureSettings.ESPDistanceFadeMap then
                if resultValue == "Generator" and featureSettings.ESPDistanceFadeGenerators then
                    enabled = true
                elseif resultValue == "Pallet" and featureSettings.ESPDistanceFadePallets then
                    enabled = true
                elseif resultValue == "Vault" and featureSettings.ESPDistanceFadeVaults then
                    enabled = true
                elseif resultValue == "Hook" and featureSettings.ESPDistanceFadeHooks then
                    enabled = true
                elseif resultValue == "Gate" and featureSettings.ESPDistanceFadeGates then
                    enabled = true
                elseif resultValue == "SCP" and featureSettings.ESPDistanceFadeSCPs then
                    enabled = true
                elseif resultValue == "BloodEffect" then
                    enabled = true
                end
            end
            if enabled and huge then
                if huge >= featureSettings.ESPFadeMax then
                    distanceOpacityFactor = 0
                elseif huge > featureSettings.ESPFadeStart then
                    local difference = featureSettings.ESPFadeMax - featureSettings.ESPFadeStart
                    local difference2 = huge - featureSettings.ESPFadeStart
                    distanceOpacityFactor = 1 - difference2 / difference
                end
            end
            resultValue4.DistanceOpacityFactor = distanceOpacityFactor
            resultValue4.LastAuraEnabled = resultValue5 and distanceOpacityFactor > 0.005
            local color3 = featureSettings.ESPFillColorMode == "Custom" and featureSettings.ESPFillColor or color
            local outlineColor = featureSettings.ESPOutlineColorMode == "Custom" and featureSettings.ESPOutlineColor
                or color
            if resultValue == "Vault" then
                if resultValue4.Highlight.Color3 ~= color3 then
                    resultValue4.Highlight.Color3 = color3
                end
            else
                if resultValue4.Highlight.FillColor ~= color3 then
                    resultValue4.Highlight.FillColor = color3

                if resultValue4.Highlight.OutlineColor ~= outlineColor then
                    resultValue4.Highlight.OutlineColor = outlineColor

            end
            if resultValue4.PuddleHighlight and resultValue4.PuddleHighlight:IsA("Highlight") then

                end

            end
            local textStrokeColor3 = featureSettings.ESPTextOutlineColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            if resultValue4.NameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 ~= textStrokeColor3 then

            end
            local font = Enum.Font[featureSettings.ESPFont] or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
            if resultValue4.NameLabel.Font ~= font then
                resultValue4.NameLabel.Font = font
            end
            local sum = 3.5 + (featureSettings.ESPPositionY or 0)
            if resultValue4.Billboard.StudsOffset.Y ~= sum then
                resultValue4.Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, sum, 0)
            end
            if resultValue4.LastESPStyle ~= lastESPStyle or resultValue4.LastIsMobile ~= isMobile then
                resultValue4.LastESPStyle = lastESPStyle
                resultValue4.LastIsMobile = isMobile
                local espTextSize = featureSettings.ESPTextSize
                if lastESPStyle == "Old" then
                    resultValue4.Billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 45)
                    resultValue4.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                    resultValue4.Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    resultValue4.ContainerStroke.Transparency = 1
                    resultValue4.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                    resultValue4.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
                    resultValue4.NameLabel.TextSize = espTextSize or 14
                elseif lastESPStyle == "Standard" then
                    resultValue4.Billboard.Size = isMobile and UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 20) or UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 26)
                    resultValue4.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                    resultValue4.Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    resultValue4.ContainerStroke.Transparency = 1
                    resultValue4.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                    resultValue4.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
                    resultValue4.NameLabel.TextSize = espTextSize or isMobile and 9 or 11
                elseif lastESPStyle == "Compact" then
                    resultValue4.Billboard.Size = isMobile and UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 16) or UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 20)
                    resultValue4.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                    resultValue4.Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    resultValue4.ContainerStroke.Transparency = 1
                    resultValue4.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                    resultValue4.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
                    resultValue4.NameLabel.TextSize = espTextSize or isMobile and 8 or 10
                elseif lastESPStyle == "Minimal" then
                    resultValue4.Billboard.Size = isMobile and UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 16) or UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 20)
                    resultValue4.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                    resultValue4.Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    resultValue4.ContainerStroke.Transparency = 1
                    resultValue4.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                    resultValue4.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
                    resultValue4.NameLabel.TextSize = espTextSize or isMobile and 8 or 10

            if lastESPStyle == "Aura Only" then

                    resultValue4.Billboard.Enabled = true
                    resultValue4.LastBillboardEnabled = true
                end
                if resultValue4.LastBillboardAdornee ~= targetPart then
                    resultValue4.Billboard.Adornee = targetPart
                    resultValue4.LastBillboardAdornee = targetPart
                end
                local text = ""
                if lastESPStyle == "Old" or lastESPStyle == "Standard" then
                    text = resultValue2.getText(item, huge)
                elseif lastESPStyle == "Compact" then
                    if resultValue == "Generator" then
                        local generatorProgress = getGeneratorProgress(item)
                        local generatorAnalytics2, _, generatorAnalytics4 = getGeneratorAnalytics(item)
                        local formattedText = ""
                        if featureSettings.GeneratorESP.ShowProgress then
                            formattedText = string.format(" %d%%", generatorProgress)
                            if
                                featureSettings.GeneratorESP.ShowRepairSpeed
                                and math.abs(generatorAnalytics2) > 0.05
                            then
                                if generatorAnalytics2 > 0 then
                                    formattedText = formattedText .. string.format(" (+%.1f%%/s)", generatorAnalytics2)

                            local playersRepairingCount = item:GetAttribute("PlayersRepairingCount") or 0
                            formattedText = string.format(" (%dp)", playersRepairingCount)
                        end
                        local noText = featureSettings.GeneratorESP.NoText and "" or "Gen"
                        if featureSettings.GeneratorESP.ShowDistance then
                            if noText == "" then
                                text = string.format("[%dm]%s", huge, formattedText)
                            else
                                text = string.format("Gen [%dm]%s", huge, formattedText)

                                    Hook = "Hook",
                                    Pallet = "Pallet",
                                    Vault = "Vault",
                                    BloodEffect = "Blood",
                                    Gate = "Gate",

                                uppercaseText = options[resultValue] or resultValue
                            end

                        if resultValue == "BloodEffect" then
                            showDistance = featureSettings.BloodESP.ShowDistance
                        elseif resultValue == "SCP" then
                            showDistance = featureSettings.SCPESP.ShowDistance
                        else
                            local resultValue2 = featureSettings[resultValue .. "ESP"]
                            showDistance = resultValue2 and resultValue2.ShowDistance
                        end

                        if
                            resultValue == "Gate"
                            and featureSettings.GateESP
                            and featureSettings.GateESP.ShowProgress
                        then

                            formattedText = string.format(" [%d%%]", gateProgress)
                        end
                        if showDistance then

                                text = string.format("[%dm]%s", huge, formattedText)
                            else
                                text = string.format("%s [%dm]%s", uppercaseText, huge, formattedText)
                            end
                        else

                        end
                    end
                elseif lastESPStyle == "Minimal" then
                    if resultValue == "Generator" then
                        local generatorProgress = getGeneratorProgress(item)
                        local formattedText = ""
                        if featureSettings.GeneratorESP.ShowProgress then
                            formattedText = string.format(" %d%%", generatorProgress)
                            if featureSettings.GeneratorESP.ShowRepairingCount then
                                local playersRepairingCount = item:GetAttribute("PlayersRepairingCount") or 0
                                formattedText = formattedText .. string.format(" (%dp)", playersRepairingCount)
                            end
                        elseif featureSettings.GeneratorESP.ShowRepairingCount then
                            local playersRepairingCount = item:GetAttribute("PlayersRepairingCount") or 0
                            formattedText = string.format(" (%dp)", playersRepairingCount)

                        if featureSettings.GeneratorESP.ShowDistance then

                    else

                        if resultValue == "BloodEffect" then

                        elseif resultValue == "SCP" then

end
function manageHighlights()
    local items = {}
    for key, data in pairs(ActiveESP.Players) do
        if data.Highlight and data.LastAuraEnabled then
            table.insert(items, {
                data = data,
                priority = 1,
                dist = getDistance(key, data.Billboard and data.Billboard.Adornee),
            })
        else
            data.TargetHighlightVisible = false
        end
    end
    local items2 = {
        ActiveESP.SCPs,
        ActiveESP.Generators,
        ActiveESP.Hooks,
        ActiveESP.Pallets,
        ActiveESP.Vaults,
        ActiveESP.BloodEffects,
        ActiveESP.Gates,
        ActiveESP.BearTraps,
        ActiveESP.Pumpkins,
    }
    for loopIndex, item in ipairs(items2) do
        local priority = 4
        if loopIndex == 1 then
            priority = 2
        elseif loopIndex == 2 or loopIndex == 7 or loopIndex == 8 then
            priority = 3
        end
        for key, data in pairs(item) do
            if data.Highlight and data.LastAuraEnabled then
                table.insert(
                    items,
                    { data = data, priority = priority, dist = getDistance(key, data.LastBillboardAdornee) }
                )
            else
                data.TargetHighlightVisible = false
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(items, function(resultValue, argument)
        if resultValue.priority ~= argument.priority then
            return resultValue.priority < argument.priority
        end
        return resultValue.dist < argument.dist
    end)
    local numberValue = 28
    for loopIndex, item in ipairs(items) do
        local targetHighlightVisible = loopIndex <= numberValue
        item.data.TargetHighlightVisible = targetHighlightVisible
        if (featureSettings.ESPFadeDuration or 0.2) <= 0.01 then
            if item.data.Highlight:IsA("Highlight") then
                if item.data.Highlight.Enabled ~= targetHighlightVisible then
                    item.data.Highlight.Enabled = targetHighlightVisible
                end
            elseif item.data.Highlight:IsA("BoxHandleAdornment") then
                if item.data.Highlight.Visible ~= targetHighlightVisible then
                    item.data.Highlight.Visible = targetHighlightVisible
                end
            end
            if item.data.PuddleHighlight and item.data.PuddleHighlight:IsA("Highlight") then
                if item.data.PuddleHighlight.Enabled ~= targetHighlightVisible then
                    item.data.PuddleHighlight.Enabled = targetHighlightVisible
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
local mapEspGroups = nil
function updateESPFadeTransitions(resultValue)
    if not featureSettings.MasterESP then
        return
    end
    local performanceMode = featureSettings.PerformanceMode
    local espFadeDuration = performanceMode and 0 or featureSettings.ESPFadeDuration or 0.2
    local performanceMode2 = performanceMode or espFadeDuration <= 0.01
    local lastFadeFill = featureSettings.ESPFillTransparency or 0.6
    local lastFadeOutline = featureSettings.ESPOutlineTransparency or 0.1
    local function handleAction(resultValue2, argument)
        if not resultValue2 or not resultValue2.Highlight then
            return
        end
        local currentAlpha = 0
        if resultValue2.TargetHighlightVisible ~= false and resultValue2.LastAuraEnabled then
            currentAlpha = resultValue2.DistanceOpacityFactor or 1
        end
        if resultValue2.CurrentAlpha == nil then
            resultValue2.CurrentAlpha = currentAlpha
        elseif performanceMode2 then
            resultValue2.CurrentAlpha = currentAlpha
        else
            local ratio = resultValue / espFadeDuration
            if resultValue2.CurrentAlpha < currentAlpha then
                resultValue2.CurrentAlpha = math.min(currentAlpha, resultValue2.CurrentAlpha + ratio)
            elseif resultValue2.CurrentAlpha > currentAlpha then
                resultValue2.CurrentAlpha = math.max(currentAlpha, resultValue2.CurrentAlpha - ratio)
            end
        end
        local lastFadeAlpha = resultValue2.CurrentAlpha
        local lastFadeVis = lastFadeAlpha > 0.005
        if
            resultValue2.LastFadeAlpha == lastFadeAlpha
            and resultValue2.LastFadeFill == lastFadeFill
            and resultValue2.LastFadeOutline == lastFadeOutline
            and resultValue2.LastFadeVis == lastFadeVis
        then
            return
        end
        resultValue2.LastFadeAlpha = lastFadeAlpha
        resultValue2.LastFadeFill = lastFadeFill
        resultValue2.LastFadeOutline = lastFadeOutline
        resultValue2.LastFadeVis = lastFadeVis
        if argument then
            if resultValue2.Highlight:IsA("BoxHandleAdornment") then
                if resultValue2.Highlight.Visible ~= lastFadeVis then
                    resultValue2.Highlight.Visible = lastFadeVis
                end
                if lastFadeVis then
                    resultValue2.Highlight.Transparency = 1 - (1 - lastFadeFill) * lastFadeAlpha
                end
            end
        else
            if resultValue2.Highlight:IsA("Highlight") then
                if resultValue2.Highlight.Enabled ~= lastFadeVis then
                    resultValue2.Highlight.Enabled = lastFadeVis
                end
                if lastFadeVis then
                    resultValue2.Highlight.FillTransparency = 1 - (1 - lastFadeFill) * lastFadeAlpha
                    resultValue2.Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 1 - (1 - lastFadeOutline) * lastFadeAlpha
                end
            end
            if resultValue2.PuddleHighlight and resultValue2.PuddleHighlight:IsA("Highlight") then
                if resultValue2.PuddleHighlight.Enabled ~= lastFadeVis then
                    resultValue2.PuddleHighlight.Enabled = lastFadeVis
                end
                if lastFadeVis then
                    resultValue2.PuddleHighlight.FillTransparency = 1 - (1 - lastFadeFill) * lastFadeAlpha
                    resultValue2.PuddleHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 1 - (1 - lastFadeOutline) * lastFadeAlpha
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, player in pairs(ActiveESP.Players) do
        handleAction(player, false)
    end
    if not mapEspGroups then
        mapEspGroups = {
            ActiveESP.Generators,
            ActiveESP.Hooks,
            ActiveESP.Pallets,
            ActiveESP.BloodEffects,
            ActiveESP.Gates,
            ActiveESP.SCPs,
            ActiveESP.BearTraps,
            ActiveESP.Pumpkins,
        }
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(mapEspGroups) do
        for _, item2 in pairs(item) do
            handleAction(item2, false)
        end
    end
    for _, vault in pairs(ActiveESP.Vaults) do
        handleAction(vault, true)
    end
end

    pcall(function()
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("BlatantAimbotLock")
    end)
    pcall(function()
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("VD_AimAssist")

            _G.VD_FovCircle:Remove()
        end)
    end
    if _G.VD_FovGui then
        pcall(function()
            _G.VD_FovGui:Destroy()
        end)
    end
    if _G.VD_CrosshairGui then
        pcall(function()
            _G.VD_CrosshairGui:Destroy()
        end)

    end
    for key, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.Players) do
        removePlayerESP(key)
    end

        removeModelESP(key, "Generator")
    end
    for key, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.SCPs) do
        removeModelESP(key, "SCP")
    end
    for key, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.Hooks) do
        removeModelESP(key, "Hook")
    end
    for key, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.Pallets) do
        removeModelESP(key, "Pallet")
    end
    for key, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.Vaults) do
        removeModelESP(key, "Vault")
    end
    for key, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.BloodEffects) do
        removeModelESP(key, "BloodEffect")
    end

        removeModelESP(key, "Gate")
    end

    end

            _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment:Destroy()
