        if _G.VD_SpearSilentAimFOVCircle then
            pcall(function()
                _G.VD_SpearSilentAimFOVCircle.Visible = false
            end)
            pcall(function()
                _G.VD_SpearSilentAimFOVCircle:Remove()
            end)
            _G.VD_SpearSilentAimFOVCircle = nil
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if _G.VD_RevolverSilentAimFOVCircle then
            pcall(function()
                _G.VD_RevolverSilentAimFOVCircle.Visible = false
            end)
            pcall(function()
                _G.VD_RevolverSilentAimFOVCircle:Remove()
            end)
            _G.VD_RevolverSilentAimFOVCircle = nil
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if _G.VD_SilentAimHighlight then
            pcall(function()
                _G.VD_SilentAimHighlight:Destroy()
            end)
            _G.VD_SilentAimHighlight = nil
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if cleanupKillerGroundFOV then
            cleanupKillerGroundFOV()
        end
        local vdKillerGroundFOV = workspace:FindFirstChild("VD_KillerGroundFOV")
        if vdKillerGroundFOV then
            pcall(function()
                vdKillerGroundFOV:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if workspace:FindFirstChild("VeilSquareHolder") then
            workspace.VeilSquareHolder:Destroy()
        end
        if workspace:FindFirstChild("VD_SpearTrajectory") then
            workspace.VD_SpearTrajectory:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

currentThemeName = "Default"

function applyTheme(resultValue)
    currentThemeName = resultValue or "Default"
    local default = themes[currentThemeName] or themes.Default
    local bg = UI.Bg
    local sidebar = UI.Sidebar
    local card = UI.Card
    local elevated = UI.Elevated
    local stroke = UI.Stroke
    local strokeDim = UI.StrokeDim
    local accent = UI.Accent
    local accentCyan = UI.AccentCyan
    local accentGreen = UI.AccentGreen
    local accentRed = UI.AccentRed
    UI.Bg = default.Bg
    UI.Sidebar = default.Sidebar
    UI.Card = default.Card
    UI.Elevated = default.Elevated
    UI.Stroke = default.Stroke
    UI.StrokeDim = default.StrokeDim
    UI.Accent = default.Accent
    UI.AccentCyan = default.AccentCyan
    UI.AccentGreen = default.AccentGreen
    UI.AccentRed = default.AccentRed
    if not mainFrame then
        return
    end
    mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Bg
    local premiumAvailable = featureSettings.CustomBackground
        and featureSettings.CustomBackground.Enabled
        and hasPremiumAccess()
        and premiumCapabilities
        and (premiumCapabilities.CustomBackground or premiumCapabilities["Custom Background"])
    mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = premiumAvailable and 1 or default.BgTrans
    _G.VD_MainStroke = mainFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if _G.VD_MainStroke then
        _G.VD_MainStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
        _G.VD_MainStroke.Thickness = 1
    end
    local sidebar2 = mainFrame:FindFirstChild("Sidebar")
    if sidebar2 then
        sidebar2.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Sidebar
        sidebar2.BackgroundTransparency = premiumAvailable and 0.85 or default.BgTrans
        local uiStroke = sidebar2:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if uiStroke then
            uiStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
        end
    end
    for _, descendant in ipairs(screenGui:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("GuiObject") then
            if
                descendant.Name == "VD_CustomBg"
                or descendant.Name == "VD_BgOverlay"
                or customBackgroundImage and descendant == customBackgroundImage
                or customBackgroundOverlay and descendant == customBackgroundOverlay
            then
                if
                    descendant.Name == "VD_CustomBg"
                    or customBackgroundImage and descendant == customBackgroundImage
                then
                    pcall(function()
                        descendant.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    end)
                end
                continue
            end
            local name = descendant.Name
            local lowercaseText = name:lower()
            local image = name == "LogoImage"
                or lowercaseText:find("logo") ~= nil
                or name == "TitleLogo"
                or name == "HomeHeaderAvatar"
                or name == "WelcomeBackAvatar"
                or lowercaseText:find("avatar") ~= nil
                or lowercaseText:find("portrait") ~= nil
                or lowercaseText:find("survivor") ~= nil
                or descendant:IsA("ImageLabel")
                    and descendant.Image
                    and (descendant.Image:find("rbxthumb://") ~= nil or descendant.Image:find("roblox.com") ~= nil or descendant.Image:find(
                        "dbd_hud_"
                    ) ~= nil or descendant.Image:find("VD_Logo") ~= nil)
            if image then
                if descendant:IsA("ImageLabel") or descendant:IsA("ImageButton") then
                    descendant.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                elseif descendant:IsA("TextLabel") and name == "TitleLogo" then
                    descendant.TextColor3 = UI.Text
                end
                local uiStroke = descendant:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if uiStroke then
                    uiStroke.Color = UI.Accent
                end
                continue
            end
            if descendant.BackgroundColor3 == bg then
                descendant.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Bg
            elseif descendant.BackgroundColor3 == sidebar then
                descendant.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Sidebar
            elseif descendant.BackgroundColor3 == card then
                descendant.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
            elseif descendant.BackgroundColor3 == elevated then
                descendant.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
            elseif descendant.BackgroundColor3 == accent then
                descendant.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Accent
            elseif descendant.BackgroundColor3 == accentCyan then
                descendant.BackgroundColor3 = UI.AccentCyan
            elseif descendant.BackgroundColor3 == accentGreen then
                descendant.BackgroundColor3 = UI.AccentGreen
            elseif descendant.BackgroundColor3 == accentRed then
                descendant.BackgroundColor3 = UI.AccentRed
            elseif descendant.BackgroundColor3 == stroke then
                descendant.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Stroke
            elseif descendant.BackgroundColor3 == strokeDim then
                descendant.BackgroundColor3 = UI.StrokeDim
            end
            if descendant:IsA("ImageLabel") or descendant:IsA("ImageButton") then
                local parent = name == "TabIcon"
                    or name == "Icon"
                    or name == "SearchIcon"
                    or name:find("Chevron") ~= nil
                    or name:find("Check") ~= nil
                    or descendant.Parent
                        and (descendant.Parent.Name:find("TabBtn") ~= nil or descendant.Parent.Name:find("Toggle") ~= nil or descendant.Parent.Name:find(
                            "Selector"
                        ) ~= nil or descendant.Parent.Name:find("Slider") ~= nil)
                if parent then
                    if descendant.ImageColor3 == accent then
                        descendant.ImageColor3 = UI.Accent
                    elseif descendant.ImageColor3 == accentCyan then
                        descendant.ImageColor3 = UI.AccentCyan
                    elseif descendant.ImageColor3 == stroke then
                        descendant.ImageColor3 = UI.Stroke
                    elseif descendant.ImageColor3 == strokeDim then
                        descendant.ImageColor3 = UI.StrokeDim
                    end
                end
            end
            if descendant:IsA("TextLabel") or descendant:IsA("TextBox") or descendant:IsA("TextButton") then
                local parent = descendant:GetAttribute("ThemeAccentText") == true
                    or name == "PopupTitle"
                    or name == "GetKeyBtn"
                    or descendant.Parent and descendant.Parent.Name == "HeaderBanner"
                    or descendant.Parent and descendant.Parent.Name:find("MobileFloating_") ~= nil
                if parent then
                    if descendant.TextColor3 == accent then
                        descendant.TextColor3 = UI.Accent
                    elseif descendant.TextColor3 == accentCyan then
                        descendant.TextColor3 = UI.AccentCyan
                    elseif descendant.TextColor3 == accentGreen then
                        descendant.TextColor3 = UI.AccentGreen
                    end
                elseif descendant.TextColor3 == accentCyan then
                    descendant.TextColor3 = UI.AccentCyan
                elseif descendant.TextColor3 == accentGreen then
                    descendant.TextColor3 = UI.AccentGreen
                end
            end
            local uiStroke = descendant:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            if uiStroke then
                if uiStroke.Color == stroke then
                    uiStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
                elseif uiStroke.Color == strokeDim then
                    uiStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
                elseif uiStroke.Color == accent then
                    uiStroke.Color = UI.Accent
                end
            end
            if descendant.Name == "SectionLine" then
                descendant.BackgroundColor3 = UI.StrokeDim
            end
        end
    end
    if searchBarContainer then
        searchBarContainer.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
    end
    if searchStroke then
        searchStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
    end
    if searchIconLbl then
        pcall(function()
            if searchIconLbl:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                searchIconLbl.ImageColor3 = UI.TextSub
            else
                searchIconLbl.TextColor3 = UI.Accent
            end
        end)
    end
    if searchBox then
        searchBox.TextColor3 = UI.Text
        searchBox.PlaceholderColor3 = UI.Muted
    end
    if clearSearchBtn then
        clearSearchBtn.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
    end
    if searchBox and searchBox.Text ~= "" and updateSearchResults then
        local lowercaseText = searchBox.Text:gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", ""):lower()
        if #lowercaseText > 0 then
            pcall(updateSearchResults, lowercaseText)
        end
    end
    if applyCustomBackground then
        pcall(applyCustomBackground)
    elseif _G.VD_ApplyCustomBg then
        pcall(_G.VD_ApplyCustomBg)
    end
end
local mobileButtonPositions = {}
local function getActionToggleState(actionName)
    if not actionName or actionName == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local text = tostring(actionName):lower():gsub("%s+", "")
    if text == "togglespeedboost" or text == "speedboost" then
        return featureSettings.SpeedBoostEnabled == true
    elseif text == "noturnspeedloss" or text == "preserveturnspeed" then
        return featureSettings.NoTurnSpeedLoss == true
    elseif text == "automoonwalk" or text == "moonwalk" then
        return featureSettings.AutoMoonwalk == true
    elseif text == "noclipvaultspallets" or text == "noclip" then
        return featureSettings.NoclipVaultsPallets == true
    elseif text == "autofleekiller" or text == "autoflee" then
        return featureSettings.AutoFleeKiller == true
    elseif text == "alwaysfastvault" or text == "fastvault" then
        return featureSettings.AlwaysFastVault == true
    elseif text == "fakevault" then
        return featureSettings.FakeVault == true
    elseif text == "instantheal" then
        return featureSettings.InstantHeal == true
    elseif text == "autoparry" then
        return featureSettings.AutoParry == true
    elseif text == "frenzyparry" then
        return featureSettings.FrenzyParry == true
    elseif text == "revolverautofarm" then
        return featureSettings.RevolverAutofarm == true
    elseif text == "revolveraimbot" or text == "aimbot" then
        return (featureSettings.RevolverAimbot and featureSettings.RevolverAimbot.Enabled) == true
    elseif text == "flowstateperk" or text == "flowstate" then
        return featureSettings.FlowstatePerk == true
    elseif text == "simulatequickrecovery" or text == "quickrecovery" then
        return featureSettings.SimulateQuickRecovery == true
    elseif text == "simulateperfectlanding" or text == "perfectlanding" then
        return featureSettings.SimulatePerfectLanding == true
    elseif text == "activefeaturesoverlay" or text == "activefeatures" then
        return featureSettings.ShowActiveFeatures == true
    elseif text == "spectatorlist" or text == "spectators" then
        return featureSettings.ShowSpectatorList == true
    elseif text == "nofog" then
        return featureSettings.NoFog == true
    elseif text == "dofremoval" or text == "removedof" then
        return featureSettings.RemoveDOF == true
    elseif text == "fullbright" then
        return featureSettings.FullBright == true
    elseif text == "noskillchecks" then
        return featureSettings.NoSkillChecks == true
    elseif text == "rainbowcharacter" or text == "rainbow" then
        return featureSettings.RainbowCharacter == true
    elseif text == "fakelag" then
        return featureSettings.FakeLag == true
    elseif text == "desync" then
        return featureSettings.Desync == true
    elseif text == "blockvaultpalletinteraction" or text == "blockvaults" or text == "blockpallets" then
        return featureSettings.BlockVaultPalletInteraction == true
    elseif featureSettings[actionName] ~= nil and type(featureSettings[actionName]) == "boolean" then
        return featureSettings[actionName] == true
    end
    for key, item in pairs(featureSettings) do
        if type(item) == "boolean" then
            local text2 = key:lower():gsub("%s+", "")
            if text2 == text then
                return item == true
            end
        elseif type(item) == "table" and item.Enabled ~= nil then
            local text2 = key:lower():gsub("%s+", "")
            if text2 == text or text2 .. "esp" == text or text2 .. "track" == text then
                return item.Enabled == true
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
function createOrUpdateMobileFloatingButton(resultValue, argument)
    if not isMobile then
        return
    end
    local playerGui = guiParent or localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if not playerGui then
        return
    end
    local vdMobileHUD = playerGui:FindFirstChild("VD_MobileHUD")
    if not vdMobileHUD or not vdMobileHUD.Parent then
        if vdMobileHUD then
            pcall(function()
                vdMobileHUD:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        vdMobileHUD = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        vdMobileHUD.Name = "VD_MobileHUD"
        vdMobileHUD.ResetOnSpawn = false
        vdMobileHUD.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        vdMobileHUD.DisplayOrder = 99997
        pcall(function()
            vdMobileHUD.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        end)
        vdMobileHUD.Parent = playerGui
    end
    local resultValue2 = mobileFloatingButtons[resultValue]
    local position = mobileButtonPositions[resultValue]
    if
        not position
        and featureSettings.MobileButtonPositions
        and featureSettings.MobileButtonPositions[resultValue]
    then
        local resultValue3 = featureSettings.MobileButtonPositions[resultValue]
        if resultValue3 and resultValue3.XScale and resultValue3.YScale then
            position = UDim2.new(
                resultValue3.XScale,
                resultValue3.XOffset or 0,
                resultValue3.YScale,
                resultValue3.YOffset or 0
            )
            mobileButtonPositions[resultValue] = position
        end
    end
    if not position then
        local sum = 0
        for _ in pairs(mobileFloatingButtons) do
            sum = sum + 1
        end
        local sum2 = 0.22 + sum * 0.12
        if sum2 > 0.75 then
            sum2 = 0.22
        end
        position = UDim2.new(0.85, -20, sum2, 0)
    end
    local actionEnabled = getActionToggleState(resultValue)
    local backgroundColor = UI.Bg
    local backgroundTransparency = 0.25
    local textColor = UI.Accent
    local color = UI.Stroke
    local thickness = 1
    if actionEnabled == true then
        backgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(18, 48, 28)
        backgroundTransparency = 0.2
        textColor = Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128)
        color = Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94)
        thickness = 1.4
    elseif actionEnabled == false then
        backgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(42, 16, 20)
        backgroundTransparency = 0.35
        textColor = Color3.fromRGB(248, 113, 113)
        color = Color3.fromRGB(225, 29, 72)
        thickness = 1
    end
    local textButton = resultValue2
    if not textButton or not textButton.Parent then
        textButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
        textButton.Name = "MobileFloating_" .. resultValue
        textButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 42)
        textButton.Position = position
        textButton.ZIndex = 998
        textButton.Parent = vdMobileHUD
        Instance.new("UICorner", textButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
        local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", textButton)
        uiStroke.Thickness = thickness
        local position2, position3 = nil, nil
        local enabled = false
        local input = nil
        registerConnection(textButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input2)
            if
                input2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                or input2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            then
                position2 = input2.Position
                position3 = textButton.Position
                enabled = false
                local connection
                connection = input2.Changed:Connect(function()
                    if input2.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                        position2 = nil
                        input = nil
                        if connection then
                            connection:Disconnect()
                        end
                        if enabled then
                            mobileButtonPositions[resultValue] = textButton.Position
                            if not featureSettings.MobileButtonPositions then
                                featureSettings.MobileButtonPositions = {}
                            end
                            featureSettings.MobileButtonPositions[resultValue] = {
                                XScale = textButton.Position.X.Scale,
                                XOffset = textButton.Position.X.Offset,
                                YScale = textButton.Position.Y.Scale,
                                YOffset = textButton.Position.Y.Offset,
                            }
                            pcall(saveSettings)
                        else
                            local resultValue2 = hotkeyActions[resultValue]
                            if resultValue2 then
                                TweenService:Create(textButton, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 38) })
                                    :Play()
                                task.delay(0.1, function()
                                    if textButton and textButton.Parent then
                                        TweenService
                                            :Create(textButton, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 42) })
                                            :Play()
                                    end
                                end)
                                resultValue2()
                                task.delay(0.05, function()
                                    if rebuildMobileButtons then
                                        pcall(rebuildMobileButtons)
                                    end
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end))
        registerConnection(textButton.InputChanged:Connect(function(input2)
            if
                input2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                or input2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            then
                input = input2
            end
        end))
        registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(resultValue2)
            if resultValue2 == input and position2 then
                local vectorValue = resultValue2.Position - position2
                if vectorValue.Magnitude > 5 then
                    enabled = true
                end
                textButton.Position = UDim2.new(
                    position3.X.Scale,
                    position3.X.Offset + vectorValue.X,
                    position3.Y.Scale,
                    position3.Y.Offset + vectorValue.Y
                )
            end
        end))
        mobileFloatingButtons[resultValue] = textButton
    end
    textButton.Text = argument:upper()
    textButton.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor
    textButton.BackgroundTransparency = backgroundTransparency
    textButton.TextColor3 = textColor
    local uiStroke = textButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if uiStroke then
        uiStroke.Color = color
        uiStroke.Thickness = thickness
    end
end

function cleanupParryUI()
    pcall(function()
        local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if not playerGui then
            return
        end
        for _, childName in ipairs({ "Survivor", "Survivor-con" }) do
            local child = playerGui:FindFirstChild(childName)
            if child then
                local bottomLeft = child:FindFirstChild("bottom left") or child:FindFirstChild("BottomLeft") or child
                local gen = bottomLeft:FindFirstChild("Gen") or child:FindFirstChild("Gen", true)
                local itemFrame = gen and gen:FindFirstChild("ItemFrame")
                if itemFrame then
                    local gui = itemFrame:FindFirstChild("Gui")
                    if gui then
                        local parryCooldownLabel = gui:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel")
                        if parryCooldownLabel then
                            pcall(function()
                                parryCooldownLabel:Destroy()
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    local parryCooldownLabel = itemFrame:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel")
                    if parryCooldownLabel then
                        pcall(function()
                            parryCooldownLabel:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local survivorMob = playerGui:FindFirstChild("Survivor-mob")
        local controls = survivorMob and survivorMob:FindFirstChild("Controls")
        if controls then
            local parryCooldownLabel = controls:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel")
            if parryCooldownLabel then
                pcall(function()
                    parryCooldownLabel:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            local guiMob = controls:FindFirstChild("Gui-mob")
            if guiMob and guiMob:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel") then
                pcall(function()
                    guiMob.ParryCooldownLabel:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            local action = controls:FindFirstChild("action")
            if action and action:FindFirstChild("ParryCooldownLabel") then
                pcall(function()
                    action.ParryCooldownLabel:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
end
do
    local items = {}
    local items2 = {}
    local numberValue = 4
    local numberValue2 = 6
    local isMobile2 = isMobile and 14 or 56
    local isMobile3 = isMobile and 12 or 18
    local isMobile4 = isMobile and 210 or 250
    local function handleAction()
        local targetY = isMobile2
        for _, item in ipairs(items2) do
            item.targetY = targetY
            if item.frame and item.frame.Parent then
                TweenService:Create(
                    item.frame,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.24, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    { Position = UDim2.new(0, isMobile3, 0, targetY) }
                ):Play()
            end
            targetY = targetY + (item.height or 46) + numberValue2
        end
    end
    local handleAction2
    handleAction2 = function()
        if #items2 >= numberValue or #items == 0 then
            return
        end
        local resultValue = table.remove(items, 1)
        local count = #items
        local numberValue3 = 3
        if count > 0 then
            numberValue3 = math.max(1.2, 3 - count * 0.4)
        end
        local lowercaseText = tostring(resultValue.notifType or "info"):lower()

        local imageColor = UI.Text
        local color = UI.Stroke
        if lowercaseText == "warning" or lowercaseText == "warn" then
            imageColor = UI.Warning
            color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 40, 20)
        elseif lowercaseText == "error" or lowercaseText == "danger" then
            imageColor = UI.Danger
            color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 24, 28)
        elseif lowercaseText == "success" then
            imageColor = UI.Success
            color = Color3.fromRGB(24, 52, 32)
        else
            imageColor = UI.AccentCyan
            color = UI.Stroke
        end
        local playerGui = screenGui
            or localPlayer
                and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
                and localPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("JLXHelperGui")
        if not playerGui then
            return
        end
        local function handleAction3(resultValue2)
            if not resultValue2 then
                return ""
            end
            local text2 = tostring(resultValue2)
            text2 = text2
                :gsub("", "")
                :gsub("", "")
                :gsub("⚡", "")
                :gsub("⏻", "")
                :gsub("👥", "")
                :gsub("📩", "")
                :gsub("⚔️", "")
                :gsub("⚔", "")
                :gsub("▶", "")
                :gsub("◐", "")
                :gsub("📄", "")
                :gsub("◎", "")
            text2 = text2:gsub("[%z\001-\127\194-\244][\128-\191]*", function(resultValue3)
                local resultValue2 = string.byte(resultValue3, 1)
                if resultValue2 >= 240 then
                    return ""
                end
                return resultValue3
            end)
            text2 = text2:gsub("%s+", " "):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
            return text2
        end
        local text2 = handleAction3(resultValue.title or "Warning")
        local resultValue2 = handleAction3(resultValue.message or "")
        local text3 = resultValue2
        if not text3:find("<font") then
            text3 = text3:gsub("ADMIN", "<font color='#ef4444'><b>ADMIN</b></font>")
            text3 = text3:gsub("MODERATOR", "<font color='#3b82f6'><b>MODERATOR</b></font>")
            text3 = text3:gsub("ENABLED", "<font color='#22c55e'><b>ENABLED</b></font>")
            text3 = text3:gsub("DISABLED", "<font color='#ef4444'><b>DISABLED</b></font>")
            text3 = text3:gsub("Vanish", "<font color='#888899'>Vanish</font>")
            text3 = text3:gsub("Near", "<font color='#22c55e'>Near</font>")
            text3 = text3:gsub("Spec", "<font color='#38bdf8'>Spec</font>")
        end
        local targetY = isMobile2
        for _, item in ipairs(items2) do
            targetY = targetY + (item.height or 46) + numberValue2
        end
        local matchIndex = (#resultValue2 > 35 or resultValue2:find("\n")) and 54 or 46
        local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        frame.Name = "VD_Notif_" .. tostring(tick())
        frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, isMobile4, 0, matchIndex)
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, -isMobile4 - 20, 0, targetY)
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 16, 21)
        frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
        frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        frame.ZIndex = 5000
        frame.Parent = playerGui
        Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
        uiStroke.Color = color
        uiStroke.Thickness = 1
        local options = {
            warning = "rbxassetid://7733658504",
            warn = "rbxassetid://7733658504",
            error = "rbxassetid://7743878496",
            danger = "rbxassetid://7743878496",
            success = "rbxassetid://7733715400",
            info = "rbxassetid://7733964719",
        }
        local imageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        imageLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14)
        imageLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 7)
        imageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        imageLabel.Image = options[lowercaseText] or "rbxassetid://7733964719"
        imageLabel.ImageColor3 = imageColor
        imageLabel.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
        imageLabel.ZIndex = 5001
        imageLabel.Parent = frame
        local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 16)
        textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 6)
        textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        textLabel.Text = text2
        textLabel.TextColor3 = UI.Text
        textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        textLabel.TextSize = 11.5
        textLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        textLabel.ZIndex = 5001
        textLabel.Parent = frame
        local textLabel2 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        textLabel2.RichText = true
        textLabel2.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, matchIndex - 24)
        textLabel2.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 22)
        textLabel2.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        textLabel2.Text = text3
        textLabel2.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
        textLabel2.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        textLabel2.TextSize = 11
        textLabel2.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        textLabel2.TextWrapped = true
        textLabel2.ZIndex = 5001
        textLabel2.Parent = frame
        local options2 = { frame = frame, height = matchIndex, targetY = targetY }
        table.insert(items2, options2)
        TweenService:Create(
            frame,
            TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Position = UDim2.new(0, isMobile3, 0, targetY) }
        ):Play()
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(numberValue3)
            if frame and frame.Parent then
                local targetY2 = options2.targetY or targetY
                TweenService
                    :Create(
                        frame,
                        TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                        { Position = UDim2.new(0, -isMobile4 - 30, 0, targetY2), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }
                    )
                    :Play()
                task.wait(0.2)
                pcall(function()
                    frame:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            for loopIndex, item in ipairs(items2) do
                if item == options2 then
                    table.remove(items2, loopIndex)
                    break
                end
            end
            handleAction()
            handleAction2()
        end)
    end
    function clearAllNotifications()
        table.clear(items)
        for loopIndex = #items2, 1, -1 do
            local resultValue = items2[loopIndex]
            if resultValue and resultValue.frame then
                pcall(function()
                    resultValue.frame:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end
        table.clear(items2)
    end
    function showNotification(title, message, notificationType)
        if featureSettings.DisableAllNotifications then
            clearAllNotifications()
            return
        end
        table.insert(items, { title = title, message = message, notifType = notificationType or "info" })
        while #items2 < numberValue and #items > 0 do
            handleAction2()
        end
    end
end
function showStartupCapabilityReport()
    local unavailableFeatures = getUnavailableFeatures()
    if #unavailableFeatures == 0 then
        showNotification("Compatibility Check", "All features supported on " .. getExecutorName() .. ".", "success")
        return
    end
    local combinedText = table.concat(unavailableFeatures, ", ")
    if #combinedText > 90 then
        combinedText = combinedText:sub(1, 87) .. "..."
    end
    showNotification(
        "Compatibility Warning",
        #unavailableFeatures .. " feature group(s) may not work: " .. combinedText,
        "warning"
    )
end

local savedMouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
local savedMouseIconEnabled = false
local mouseStateCaptured = false
local uiVisible = not isMobile
local function captureMouseState()
    pcall(function()
        if not uiVisible then
            savedMouseBehavior = UserInputService.MouseBehavior
            savedMouseIconEnabled = UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled
            mouseStateCaptured = true
        end
    end)
end
local function restoreMouseState()
    pcall(function()
        if isMobile or UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
            UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
            return
        end
        if mouseStateCaptured then
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior = savedMouseBehavior
            UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = savedMouseIconEnabled
        else
            local matchesCondition = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") ~= nil
            if matchesCondition then
                UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
                UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
            else
                UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
                UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
            end
        end
    end)
end

function findEmoteByName(resultValue)
    if not resultValue then
        return nil
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(allEmotesList or {}) do
        if item.name == resultValue or item.name:lower() == resultValue:lower() then
            return item
        end
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(featureSettings.UserCustomEmotes or {}) do
        if item.name == resultValue or item.name:lower() == resultValue:lower() then
            return item
        end
    end
    return nil
end
function getFullEmoteList()
    local items = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(allEmotesList or {}) do
        table.insert(items, item)
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(featureSettings.UserCustomEmotes or {}) do
        table.insert(items, item)
    end
    return items
end

applyCustomBackground = function()
    local sidebar = mainFrame:FindFirstChild("Sidebar")
    local premiumAvailable = hasPremiumAccess()
        and premiumCapabilities
        and (premiumCapabilities.CustomBackground or premiumCapabilities["Custom Background"])
        and featureSettings.CustomBackground
        and featureSettings.CustomBackground.Enabled
    if not premiumAvailable then
        customBackgroundImage.Visible = false
        customBackgroundOverlay.Visible = false
        mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Bg
        mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = themes and themes[currentThemeName] and themes[currentThemeName].BgTrans
            or 0.02
        if sidebar then
            sidebar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
        end
        return
    end
    local customBackground = featureSettings.CustomBackground
    local image = ""
    if customBackground.LocalFile and customBackground.LocalFile ~= "" then
        local getLocalAsset2 = writefile and readfile and isfile and getLocalAsset
        if getLocalAsset2 then
            local succeeded, result = pcall(getLocalAsset, customBackground.LocalFile)
            if succeeded and result and result ~= "" then
                image = result
            end
        end
    end
    if image == "" and customBackground.AssetId and customBackground.AssetId ~= "" then
        local assetId = customBackground.AssetId
        if not assetId:match("^rbxassetid://") then
            assetId = "rbxassetid://" .. (assetId:match("%d+") or "")
        end
        image = assetId
    end
    if image == "" then
        customBackgroundImage.Visible = false
        customBackgroundOverlay.Visible = false
        mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Bg
        mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = themes and themes[currentThemeName] and themes[currentThemeName].BgTrans
            or 0.02
        if sidebar then
            sidebar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
        end
        return
    end
    customBackgroundImage.Image = image
    customBackgroundImage.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    if customBackground.ScaleType then
        local scaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
        if customBackground.ScaleType == "Stretch" then
            scaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
        elseif customBackground.ScaleType == "Fit" then
            scaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
        end
        customBackgroundImage.ScaleType = scaleType
    end
    customBackgroundImage.Visible = true
    local clampedValue = math.clamp((customBackground.Overlay or 40) / 100, 0, 0.7)
    customBackgroundOverlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    customBackgroundOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clampedValue
    customBackgroundOverlay.Visible = clampedValue > 0
    mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    if sidebar then
        sidebar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.85
    end
end
_G.VD_ApplyCustomBg = applyCustomBackground

searchBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local text = searchBox.Text
    local text2 = text:gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
    if #text2 == 0 then
        TweenService:Create(searchStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Color = UI.StrokeDim, Thickness = 0.85 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(searchBarContainer, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(searchIconLbl, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { ImageTransparency = 0.3, ImageColor3 = UI.TextSub })
            :Play()
    end
end)
searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    local text = searchBox.Text
    local lowercaseText = text:gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1"):lower()
    if #lowercaseText == 0 then
        clearSearchBtn.Visible = false
        if searchContainer and searchContainer.Visible then
            searchContainer.Visible = false
            if activeTab and tabContainers[activeTab] then
                tabContainers[activeTab].Visible = true
                tabContainers[activeTab].GroupTransparency = 0
            end
        end
    else
        clearSearchBtn.Visible = true
        for _, guiObject in pairs(tabContainers) do
            guiObject.Visible = false
        end
        if searchContainer then
            searchContainer.Visible = true
            searchContainer.GroupTransparency = 0
        end
        if updateSearchResults then
            updateSearchResults(lowercaseText)
        end
    end
end)
clearSearchBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    searchBox.Text = ""
    searchBox:ReleaseFocus()
    clearSearchBtn.Visible = false
    if searchContainer then
        searchContainer.Visible = false
    end
    if activeTab and tabContainers[activeTab] then
        tabContainers[activeTab].Visible = true
        tabContainers[activeTab].GroupTransparency = 0
    end
end)
registerConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, _)
    if isBindingKey then
        return
    end
    if
        input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F
        and (
            UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
            or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)
        )
    then
        if mainFrame and mainFrame.Visible and searchBox then
            searchBox:CaptureFocus()
            searchBox.SelectionStart = 1
            searchBox.CursorPosition = #searchBox.Text + 1
        end
        return
    end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
        if
            searchBox
            and (searchBox:IsFocused() or searchBox.Text ~= "" and searchContainer and searchContainer.Visible)
        then
            searchBox.Text = ""
            searchBox:ReleaseFocus()
            if clearSearchBtn then
                clearSearchBtn.Visible = false
            end
            if searchContainer then
                searchContainer.Visible = false
            end
            if activeTab and tabContainers[activeTab] then
                tabContainers[activeTab].Visible = true
                tabContainers[activeTab].GroupTransparency = 0
            end
        end
    end
end))

tabButtons = {}
tabContainers = {}
tabHeaderTitles = {}
activeTab = nil
function switchTab(resultValue)
    if activeTab == resultValue and (not searchContainer or not searchContainer.Visible) then
        if tabContainers and tabContainers[resultValue] and not tabContainers[resultValue].Visible then
            tabContainers[resultValue].Visible = true
            tabContainers[resultValue].GroupTransparency = 0
        end
        return
    end
    if searchContainer then
        searchContainer.Visible = false
    end
    if searchBox and searchBox.Text ~= "" then
        searchBox.Text = ""
        if clearSearchBtn then
            clearSearchBtn.Visible = false
        end
    end
    for key, tabButton in pairs(tabButtons) do
        local icon = tabButton:FindFirstChild("Icon")
        local activeIndicator = tabButton:FindFirstChild("ActiveIndicator")
        local uiStroke = tabButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if key == resultValue then
            TweenService:Create(
                tabButton,
                TweenInfo.new(0.18),
                { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 26), BackgroundTransparency = 0.1 }
            ):Play()
            if uiStroke then
                TweenService
                    :Create(uiStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Transparency = 0, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) })
                    :Play()
            end
            if icon then
                TweenService:Create(
                    icon,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.18),
                    { ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), ImageTransparency = 0 }
                ):Play()
            end
            if activeIndicator then
                TweenService:Create(
                    activeIndicator,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.18),
                    { BackgroundTransparency = 0, Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.7, 0) }
                ):Play()
            end
        else
            TweenService:Create(
                tabButton,
                TweenInfo.new(0.18),
                { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 16, 21), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }
            ):Play()
            if uiStroke then
                TweenService:Create(uiStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
            end
            if icon then
                TweenService:Create(
                    icon,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.18),
                    { ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), ImageTransparency = 0.35 }
                ):Play()
            end
            if activeIndicator then
                TweenService:Create(
                    activeIndicator,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.18),
                    { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.7, 0) }
                ):Play()
            end
        end
    end
    for key, guiObject in pairs(tabContainers) do
        if key == resultValue then
            guiObject.Visible = true
            guiObject.GroupTransparency = 1
            TweenService:Create(guiObject, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { GroupTransparency = 0 }):Play()
        else
            guiObject.Visible = false
        end
    end
    activeTab = resultValue
    if resultValue == "Teleport" or resultValue == "TP" then
        if scanMapObjects then
            pcall(scanMapObjects)
        end
        if refreshTPMenu then
            pcall(refreshTPMenu)
        end
    end
end
local function normalizeControlLabel(label)
    if not label then
        return ""
    end
    return tostring(label):gsub("<[^>]+>", ""):gsub("%s*%+", ""):gsub("%s*%b()", ""):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
end
function resolveTabNameFromInstance(resultValue)
    local parent = resultValue
    while parent and parent ~= contentFolder and parent ~= screenGui and parent ~= game do
        if tabByScroll and tabByScroll[parent] then
            return tabByScroll[parent]
        end
        if tabContainers then
            for key, tabContainer in pairs(tabContainers) do
                if parent == tabContainer then
                    return key
                end
            end
        end
        if groupInfoByContent and groupInfoByContent[parent] and groupInfoByContent[parent].parentTab then
            return groupInfoByContent[parent].parentTab
        end
        parent = parent.Parent
    end
    return nil
end
function registerSearchableFeature(resultValue)
    if not resultValue or not resultValue.name or resultValue.name == "" then
        return
    end
    local name = normalizeControlLabel(resultValue.name)
    if name == "" or name:lower() == "trigger" then
        return
    end
    local resultValue2 = nil
    if resultValue.container then
        resultValue2 = resolveTabNameFromInstance(resultValue.container)
    end
    if not resultValue2 and resultValue.parent then
        resultValue2 = resolveTabNameFromInstance(resultValue.parent)
    end
    local tabName = resultValue.tabName or resultValue2 or currentBuildingTabName or "Home"
    local sectionName = resultValue.sectionName or currentBuildingSectionName or "General"
    local options = {
        name = name,
        rawLabel = resultValue.name,
        tabName = tabName,
        sectionName = sectionName,
        controlType = resultValue.controlType or "Toggle",
        container = resultValue.container,
        parent = resultValue.parent,
        parentGroup = resultValue.parentGroup,
        isPremium = resultValue.isPremium or isPremiumLabel(resultValue.name),
        keybindName = resultValue.keybindName,
        controlRef = resultValue.controlRef,
        callback = resultValue.callback,
        description = resultValue.description or "",
    }
    table.insert(searchableFeatures, options)
    return options
end
function jumpToFeature(resultValue)
    if not resultValue then
        return
    end
    if searchBox then
        searchBox.Text = ""
        searchBox:ReleaseFocus()
    end
    if clearSearchBtn then
        clearSearchBtn.Visible = false
    end
    if searchContainer then
        searchContainer.Visible = false
    end
    local container = resultValue.container or resultValue.parentGroup and resultValue.parentGroup.container
    local tabName = nil
    if container then
        tabName = resolveTabNameFromInstance(container)
    end
    if not tabName and resultValue.parent then
        tabName = resolveTabNameFromInstance(resultValue.parent)
    end
    if not tabName then
        tabName = resultValue.tabName
    end
    local options = {
        dashboard = "Home",
        home = "Home",
        esp = "ESP",
        farm = "Farm",
        autofarm = "Farm",
        self = "Self",
        modifiers = "Self",
        combat = "Combat",
        tp = "Teleport",
        teleport = "Teleport",
        teleports = "Teleport",
        visual = "Visuals",
        visuals = "Visuals",
        config = "Config",
        configs = "Config",
        community = "Community",
    }
    if tabName then
        local text = tostring(tabName):lower():gsub("%s+", "")
        if options[text] then
            tabName = options[text]
        end
    end
    if not (tabName and tabContainers and tabContainers[tabName]) then
        for key, _ in pairs(tabContainers or {}) do
            if key:lower() == tostring(tabName):lower() then
                tabName = key
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if not (tabName and tabContainers and tabContainers[tabName]) then
        tabName = activeTab or "Home"
    end
    if activeTab == tabName then
        if tabContainers and tabContainers[tabName] then
            tabContainers[tabName].Visible = true
            tabContainers[tabName].GroupTransparency = 0
        end
    else
        switchTab(tabName)
    end
    if container then
        local parent = container
        while parent and parent ~= contentFolder and parent ~= screenGui and parent ~= game do
            if
                groupInfoByContent
                and groupInfoByContent[parent]
                and groupInfoByContent[parent].groupObj
                and groupInfoByContent[parent].groupObj.toggleExpand
            then
                pcall(function()
                    groupInfoByContent[parent].groupObj.toggleExpand(true)
                end)
            end
            parent = parent.Parent
        end
    end
    if resultValue.parentGroup and resultValue.parentGroup.toggleExpand then
        pcall(function()
            resultValue.parentGroup.toggleExpand(true)
        end)
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.12)
        local tabScrollByNameValue = tabScrollByName
            and (tabScrollByName[tabName] or tabScrollByName[resultValue.tabName])
        if tabScrollByNameValue and container and container:IsDescendantOf(tabScrollByNameValue) then
            pcall(function()
                local y = tabScrollByNameValue.AbsolutePosition.Y
                local y2 = container.AbsolutePosition.Y
                local y3 = tabScrollByNameValue.CanvasPosition.Y
                local difference = y3 + (y2 - y) - 50
                tabScrollByNameValue.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, difference))
            end)
        end
        if container and container.Parent and container.Parent:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
            local parent = container.Parent
            pcall(function()
                local y = parent.AbsolutePosition.Y
                local y2 = container.AbsolutePosition.Y
                local y3 = parent.CanvasPosition.Y
                local difference = y3 + (y2 - y) - 20
                parent.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, difference))
            end)
        end
        if container then
            pcall(function()
                local uiStroke = container:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                    or container:FindFirstChild("VisualFrame") and container.VisualFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass(
                        "UIStroke"
                    )
                    or container:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Frame")
                        and container:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Frame"):FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if uiStroke then
                    local color = uiStroke.Color
                    local thickness = uiStroke.Thickness
                    uiStroke.Color = UI.AccentCyan or UI.Accent
                    uiStroke.Thickness = 2.2
                    TweenService:Create(
                        uiStroke,
                        TweenInfo.new(1.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                        { Color = color, Thickness = thickness }
                    ):Play()
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
end
renderedResultCards = {}
function updateSearchResults(resultValue)
    for _, renderedResultCard in ipairs(renderedResultCards) do
        if renderedResultCard and renderedResultCard.Parent then
            renderedResultCard:Destroy()
        end
    end
    renderedResultCards = {}
    if not resultValue or resultValue == "" then
        if searchSubLbl then
            searchSubLbl.Text = "Type in the search bar above to filter features across all tabs."
        end
        return
    end
    local items = {}
    local items2 = {}
    for _, feat in ipairs(searchableFeatures) do
        local lowercaseText = feat.name:lower()
        local lowercaseText2 = (feat.sectionName or ""):lower()
        local lowercaseText3 = (feat.tabName or ""):lower()
        local lowercaseText4 = (feat.keybindName or ""):lower()
        local lowercaseText5 = (feat.description or ""):lower()
        local score = nil
        if lowercaseText == resultValue then
            score = 1
        elseif lowercaseText:sub(1, #resultValue) == resultValue then
            score = 2
        elseif lowercaseText:find(resultValue, 1, true) then
            score = 3
        elseif lowercaseText2:find(resultValue, 1, true) then
            score = 4
        elseif lowercaseText3:find(resultValue, 1, true) then
            score = 5
        elseif lowercaseText4:find(resultValue, 1, true) or lowercaseText5:find(resultValue, 1, true) then
            score = 6
        end
        if score and not items2[feat.name .. ":" .. (feat.tabName or "")] then
            items2[feat.name .. ":" .. (feat.tabName or "")] = true
            table.insert(items, { feat = feat, score = score })
        end
    end
    table.sort(items, function(resultValue2, argument)
        if resultValue2.score ~= argument.score then
            return resultValue2.score < argument.score
        end
        return resultValue2.feat.name < argument.feat.name
    end)
    if searchSubLbl then
        searchSubLbl.Text = string.format('Found %d feature(s) matching "%s"', #items, resultValue)
    end
    if #items == 0 then
        local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 70)
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
        frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6
        frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        frame.Parent = resultsFrame
        Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
        local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
        uiStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
        uiStroke.Thickness = 0.85
        local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
        textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 14)
        textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        textLabel.Text = "No features found"
        textLabel.TextColor3 = UI.Text
        textLabel.Font = UI.Font or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        textLabel.TextSize = 13.5
        textLabel.Parent = frame
        local textLabel2 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        textLabel2.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
        textLabel2.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 36)
        textLabel2.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        textLabel2.Text = "Try searching for: ESP, Farm, Speed, Noclip, Aimbot, Visuals, Config..."
        textLabel2.TextColor3 = UI.Muted
        textLabel2.Font = UI.Font or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        textLabel2.TextSize = 11
        textLabel2.Parent = frame
        table.insert(renderedResultCards, frame)
        return
    end
    for layoutOrder, item in ipairs(items) do
        local feat = item.feat
        local isPremium = feat.isPremium
        local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
        frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.65
        frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        frame.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
        frame.Parent = resultsFrame
        Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
        local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
        uiStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
        uiStroke.Thickness = 0.85
        frame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(uiStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = UI.Stroke, Thickness = 1 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 }):Play()
        end)
        frame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(uiStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = UI.StrokeDim, Thickness = 0.85 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.65 }):Play()
        end)
        local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -165, 0, 13)
        textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 5)
        textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        textLabel.Text = string.format("%s  ›  %s", feat.tabName:upper(), feat.sectionName or "General")
        textLabel.TextColor3 = UI.AccentCyan or UI.Accent
        textLabel.Font = UI.Font or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        textLabel.TextSize = 9.5
        textLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        textLabel.Parent = frame
        local textLabel2 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        textLabel2.RichText = true
        textLabel2.Size = UDim2.new(1, -165, 0, 18)
        textLabel2.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 18)
        textLabel2.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        local text = feat.name
        if isPremium and not hasPremiumAccess() then
            text = text .. ' <font color="#FF2A6D">[👑]</font>'
        end
        textLabel2.Text = text
        textLabel2.TextColor3 = UI.Text
        textLabel2.Font = UI.Font or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        textLabel2.TextSize = 12.5
        textLabel2.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        textLabel2.Parent = frame
        local frame2 = Instance.new("Frame")
        frame2.Size = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 18)
        frame2.Position = UDim2.new(1, -145, 0.5, -9)
        frame2.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
        frame2.BorderSizePixel = 0
        frame2.Parent = frame
        Instance.new("UICorner", frame2).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        local textLabel3 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        textLabel3.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)

        textLabel3.Text = (feat.controlType or "Feature"):upper()
        textLabel3.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
        textLabel3.Font = UI.Font or Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        textLabel3.TextSize = 8.5

        local uiStroke2 = Instance.new("UIStroke", textButton)
        uiStroke2.Color = UI.Stroke

        textButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function()

        table.insert(renderedResultCards, frame)
    end
end
local iconAssetCache = {}
function resolveIcon(resultValue, argument)
    if iconAssetCache[resultValue] then
        return iconAssetCache[resultValue]
    end
    local getcustomassetValue = getLocalAsset or syn and syn.getcustomasset
    if getcustomassetValue and writefile and isfile and readfile then
        local text = "VD_Icons"
        if not isfolder or not isfolder(text) then
            pcall(makefolder, text)
        end
        local combinedText = text .. "/" .. resultValue .. ".png"
        if isfile(combinedText) then
            local succeeded, result = pcall(getcustomassetValue, combinedText)
            if succeeded and result then
                iconAssetCache[resultValue] = result
                return result
            end
        else
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(function()
                    local requestUrl = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/latte-soft/lucide-roblox/master/icons/compiled/48px/"
                        .. resultValue
                        .. ".png"
                    local responseBody = game:HttpGet(requestUrl)
                    if responseBody and #responseBody > 50 then
                        writefile(combinedText, responseBody)
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end
    end
    iconAssetCache[resultValue] = argument
    return argument
end
