hotkeyActions.ToggleUI = function()
    pcall(toggleUI)
end
toggleInProgress = false
function toggleUI(resultValue)
    if not mainFrame then
        return
    end
    if configurationLoading then
        return
    end
    if toggleInProgress then
        return
    end
    local matchesCondition = resultValue ~= nil and resultValue or not mainFrame.Visible
    if mobileToggleButton then
        mobileToggleButton.Visible = isMobile or UserInputService.TouchEnabled
    end
    mainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
    local default = themes[currentThemeName] or themes.Default
    local mouse = localPlayer:GetMouse()
    if matchesCondition then
        captureMouseState()
        toggleInProgress = true
        uiVisible = true
        mainFrame.Visible = true
        pcall(function()
            local modalButton = mainFrame:FindFirstChild("ModalButton")
            if modalButton then
                modalButton.Modal = true
            end
            mouse.Icon = "rbxassetid://26140499"
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
            UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
        end)
        mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, UI.MainW * 0.85, 0, UI.MainH * 0.85)
        mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -(UI.MainW * 0.85) / 2, 0.5, -(UI.MainH * 0.85) / 2)
        mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        local tween =
            TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Size = UDim2.new(0, UI.MainW, 0, UI.MainH),
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -UI.MainW / 2, 0.5, -UI.MainH / 2),
            })
        local premiumAvailable = featureSettings.CustomBackground
            and featureSettings.CustomBackground.Enabled
            and hasPremiumAccess()
            and premiumCapabilities
            and (premiumCapabilities.CustomBackground or premiumCapabilities["Custom Background"])
            and customBackgroundImage
            and customBackgroundImage.Visible
        local backgroundTransparency = premiumAvailable and 1 or default.BgTrans
        local tween2 = TweenService:Create(
            mainFrame,
            TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { BackgroundTransparency = backgroundTransparency }
        )
        tween:Play()
        tween2:Play()
        tween.Completed:Connect(function()
            toggleInProgress = false
        end)
    else
        toggleInProgress = true
        uiVisible = false
        pcall(function()
            local modalButton = mainFrame:FindFirstChild("ModalButton")
            if modalButton then
                modalButton.Modal = false
            end
            restoreMouseState()
        end)
        local tween =
            TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                Size = UDim2.new(0, UI.MainW * 0.85, 0, UI.MainH * 0.85),
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -(UI.MainW * 0.85) / 2, 0.5, -(UI.MainH * 0.85) / 2),
            })
        local tween2 = TweenService:Create(
            mainFrame,
            TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
            { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }
        )
        tween:Play()
        tween2:Play()
        tween.Completed:Connect(function()
            mainFrame.Visible = false
            toggleInProgress = false
        end)
    end
end
local function formatKeybindLabel(keybind)
    if not keybind or keybind == "" or keybind == "None" then
        return "None"
    end
    local text = tostring(keybind)
    local enabled = false
    if text:sub(1, 5):lower() == "hold " then
        enabled = true
        text = text:sub(6)
    end
    local text2 = text:gsub("Enum%.KeyCode%.", "")
    if enabled then
        return "HOLD " .. text2
    end
    return text2
end
function createKeybindButton(container, actionId, accentColor)
    if accentColor then
        hotkeyActions[actionId] = accentColor
    end
    local textButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    textButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
    textButton.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    textButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    textButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 21, 28)
    textButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
    textButton.Text = ""
    textButton.TextColor3 = UI.Text
    textButton.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    textButton.TextSize = 10
    textButton.AutoButtonColor = false
    textButton.Parent = container
    Instance.new("UICorner", textButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", textButton)
    uiStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
    uiStroke.Thickness = 0.8
    local uiPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding", textButton)
    uiPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)
    uiPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local function animateColor(resultValue)
        local backgroundColor, color, textColor, text, font, textSize
        if isMobile then
            local mobileButtons = featureSettings.MobileButtons and featureSettings.MobileButtons[actionId]
            if mobileButtons and mobileButtons ~= "" and mobileButtons ~= "None" then
                text = tostring(mobileButtons):upper()
                textColor = Color3.fromRGB(240, 242, 250)
                font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
                textSize = 10
                backgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(26, 28, 38)
                color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 65, 80)
            else
                text = "NONE"
                textColor = Color3.fromRGB(115, 120, 135)
                font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
                textSize = 9.5
                backgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(18, 19, 25)
                color = UI.StrokeDim
            end
        else
            local keybinds = featureSettings.Keybinds and featureSettings.Keybinds[actionId]
            if keybinds and keybinds ~= "" and keybinds ~= "None" then
                local uppercaseText = formatKeybindLabel(keybinds):upper()
                text = uppercaseText
                textColor = Color3.fromRGB(240, 242, 250)
                font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
                textSize = 10
                backgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(26, 28, 38)
                color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 65, 80)
            else
                text = "NONE"
                textColor = Color3.fromRGB(115, 120, 135)
                font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
                textSize = 9.5
                backgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(18, 19, 25)
                color = UI.StrokeDim
            end
        end
        textButton.Text = text
        textButton.Font = font
        textButton.TextSize = textSize
        if resultValue then
            TweenService:Create(
                textButton,
                TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                { BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, TextColor3 = textColor }
            ):Play()
            TweenService:Create(
                uiStroke,
                TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                { Color = color, Thickness = 0.8 }
            ):Play()
        else
            textButton.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor
            textButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
            textButton.TextColor3 = textColor
            uiStroke.Color = color
            uiStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        end
    end
    keybindRefreshCallbacks[actionId] = function()
        animateColor(false)
    end
    textButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if isMobile then
            showMobileKeybindPrompt(actionId, function(resultValue)
                if not resultValue or resultValue:gsub("%s+", "") == "" then
                    if featureSettings.MobileButtons then
                        featureSettings.MobileButtons[actionId] = nil
                    end
                    if mobileFloatingButtons and mobileFloatingButtons[actionId] then
                        pcall(function()
                            mobileFloatingButtons[actionId]:Destroy()
                        end)
                        mobileFloatingButtons[actionId] = nil
                    end
                    showNotification("Button Removed", "Floating button removed.", "info")
                else
                    local resultValue2 = resultValue:sub(1, 6)
                    if not featureSettings.MobileButtons then
                        featureSettings.MobileButtons = {}
                    end
                    featureSettings.MobileButtons[actionId] = resultValue2
                    if createOrUpdateMobileFloatingButton then
                        pcall(createOrUpdateMobileFloatingButton, actionId, resultValue2)
                    end
                    showNotification("Button Setup", "Floating button '" .. resultValue2 .. "' setup!", "success")
                end
                pcall(saveSettings)
                animateColor(true)
            end)
            return
        end
        isBindingKey = true
        textButton.Text = "..."
        TweenService:Create(textButton, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 12),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.05,
            TextColor3 = UI.AccentCyan,
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(
            uiStroke,
            TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Color = UI.AccentCyan, Thickness = 1.2 }
        ):Play()
        local connection, connection2
        local name = nil
        local timestamp = 0
        local workerThread = nil
        local function disconnectConnection()
            if workerThread then
                pcall(task.cancel, workerThread)
                workerThread = nil
            end
            if connection then
                connection:Disconnect()
                connection = nil
            end
            if connection2 then
                connection2:Disconnect()
                connection2 = nil
            end
            isBindingKey = false
        end
        connection = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            local matchesCondition = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad3
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad4
            local matchesCondition2 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or matchesCondition
            local matchesCondition3 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
            if matchesCondition2 or matchesCondition3 then
                local name2 = matchesCondition2 and input.KeyCode.Name or input.UserInputType.Name
                if name2 == "Escape" or name2 == "Backspace" or name2 == "Delete" then
                    disconnectConnection()
                    featureSettings.Keybinds[actionId] = "None"
                    pcall(saveSettings)
                    animateColor(true)
                    if _G.VD_RefreshHotkeys then
                        pcall(_G.VD_RefreshHotkeys)
                    end
                    return
                end
                if not name then
                    name = name2
                    timestamp = tick()
                    textButton.Text = name:upper()
                    workerThread = task.spawn(function()
                        task.wait(0.4)
                        if name == name2 and isBindingKey then
                            textButton.Text = "HOLD " .. name:upper()
                            TweenService
                                :Create(
                                    uiStroke,
                                    TweenInfo.new(0.15),
                                    { Color = UI.AccentPink or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 120), Thickness = 1.4 }
                                )
                                :Play()
                            textButton.TextColor3 = UI.AccentPink or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 120)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end)
        connection2 = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            local matchesCondition = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad3
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad4
            local matchesCondition2 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or matchesCondition
            local matchesCondition3 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
            if (matchesCondition2 or matchesCondition3) and name then
                local name2 = matchesCondition2 and input.KeyCode.Name or input.UserInputType.Name
                if name2 == name then
                    local difference = tick() - timestamp
                    disconnectConnection()
                    if difference >= 0.4 then
                        featureSettings.Keybinds[actionId] = "Hold " .. name
                        showNotification("Keybind Set", actionId .. " bound to HOLD " .. name, "success")
                    else
                        featureSettings.Keybinds[actionId] = name
                        showNotification("Keybind Set", actionId .. " bound to " .. name, "success")
                    end
                    pcall(saveSettings)
                    animateColor(true)
                    if _G.VD_RefreshHotkeys then
                        pcall(_G.VD_RefreshHotkeys)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end)
    animateColor(false)
    return textButton
end
function createToggle(container, label, initialValue, onChanged, _, actionId)
    local isPremiumFeature = isPremiumLabel(label)
    local text = label
    if not hasPremiumAccess() and isPremiumFeature then
        text = label .. " +"
    end
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = container
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
    local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    uiStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
    uiStroke.Thickness = 0.9
    local matchesCondition = actionId ~= nil
    local initialValue2 = initialValue
    if initialValue2 and isPremiumFeature and not hasPremiumAccess() then
        initialValue2 = false
    end
    local textButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    textButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
    textButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -8)
    textButton.BackgroundColor3 = initialValue2 and UI.Text or UI.Elevated
    textButton.BackgroundTransparency = initialValue2 and 0 or 0.6
    textButton.Text = ""
    textButton.AutoButtonColor = false
    textButton.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", textButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    local uiStroke2 = Instance.new("UIStroke", textButton)
    uiStroke2.Color = initialValue2 and UI.Text or UI.Stroke
    uiStroke2.Thickness = 0.8
    local imageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    imageLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)
    imageLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -6, 0.5, -6)
    imageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    imageLabel.Image = "rbxassetid://7733715400"
    imageLabel.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 16, 21)
    imageLabel.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    imageLabel.Visible = not not initialValue2
    imageLabel.Parent = textButton
    local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    textLabel.RichText = true
    textLabel.Size = matchesCondition and UDim2.new(1, -120, 1, 0) or UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0)
    textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 0)
    textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    textLabel.Text = text
    textLabel.TextColor3 = UI.Text
    textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    textLabel.TextSize = 12
    textLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    textLabel.Parent = frame
    table.insert(registeredPremiumLabels, { labelObj = textLabel, originalText = label, isPrem = isPremiumFeature })
    local initialValue3 = initialValue2
    local function setValue(enabled, argument)
        if enabled and isPremiumFeature and not hasPremiumAccess() then
            enabled = false
        end
        initialValue3 = enabled
        TweenService:Create(textButton, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
            BackgroundColor3 = initialValue3 and UI.Text or UI.Elevated,
            BackgroundTransparency = initialValue3 and 0 or 0.6,
        }):Play()
        imageLabel.Visible = not not initialValue3
        TweenService:Create(uiStroke2, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = initialValue3 and UI.Text or UI.Stroke }):Play()
        if argument and onChanged then
            pcall(onChanged, enabled)
        end
    end
    local function handleAction(resultValue, argument)
        if not hasPremiumAccess() and isPremiumFeature and resultValue then
            showNotification("Premium Feature", "Unlock Premium in Config tab!", "warning")
            setValue(false, true)
            return
        end
        setValue(resultValue, true)
        if argument and featureSettings.ShowToggleNotifications then
            local text2 = label:gsub("<[^>]+>", ""):gsub("%s*%b()", ""):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
            local text3 = resultValue and "ENABLED" or "DISABLED"
            local text4 = resultValue and "success" or "warning"
            showNotification(text2, text3, text4)
        end
    end
    local function callback()
        handleAction(not initialValue3, true)
    end
    if actionId and actionId ~= "" then
        hotkeyActions[actionId] = callback
        hotkeyStateSetters[actionId] = function(resultValue)
            handleAction(resultValue, true)
        end
        hotkeyStateGetters[actionId] = function()
            return initialValue3
        end
    end
    local text2 = label:gsub("<[^>]+>", ""):gsub("%s*%b()", ""):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
    if text2 ~= "" then
        hotkeyActions[text2] = callback
        hotkeyStateSetters[text2] = function(resultValue)
            handleAction(resultValue, true)
        end
        hotkeyStateGetters[text2] = function()
            return initialValue3
        end
        local text3 = text2:gsub("%s+", "")
        hotkeyActions[text3] = callback
        hotkeyStateSetters[text3] = function(resultValue)
            handleAction(resultValue, true)
        end
        hotkeyStateGetters[text3] = function()
            return initialValue3
        end
    end
    textButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    local textButton2 = Instance.new("TextButton")
    textButton2.Size = UDim2.new(1, matchesCondition and -70 or 0, 1, 0)
    textButton2.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    textButton2.Text = ""
    textButton2.Parent = frame
    textButton2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    if matchesCondition then
        local keybindButton = createKeybindButton(frame, actionId, callback)
        keybindButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0)
    end
    frame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(uiStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = UI.Stroke, Thickness = 1 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 }):Play()
    end)
    frame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(uiStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Color = UI.StrokeDim, Thickness = 0.9 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 }):Play()
    end)
    local controlRef = { setValue = setValue, container = frame }
    registerSearchableFeature({
        name = label,
        parent = container,
        controlType = "Toggle",
        container = frame,
        keybindName = actionId,
        isPremium = isPremiumFeature,
        controlRef = controlRef,
        callback = callback,
    })
    return controlRef
end
function createButton(container, label, argument, argument2, _, keybindName)
    local isPremiumFeature = isPremiumLabel(label)
    local text = label
    if not hasPremiumAccess() and isPremiumFeature then
        text = label .. " +"
    end
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")

    uiStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
    uiStroke.Thickness = 0.9
    local matchesCondition = keybindName ~= nil
    local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    textLabel.Size = matchesCondition and UDim2.new(1, -185, 1, 0) or UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, 0)

    textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    textLabel.TextColor3 = UI.Text
    textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    textLabel.TextSize = 12
    textLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    textLabel.Parent = frame
    table.insert(registeredPremiumLabels, { labelObj = textLabel, originalText = label, isPrem = isPremiumFeature })
    local frame2 = Instance.new("Frame")

    uiStroke2.Color = UI.Stroke
    uiStroke2.Thickness = 0.8
    local textButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    textButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    textButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    textButton.Text = (argument or "TRIGGER"):upper()
    textButton.TextColor3 = UI.Text
    textButton.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    textButton.TextSize = 10.5
    textButton.AutoButtonColor = false
    textButton.Parent = frame2
    textButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(frame2, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 36, 46) }):Play()
    end)
    textButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(frame2, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated }):Play()
    end)
    local callback = function()
        if not hasPremiumAccess() and isPremiumFeature then
            showNotification("Premium Feature", "Unlock Premium in Config tab!", "warning")
            return
        end
        pcall(argument2)
    end
    if keybindName and keybindName ~= "" then
        hotkeyActions[keybindName] = callback
    end
    local text2 = label:gsub("<[^>]+>", ""):gsub("%s*%b()", ""):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
    if text2 ~= "" then
        hotkeyActions[text2] = callback
        hotkeyActions[text2:gsub("%s+", "")] = callback
    end
    textButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    if matchesCondition then
        local keybindButton = createKeybindButton(frame, keybindName, callback)
        keybindButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -105, 0.5, 0)
    end
    registerSearchableFeature({
        name = label,
        parent = container,
        controlType = "Button",
        container = frame,
        keybindName = keybindName,
        isPremium = isPremiumFeature,
        callback = callback,
    })
    return frame
end

    table.insert(registeredPremiumLabels, { labelObj = textLabel, originalText = label, isPrem = isPremiumFeature })
    local frame3 = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame3.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
    frame3.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    frame3.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame3.ClipsDescendants = true
    frame3.LayoutOrder = 2
    frame3.Parent = frame
    local uiListLayout2 = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    uiListLayout2.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    uiListLayout2.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
    uiListLayout2.Parent = frame3
    local uiPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    uiPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12)
    uiPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 2)
    uiPadding.Parent = frame3
    local resultValue = false
    local function toggleExpand(resultValue2)
        if resultValue2 == nil then
            resultValue = not resultValue
        else
            resultValue = resultValue2
        end
        TweenService:Create(
            imageLabel,
            TweenInfo.new(0.2),
            { Rotation = resultValue and 90 or 0, ImageColor3 = resultValue and UI.Text or UI.TextSub }
        ):Play()
        TweenService:Create(
            uiStroke,
            TweenInfo.new(0.2),
            { Color = resultValue and UI.Stroke or UI.StrokeDim, Thickness = resultValue and 1.1 or 0.9 }
        ):Play()
        local y = resultValue and uiListLayout2.AbsoluteContentSize.Y or 0
        TweenService:Create(
            frame3,
            TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, y) }
        ):Play()
    end
    uiListLayout2:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
        if resultValue then
            frame3.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, uiListLayout2.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
        end
    end)
    textButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if not hasPremiumAccess() and isPremiumFeature then
            showNotification("Premium Feature", "Unlock Premium in Config tab!", "warning")
            return
        end
        toggleExpand()
    end)
    local function addSubToggle(resultValue2, argument2, argument3)
        return createSubToggle(frame3, resultValue2, argument2, argument3)
    end
    local groupObj = {
        addSubToggle = addSubToggle,
        content = frame3,
        toggleExpand = toggleExpand,
        container = frame,
    }
    local parentTab = resolveTabNameFromInstance(container) or currentBuildingTabName or "General"
    groupInfoByContent[frame3] = {
        groupObj = groupObj,
        parentTab = parentTab,
        sectionName = currentBuildingSectionName,
        groupTitle = normalizeControlLabel(label),
    }
    registerSearchableFeature({
        name = label,
        parent = container,
        controlType = "Group",
        container = frame,
        parentGroup = groupObj,
        isPremium = isPremiumFeature,
    })
    return groupObj
end

function createSlider(container, label, minimum, maximum, initialValue, callback, _, argument2, argument3)
    local argument4 = nil
    local text = ""
    if type(argument2) == "number" then
        argument4 = argument2
        if type(argument3) == "string" then
            text = argument3
        end
    elseif type(argument2) == "string" then
        text = argument2
    elseif type(argument3) == "string" then
        text = argument3
    end
    local isPremiumFeature = isPremiumLabel(label)
    local text2 = label
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = container
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
    local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    uiStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
    uiStroke.Thickness = 0.9
    local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    textLabel.RichText = true
    textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 18)
    textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 4)
    textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    textLabel.Text = text2
    textLabel.TextColor3 = UI.Text
    textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    textLabel.TextSize = 12
    textLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    textLabel.Parent = frame
    local function handleAction(resultValue)
        local numberValue = tonumber(resultValue) or 0
        if type(argument4) == "number" and argument4 > 0 and argument4 < 0.1 then
            if maximum then
                return string.format("%.2f / %.2f%s", numberValue, maximum, text)
            end
            return string.format("%.2f%s", numberValue, text)
        end
        if maximum then
            return tostring(math.round(numberValue * 100) / 100) .. " / " .. tostring(maximum) .. text
        end
        return tostring(math.round(numberValue * 100) / 100) .. text
    end
    local initialValue2 = initialValue
    local textBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
    textBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 18)
    textBox.Position = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 4)
    textBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    textBox.Text = handleAction(initialValue)
    textBox.TextColor3 = UI.TextSub
    textBox.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    textBox.TextSize = 11
    textBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    textBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    textBox.Parent = frame
    local textButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    textButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 3)
    textButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 26)
    textButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 34, 43)
    textButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
    textButton.Text = ""
    textButton.AutoButtonColor = false
    textButton.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", textButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local frame2 = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame2.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    frame2.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Text
    frame2.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame2.Parent = textButton
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame2).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local frame3 = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame3.Size = UDim2.new(0, 9, 0, 9)
    frame3.Position = UDim2.new(0, -4, 0.5, -4)
    frame3.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    frame3.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame3.Parent = textButton
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame3).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local function setValue(resultValue, argument5)
        initialValue2 = resultValue
        local clampedValue = math.clamp((resultValue - minimum) / (maximum - minimum), 0, 1)
        frame2.Size = UDim2.new(clampedValue, 0, 1, 0)
        frame3.Position = UDim2.new(clampedValue, -4, 0.5, -4)
        if not textBox:IsFocused() then
            textBox.Text = handleAction(resultValue)
        end
        if argument5 and callback then
            pcall(callback, resultValue)
        end
    end
    textBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        if not hasPremiumAccess() and isPremiumFeature then
            showNotification("Premium Feature", "Unlock Premium in Config tab!", "warning")
            textBox.Text = handleAction(initialValue2)
            return
        end
        local text3 = textBox.Text:gsub("[^%d%.%-]", "")
        local numberValue = tonumber(text3)
        if numberValue then
            numberValue = math.clamp(numberValue, minimum, maximum)
            setValue(numberValue, true)
        else
            textBox.Text = handleAction(initialValue2)
        end
    end)
    local function handleAction2(resultValue)
        local x = textButton.AbsoluteSize.X
        if x <= 0 then
            x = 180
        end
        local clampedValue = math.clamp(resultValue.Position.X - textButton.AbsolutePosition.X, 0, x)
        local ratio = clampedValue / x
        local sum = minimum + (maximum - minimum) * ratio
        if type(argument4) == "number" and argument4 > 0 then
            sum = math.round(sum / argument4) * argument4
        else
            sum = math.round(sum)
        end
        initialValue2 = sum
        frame2.Size = UDim2.new(ratio, 0, 1, 0)
        frame3.Position = UDim2.new(ratio, -4, 0.5, -4)
        if not textBox:IsFocused() then
            textBox.Text = handleAction(sum)
        end
        callback(sum)
    end
    local clampedValue = math.clamp((initialValue - minimum) / (maximum - minimum), 0, 1)
    frame2.Size = UDim2.new(clampedValue, 0, 1, 0)
    frame3.Position = UDim2.new(clampedValue, -4, 0.5, -4)
    local enabled = false
    textButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            if not hasPremiumAccess() and isPremiumFeature then
                showNotification("Premium Feature", "Unlock Premium in Config tab!", "warning")
                return
            end
            enabled = true
            handleAction2(input)
        end
    end)
    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if
            enabled
            and (
                input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            )
        then
            handleAction2(input)
        end
    end))
    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            enabled = false
        end
    end))
    local controlRef = { setValue = setValue, container = frame }
    registerSearchableFeature({
        name = label,
        parent = container,
        controlType = "Slider",
        container = frame,
        isPremium = isPremiumFeature,
        controlRef = controlRef,
        callback = callback,
    })
    return controlRef
end
function createSliderFloat(container, label, minimum, maximum, initialValue, argument, argument2, argument3)
    return createSlider(container, label, minimum, maximum, initialValue, argument, argument2, argument3 or 0.01)
end

                return
            end

            end
        end)
        textBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()

        end)
        local controlRef = {

        }

    else

        textLabel.TextSize = 12

        textLabel.Parent = frame
        local frame2 = Instance.new("Frame")
        frame2.Size = UDim2.new(0, 96, 0, 20)

        frame2.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Elevated
        frame2.BorderSizePixel = 0
        frame2.Parent = frame
        Instance.new("UICorner", frame2).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
        local textBox = Instance.new("TextBox")

        textBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0)
        textBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        textBox.Text = tostring(argument2 or "")
        textBox.PlaceholderText = argument or "value"
        textBox.PlaceholderColor3 = UI.Muted
        textBox.TextColor3 = UI.Text
        textBox.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        textBox.TextSize = 11
        textBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
        textBox.Parent = frame2
        textBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
            pcall(callback, textBox.Text)
        end)
        local controlRef = {
            container = frame,
            textBox = textBox,
            setValue = function(resultValue)
                if not textBox:IsFocused() then
                    textBox.Text = tostring(resultValue)
                end
            end,
        }
        registerSearchableFeature({
            name = label,
            parent = container,
            controlType = "Input",
            container = frame,
            isPremium = isPremiumFeature,
            controlRef = controlRef,
            callback = callback,
        })
        return controlRef
    end

        frame11.Position = UDim2.new(clampedValue, 0, 0.5, 0)

        enabled = resultValue

            enabled2 = true
            local absolutePosition = frame6.AbsolutePosition
            local absoluteSize = frame6.AbsoluteSize
            clampedValue2 = math.clamp((input.Position.X - absolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, absoluteSize.X), 0, 1)
            clampedValue3 = math.clamp(1 - (input.Position.Y - absolutePosition.Y) / math.max(1, absoluteSize.Y), 0, 1)
            handleAction(true)
        end
    end)

        end
    end))
    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch

            enabled2 = false

        end
    end))
    local controlRef = {
        setColor = function(resultValue)
            if resultValue and typeof(resultValue) == "Color3" then
                clampedValue, clampedValue2, clampedValue3 = Color3.toHSV(resultValue)
                handleAction(false)
            end
        end,
        setValue = function(resultValue)
            if resultValue and typeof(resultValue) == "Color3" then
                clampedValue, clampedValue2, clampedValue3 = Color3.toHSV(resultValue)
                handleAction(false)
            end
        end,
        getColor = function()
            return backgroundColor2
        end,

    }
    registerSearchableFeature({
        name = label,
        parent = container,
        controlType = "Color",
        container = frame,
        isPremium = isPremiumFeature,
        controlRef = controlRef,
        callback = callback,
    })
    handleAction(false)
    return controlRef
end

        local integerValue3 = math.floor(backgroundColor2.B * 255)

                pcall(function()
                    callback(backgroundColor2)
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    local enabled = false
    textButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            enabled = true
            local absolutePosition = frame4.AbsolutePosition
            local absoluteSize = frame4.AbsoluteSize
            clampedValue2 = math.clamp((input.Position.X - absolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, absoluteSize.X), 0, 1)
            clampedValue3 = math.clamp(1 - (input.Position.Y - absolutePosition.Y) / math.max(1, absoluteSize.Y), 0, 1)
            handleAction2(true)
        end
    end)

            enabled
            and (
                input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            )
        then
            local absolutePosition = frame4.AbsolutePosition
            local absoluteSize = frame4.AbsoluteSize
            clampedValue2 = math.clamp((input.Position.X - absolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, absoluteSize.X), 0, 1)
            clampedValue3 = math.clamp(1 - (input.Position.Y - absolutePosition.Y) / math.max(1, absoluteSize.Y), 0, 1)
            handleAction2(true)
        end
    end))

            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch

            enabled2 = false
        end
    end))
    local controlRef = {
        setColor = function(resultValue)
            if resultValue and typeof(resultValue) == "Color3" then
                clampedValue, clampedValue2, clampedValue3 = Color3.toHSV(resultValue)
                handleAction2(false)
            end

                handleAction2(false)
            end
        end,
        container = frame,
    }
    registerSearchableFeature({
        name = name,
        parent = parent,
        controlType = "Color",
        container = frame,
        isPremium = isPremiumFeature,
        controlRef = controlRef,
        callback = callback,
    })
    handleAction2(false)
    return controlRef
end
function createHueSlider(resultValue, argument, argument2, argument3)
    return createColorWheel(resultValue, argument, argument2, argument3)
end
function setRevolverAutofarm(revolverAutofarm)
    if revolverAutofarm and not hasPremiumAccess("RevolverAutofarm") then
        showNotification("Premium Feature +", "Unlock the Premium version to use this feature!", "warning")
        if controlRegistry.RevolverAutofarm and controlRegistry.RevolverAutofarm.setValue then
            pcall(function()
                controlRegistry.RevolverAutofarm.setValue(false)
            end)
        end
        return
    end
    featureSettings.RevolverAutofarm = revolverAutofarm
    if revolverAutofarm then
        if not featureSettings.InstantHeal then
            instantHealWasDisabledBeforeRevolver = true
            featureSettings.InstantHeal = true
            if controlRegistry.InstantHeal and controlRegistry.InstantHeal.setValue then
                pcall(function()
                    controlRegistry.InstantHeal.setValue(true)
                end)
            end
        else
            instantHealWasDisabledBeforeRevolver = false
        end
    else
        if instantHealWasDisabledBeforeRevolver then
            featureSettings.InstantHeal = false
            if controlRegistry.InstantHeal and controlRegistry.InstantHeal.setValue then
                pcall(function()
                    controlRegistry.InstantHeal.setValue(false)
                end)
            end
            instantHealWasDisabledBeforeRevolver = false
        end
    end
    if controlRegistry.RevolverAutofarm and controlRegistry.RevolverAutofarm.setValue then
        pcall(function()
            controlRegistry.RevolverAutofarm.setValue(revolverAutofarm)
        end)
    end
    pcall(saveSettings)
end

    local function handleAction(text)
        if not text then
            return nil
        end
        text = tostring(text):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        if text == "" then
            return nil
        end
        local numberValue = tonumber(text)
        if numberValue and numberValue > 0 then
            return numberValue
        end
        local succeeded, result = pcall(function()
            return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(text)
        end)
        if succeeded and result then
            return result
        end
        return nil
    end
    _G.VD_GetTargetPlayers = function(playerCustomizer)
        playerCustomizer = playerCustomizer
            or featureSettings and featureSettings.PlayerCustomizer and featureSettings.PlayerCustomizer.SelectedTarget
            or "LocalPlayer (Self)"
        local items = {}
        if playerCustomizer == "LocalPlayer (Self)" or playerCustomizer == "Self" then
            if localPlayer then
                table.insert(items, localPlayer)
            end
        elseif playerCustomizer == "All Players" then
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                table.insert(items, player)
            end
        elseif playerCustomizer == "Killer" then
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                local players = ActiveESP and ActiveESP.Players and ActiveESP.Players[player]
                local matchesCondition = players and players.IsKiller or player.Team and player.Team.Name == "Killer"
                if matchesCondition then
                    table.insert(items, player)
                end
            end
        elseif playerCustomizer == "Survivors" then
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                local players = ActiveESP and ActiveESP.Players and ActiveESP.Players[player]
                local matchesCondition = players and players.IsSurvivor
                    or player.Team and player.Team.Name == "Survivors"
                if matchesCondition and player ~= localPlayer then
                    table.insert(items, player)
                end
            end
        else
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if
                    player.Name == playerCustomizer
                    or player.DisplayName == playerCustomizer
                    or tostring(player.UserId) == playerCustomizer
                then
                    table.insert(items, player)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        return items
    end
    _G.VD_GetLobbyPlayerOptions = function()
        local items2 = { "LocalPlayer (Self)", "All Players", "Killer", "Survivors" }
        local items = { "LocalPlayer (Self)", "All Players", "Killer", "Survivors" }
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= localPlayer then
                local formattedText = string.format("%s (@%s)", player.DisplayName or player.Name, player.Name)
                table.insert(items2, formattedText)
                table.insert(items, player.Name)
            end
        end
        return items2, items
    end

                        vdCustomParticleEmitter.Speed = hellfire.Speed or NumberRange.new(2, 6)
                        vdCustomParticleEmitter.SpreadAngle = hellfire.SpreadAngle or Vector2.new(180, 180)

    local function handleAction2(resultValue)

                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function handleAction3(resultValue, parent)
        if not parent or not resultValue then
            return
        end
        handleAction2(parent)
        local head = parent:FindFirstChild("Head")

            local bodyColors = Instance.new("BodyColors")

        if resultValue.assets then
            for _, asset in ipairs(resultValue.assets) do

                        for _, face in ipairs(resultValue) do
                            if face:IsA("Accessory") then
                                face.Parent = parent
                                local handle = face:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                                if handle then
                                    local attachment = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
                                    if attachment then
                                        local part = nil
                                        for _, part1 in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
                                            if part1:IsA("BasePart") then
                                                part = part1:FindFirstChild(attachment.Name)
                                                if part then
                                                    local accessoryWeld = Instance.new("Weld")
                                                    accessoryWeld.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
                                                    accessoryWeld.Part0 = handle
                                                    accessoryWeld.Part1 = part1
                                                    accessoryWeld.C0 = attachment.CFrame
                                                    accessoryWeld.C1 = part.CFrame
                                                    accessoryWeld.Parent = handle
                                                    break
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    elseif head then
                                        local accessoryWeld = Instance.new("Weld")
                                        accessoryWeld.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
                                        accessoryWeld.Part0 = handle
                                        accessoryWeld.Part1 = head
                                        accessoryWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)
                                        accessoryWeld.Parent = handle
                                    end
                                    handle.CanCollide = false
                                end
                            elseif
                                face:IsA("Shirt")
                                or face:IsA("Pants")
                                or face:IsA("ShirtGraphic")
                                or face:IsA("BodyColors")
                                or face:IsA("CharacterMesh")
                            then
                                face.Parent = parent
                            elseif face:IsA("Decal") and head then
                                face.Name = "face"
                                face.Parent = head
                            elseif face:IsA("SpecialMesh") and head then
                                local specialMesh = head:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
                                if specialMesh then
                                    specialMesh:Destroy()
                                end
                                face.Parent = head
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    local function handleAction4(resultValue, parent)
        if not parent or not resultValue then
            return
        end
        handleAction2(parent)
        local head = parent:FindFirstChild("Head")
        for _, child in ipairs(resultValue:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Accessory") then
                local clone = child:Clone()
                clone.Parent = parent
                local handle = clone:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                if handle then
                    local attachment = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
                    if attachment then
                        for _, part1 in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
                            if part1:IsA("BasePart") then
                                local part = part1:FindFirstChild(attachment.Name)
                                if part then
                                    local accessoryWeld = Instance.new("Weld")
                                    accessoryWeld.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
                                    accessoryWeld.Part0 = handle
                                    accessoryWeld.Part1 = part1
                                    accessoryWeld.C0 = attachment.CFrame
                                    accessoryWeld.C1 = part.CFrame
                                    accessoryWeld.Parent = handle
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    elseif head then
                        local accessoryWeld = Instance.new("Weld")
                        accessoryWeld.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
                        accessoryWeld.Part0 = handle
                        accessoryWeld.Part1 = head
                        accessoryWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)
                        accessoryWeld.Parent = handle
                    end
                    handle.CanCollide = false
                end
            elseif
                child:IsA("Shirt")
                or child:IsA("Pants")
                or child:IsA("ShirtGraphic")
                or child:IsA("BodyColors")
                or child:IsA("CharacterMesh")
            then
                child:Clone().Parent = parent
            elseif child:IsA("Decal") and head then
                local face = child:Clone()
                face.Name = "face"
                face.Parent = head
            end
        end
    end
    _G.VD_ApplySkinToTarget = function(resultValue, argument)
        local playerCustomizer = argument
            or featureSettings and featureSettings.PlayerCustomizer and featureSettings.PlayerCustomizer.SkinTarget
            or featureSettings and featureSettings.SkinChangerTarget
        if not playerCustomizer or playerCustomizer == "" then
            pcall(function()
                showNotification("Skin Changer", "Please enter a valid Username or User ID!", "warning")
            end)
            return false
        end
        local resultValue2 = _G.VD_GetTargetPlayers(resultValue)
        if #resultValue2 == 0 then
            showNotification("Skin Changer", "No target players found!", "warning")
            return false
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            local resultValue3 = handleAction(playerCustomizer)
            if not resultValue3 then
                showNotification("Skin Changer", "Utente non trovato: " .. tostring(playerCustomizer), "warning")
                return
            end
            local sum = 0
            for _, player in ipairs(resultValue2) do
                _G.VD_SpoofedSkins[player.UserId] = resultValue3
                _G.VD_SpoofedSkins[player.Name] = resultValue3
                local characterValue = player.Character
                if characterValue then
                    local succeeded, result = pcall(function()
                        return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceAsync(resultValue3)
                    end)
                    if succeeded and result then
                        handleAction4(result, characterValue)
                        pcall(function()
                            result:Destroy()
                        end)
                        sum = sum + 1
                    else
                        local succeeded2, result2 = pcall(function()
                            return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceInfoAsync(resultValue3)
                        end)
                        if succeeded2 and result2 then
                            handleAction3(result2, characterValue)
                            sum = sum + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            showNotification(
                "Skin Changer",
                string.format("Skin applied to %d player(s)! (ID: %s)", sum, tostring(resultValue3)),
                "success"
            )
        end)
        return true
    end

    _G.VD_UpdateSurvivorHUD = function()
        pcall(function()
            local playerGui = localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            if not playerGui then
                return
            end
            local items = {}
            for _, childName in ipairs({
                "Survivor",
                "Survivor-con",
                "Survivor-mob",
                "SurvivorGui",
                "SpectatorHUD",
                "SpectatorHUD-con",
                "SpectatorHUD-mob",
            }) do
                local child = playerGui:FindFirstChild(childName)
                if child then
                    local bottomLeft = child:FindFirstChild("bottom left") or child:FindFirstChild("BottomLeft")
                    if bottomLeft then
                        local frame = bottomLeft:FindFirstChild("Frame")
                        if frame and not table.find(items, frame) then
                            table.insert(items, frame)
                        end
                    end
                    local frame = child:FindFirstChild("Frame", true)
                    if frame and (frame:FindFirstChild("Survivor1") or frame:FindFirstChild("Survivor2")) then
                        if not table.find(items, frame) then
                            table.insert(items, frame)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, item in ipairs(items) do
                for _, child in ipairs(item:GetChildren()) do
                    if
                        child:IsA("GuiObject")
                        and (
                            child.Name:sub(1, 8) == "Survivor"
                            or child:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
                            or child:FindFirstChildOfClass("ImageLabel")
                            or child:FindFirstChildOfClass("ViewportFrame")
                        )
                    then
                        local textLabel = child:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
                            or child:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
                            or child:FindFirstChild("TextLabel", true)
                            or child:FindFirstChild("Name", true)
                            or child:FindFirstChild("PlayerName", true)
                        local imageLabel = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("ImageLabel")
                            or child:FindFirstChild("ImageLabel", true)
                            or child:FindFirstChild("Avatar", true)
                            or child:FindFirstChild("Icon", true)
                        local viewportFrame = child:FindFirstChild("ViewportFrame")
                            or child:FindFirstChildOfClass("ViewportFrame")
                            or child:FindFirstChild("ViewportFrame", true)
                        local player = nil
                        local text = textLabel and textLabel.Text or ""
                        local vdOrigName = child:GetAttribute("VD_OrigName")
                        for _, player2 in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                            if
                                vdOrigName and (vdOrigName == player2.Name or vdOrigName == player2.DisplayName)
                                or text ~= "" and (text == player2.Name or text == player2.DisplayName)
                            then
                                player = player2
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if not player and viewportFrame then
                            local worldModel = viewportFrame:FindFirstChild("WorldModel")
                                or viewportFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("WorldModel")
                            if worldModel then
                                for _, child2 in ipairs(worldModel:GetChildren()) do
                                    if child2:IsA("Model") then
                                        local child = Players:FindFirstChild(child2.Name)
                                        if child then
                                            player = child
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if not player and imageLabel and imageLabel.Image then
                            local match = imageLabel.Image:match("userId=(%d+)") or imageLabel.Image:match("id=(%d+)")
                            if match then
                                for _, player2 in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                                    if tostring(player2.UserId) == match then
                                        player = player2
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if not player and child.Name == "Survivor1" then
                            player = localPlayer
                        end
                        local text2 = nil
                        if player then
                            text2 = _G.VD_SpoofedNames
                                and (_G.VD_SpoofedNames[player.UserId] or _G.VD_SpoofedNames[player.Name])
                        end
                        if (not text2 or text2 == "") and (player == localPlayer or child.Name == "Survivor1") then
                            if
                                featureSettings
                                and featureSettings.PlayerCustomizer
                                and featureSettings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedName
                                and featureSettings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedName ~= ""
                            then
                                text2 = featureSettings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedName
                            end
                        end
                        if (not text2 or text2 == "") and featureSettings and featureSettings.StreamerMode then
                            if player == localPlayer or child.Name == "Survivor1" then
                                text2 = "Anonymous User"
                            else
                                local match = child.Name:match("%d+") or "X"
                                text2 = "Survivor " .. match
                            end
                        end
                        if textLabel then
                            if text2 and text2 ~= "" then
                                if not child:GetAttribute("VD_OrigName") then
                                    child:SetAttribute("VD_OrigName", textLabel.Text)
                                end
                                if textLabel.Text ~= text2 then
                                    textLabel.Text = text2
                                end
                            else
                                local vdOrigName2 = child:GetAttribute("VD_OrigName")
                                if vdOrigName2 and vdOrigName2 ~= "" then
                                    textLabel.Text = vdOrigName2
                                    child:SetAttribute("VD_OrigName", nil)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        local image = nil
                        if player then
                            image = _G.VD_SpoofedIcons
                                and (_G.VD_SpoofedIcons[player.UserId] or _G.VD_SpoofedIcons[player.Name])
                        end
                        if (not image or image == "") and (player == localPlayer or child.Name == "Survivor1") then
                            if
                                featureSettings
                                and featureSettings.PlayerCustomizer
                                and featureSettings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedIcon
                                and featureSettings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedIcon ~= ""
                            then
                                image = featureSettings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedIcon
                            elseif featureSettings and featureSettings.StreamerMode then
                                image = "rbxassetid://0"
                            end
                        end
                        if image and image ~= "" then
                            if tonumber(image) and not string.find(image, "://") then
                                image = "rbxassetid://" .. image
                            end
                        end
                        if image and image ~= "" then
                            if imageLabel then
                                if not child:GetAttribute("VD_OrigIcon") then
                                    child:SetAttribute("VD_OrigIcon", imageLabel.Image)
                                end
                                if imageLabel.Image ~= image then
                                    imageLabel.Image = image
                                end
                            end
                            if viewportFrame then
                                local vdSpoofIcon = viewportFrame:FindFirstChild("VD_SpoofIcon")
                                if not vdSpoofIcon then
                                    vdSpoofIcon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                                    vdSpoofIcon.Name = "VD_SpoofIcon"
                                    vdSpoofIcon.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                                    vdSpoofIcon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
                                    vdSpoofIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                                    vdSpoofIcon.ZIndex = 25
                                    local uiCorner = viewportFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
                                    if uiCorner then
                                        local clone = uiCorner:Clone()
                                        clone.Parent = vdSpoofIcon
                                    end
                                    vdSpoofIcon.Parent = viewportFrame
                                end
                                if vdSpoofIcon.Image ~= image then
                                    vdSpoofIcon.Image = image
                                end
                                vdSpoofIcon.Visible = true
                            end
                        else
                            if imageLabel then
                                local vdOrigIcon = child:GetAttribute("VD_OrigIcon")
                                if vdOrigIcon and vdOrigIcon ~= "" then
                                    imageLabel.Image = vdOrigIcon
                                    child:SetAttribute("VD_OrigIcon", nil)
                                end
                            end
                            if viewportFrame then
                                local vdSpoofIcon = viewportFrame:FindFirstChild("VD_SpoofIcon")
                                if vdSpoofIcon then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        vdSpoofIcon:Destroy()
                                    end)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    _G.VD_ApplyNameToTarget = function(resultValue, displayName)
        displayName = displayName
            or featureSettings and featureSettings.PlayerCustomizer and featureSettings.PlayerCustomizer.SpoofedName
            or ""
        if not displayName or displayName == "" then
            showNotification("Name Changer", "Please enter a valid name!", "warning")
            return false
        end
        local resultValue2 = _G.VD_GetTargetPlayers(resultValue)
        if #resultValue2 == 0 then
            showNotification("Name Changer", "No target players found!", "warning")
            return false
        end
        for _, player in ipairs(resultValue2) do
            _G.VD_SpoofedNames[player.UserId] = displayName
            _G.VD_SpoofedNames[player.Name] = displayName
            local characterValue = player.Character
            if characterValue then
                local humanoid = characterValue:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if humanoid then
                    pcall(function()
                        humanoid.DisplayName = displayName
                    end)
                end
                local head = characterValue:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if head then
                    for _, descendant in ipairs(head:GetDescendants()) do
                        if
                            descendant:IsA("TextLabel")
                            and (descendant.Text == player.Name or descendant.Text == player.DisplayName)
                        then
                            descendant.Text = displayName
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if _G.VD_UpdateSpectatorListOverlay then
            pcall(_G.VD_UpdateSpectatorListOverlay)
        end
        if _G.VD_UpdateInfoBanner then
            pcall(_G.VD_UpdateInfoBanner)
        end
        if _G.VD_UpdateSurvivorHUD then
            pcall(_G.VD_UpdateSurvivorHUD)
        end
        showNotification(
            "Name Changer",
            string.format("Name spoofed to '%s' for %d player(s)!", displayName, #resultValue2),
            "success"
        )
        return true
    end

task.spawn(function()
    local function callback(resultValue)
        resultValue.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(resultValue2)
            if
                _G.VD_SpoofedSkins
                and _G.VD_SpoofedSkins[resultValue.UserId]
                and featureSettings.SkinChangerAutoReapply ~= false
            then
                task.wait(0.6)
                pcall(function()
                    local resultValue3 = _G.VD_SpoofedSkins[resultValue.UserId]
                    if resultValue3 and resultValue2 and resultValue2.Parent then
                        local succeeded, result = pcall(function()
                            return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceAsync(resultValue3)
                        end)
                        if succeeded and result then
                            applyAppearanceFromModel(result, resultValue2)
                            pcall(function()
                                result:Destroy()
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            if _G.VD_SpoofedNames and _G.VD_SpoofedNames[resultValue.UserId] then
                task.wait(0.3)
                pcall(function()
                    local displayName = _G.VD_SpoofedNames[resultValue.UserId]
                    local humanoid = resultValue2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if humanoid then
                        humanoid.DisplayName = displayName
                    end
                end)
            end
            if
                featureSettings.CustomParticles
                and featureSettings.CustomParticles.Enabled
                and _G.VD_UpdateCustomParticles
            then
                task.wait(0.5)
                pcall(_G.VD_UpdateCustomParticles)
            end
        end)
    end
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        callback(player)
    end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(callback)
end)

            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

                    local vdCustomParticleEmitter = player.Character:FindFirstChild("VD_CustomParticleEmitter", true)
                    if vdCustomParticleEmitter then

            task.wait(0.5)
        end

do
    local connection = nil
    function stopCustomEmote()
        if connection then
            pcall(function()
                connection:Disconnect()
            end)
            connection = nil
        end
        if currentEmoteTrack then
            pcall(function()
                currentEmoteTrack:Stop(0.2)
            end)
            currentEmoteTrack = nil
        end
        if currentEmoteSound then
            pcall(function()
                currentEmoteSound:Stop()
                currentEmoteSound:Destroy()
            end)
            currentEmoteSound = nil
        end
        pcall(function()
            local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            local emoteHandler = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("EmoteHandler")
            if emoteHandler then
                emoteHandler:FireServer("StopEmote")
            end
        end)
    end
    function playCustomEmote(resultValue, argument)
        stopCustomEmote()
        local characterValue = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
        local humanoid = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local animator = humanoid and (humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or humanoid)
        if not animator then
            showNotification("Animation Player", "Character Animator not found!", "error")
            return
        end
        local match = tostring(resultValue):match("%d+") or tostring(resultValue)
        local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
        animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. match
        local succeeded, result = pcall(function()
            return animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
        end)
        if not succeeded or not result then
            showNotification("Animation Player", "Failed to load emote: " .. tostring(argument), "error")
            return
        end
        currentEmoteTrack = result
        result.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
        result:Play(0.2)
        pcall(function()
            local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            local emoteHandler = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("EmoteHandler")
            if emoteHandler then
                emoteHandler:FireServer(argument)
            end
        end)
        showNotification("Animation Player", argument, "info")
        if not (featureSettings.WalkWhileEmoting == true) then
            connection = registerConnection(humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MoveDirection"):Connect(function()
                if humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 and currentEmoteTrack == result then
                    stopCustomEmote()
                end
            end))
        end
        result.Stopped:Connect(function()
            if currentEmoteTrack == result then
                stopCustomEmote()
            end
        end)
    end
end

            end

            end

buildEspTab()
local function buildFarmTab()
    _G.VD_FarmStatusLabel = nil
    _G.VD_SetFarmToggle = nil
    _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle = nil
    _G.VD_SetTotalAFKToggle = nil
    _G.VD_SetHopEscapeToggle = nil
    _G.VD_SetInstantEscapeToggle = nil
    _G.VD_DoCancelGen = nil
    do
        createSection(tabFarm, "Survivor Automations", UI.Accent)
        local autoFarmSurvivor = createCollapsibleToggle(
            tabFarm,
            "Survivor Auto Farm",
            featureSettings.AutoFarmSurvivor,
            function(autoFarmSurvivor)
                if autoFarmSurvivor then
                    if featureSettings.AutoFarmAFKTotal then
                        featureSettings.AutoFarmAFKTotal = false
                        if _G.VD_SetTotalAFKToggle then
                            _G.VD_SetTotalAFKToggle(false)
                        end
                    end
                    if featureSettings.AutoServerHopEscape then
                        featureSettings.AutoServerHopEscape = false
                        if _G.VD_SetHopEscapeToggle then
                            _G.VD_SetHopEscapeToggle(false)
                        end
                    end
                    if featureSettings.InstantFinishlineEscape then
                        featureSettings.InstantFinishlineEscape = false
                        if _G.VD_SetInstantEscapeToggle then
                            _G.VD_SetInstantEscapeToggle(false)
                        end
                    end
                end
                featureSettings.AutoFarmSurvivor = autoFarmSurvivor
                if autoFarmSurvivor then
                    _G.VD_FarmState.farmTeamStartTime = tick()
                    _G.VD_FarmState.farmLastTeamName = ""
                    _G.VD_AbortPathfinding = false
                    showNotification("Auto Farm Enabled", "Starting automatic generator repairs.", "success")
                else
                    _G.VD_AbortPathfinding = true
                    pcall(function()
                        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game)
                    end)
                    local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
                    local humanoid = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if humanoid then
                        pcall(function()
                            humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
                            humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
                        end)
                    end
                    if _G.VD_ExitSubSurfacePocket then
                        pcall(_G.VD_ExitSubSurfacePocket)
                    end
                    showNotification("Auto Farm Disabled", "Stopped survivor autofarm immediately.", "info")
                end
                pcall(saveSettings)
            end,
            UI.Accent,
            "AutoFarmSurvivor"
        )
        _G.VD_SetFarmToggle = autoFarmSurvivor.setValue
        _G.VD_SetFarmToggle = _G.VD_SetFarmToggle
        controlRegistry.AutoFarmSurvivor = autoFarmSurvivor
        local autoFarmUnhookSurvivors = createToggle(
            autoFarmSurvivor.content,
            "Unhook Other Survivors",
            featureSettings.AutoFarmUnhookSurvivors,
            function(autoFarmUnhookSurvivors)
                featureSettings.AutoFarmUnhookSurvivors = autoFarmUnhookSurvivors

        local autoFarmTwistOfFate = createToggle(

        controlRegistry.AutoFarmTwistOfFate = autoFarmTwistOfFate
        local autoFarmPathfinding = createToggle(

            function(autoFarmPathfinding)
                featureSettings.AutoFarmPathfinding = autoFarmPathfinding

            end,

        local autoServerHopEscape = createToggle(

                if autoServerHopEscape then

                            _G.VD_SetFarmToggle(false)

        _G.VD_SetTotalAFKToggle = autoFarmAFKTotal.setValue
        _G.VD_SetTotalAFKToggle = _G.VD_SetTotalAFKToggle
        controlRegistry.AutoFarmAFKTotal = autoFarmAFKTotal
        performInstantEscape = function()
            local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
            local humanoidRootPart = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not humanoidRootPart then
                showNotification("Escape Failed", "Character root part not found!", "error")
                return false
            end
            if premiumCapabilities and type(premiumCapabilities.InstantEscape) == "function" then
                premiumCapabilities.InstantEscape(humanoidRootPart, showNotification)
                return true
            else
                local part = nil
                local huge = math.huge
                for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if
                        descendant:IsA("BasePart")
                        and (
                            descendant.Name == "Fininshline"
                            or descendant.Name == "Finishline"
                            or descendant.Name:lower():find("finishline")
                            or descendant.Name:lower():find("fininshline")
                        )
                    then
                        local distance = (descendant.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                        if distance < huge then
                            huge = distance
                            part = descendant
                        end
                    end
                end
                if part then
                    if _G.VD_StopAllInteractions then
                        pcall(_G.VD_StopAllInteractions)
                        task.wait(0.15)
                    end
                    if featureSettings.AutoFarmPathfinding and _G.VD_SmartWalkTo then
                        _G.VD_SmartWalkTo(part.Position, 3)
                    else
                        safeSegmentedTeleport(humanoidRootPart, part.CFrame)
                    end
                    showNotification("Instant Escape", "Teleported to escape line!", "success")
                    return true
                else
                    showNotification("Instant Escape", "Finish Line not found!", "error")
                    return false
                end
            end
        end
        local instantFinishlineEscape = createToggle(
