            "Instant Finishline Escape",

                end

            end,

            "AutoPumpkin"

            collapsibleToggle.content,

            UI.Accent
        )
        controlRegistry.NoSkillChecks = createToggle(
            collapsibleToggle.content,
            "No Skill Checks (Remove Checks)",
            featureSettings.NoSkillChecks,
            function(noSkillChecks)
                if noSkillChecks and not hasPremiumAccess("NoSkillChecks") then
                    showNotification("Premium Feature +", "Unlock the Premium version to use this feature!", "warning")
                    if controlRegistry.NoSkillChecks and controlRegistry.NoSkillChecks.setValue then
                        controlRegistry.NoSkillChecks.setValue(false)
                    end
                    return
                end
                featureSettings.NoSkillChecks = noSkillChecks
                pcall(saveSettings)
                local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
                if characterValue then
                    if noSkillChecks then
                        if _G.VD_StashSkillchecks then
                            pcall(_G.VD_StashSkillchecks)
                        end
                    else
                        if _G.VD_RestoreSkillchecks then
                            pcall(_G.VD_RestoreSkillchecks)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end,
            UI.Accent,
            "NoSkillChecks"
        )
        createSection(tabFarm, "Killer Automations", UI.Accent)
        local autoFarmKiller = createToggle(
            tabFarm,
            "Killer Auto Farm",
            featureSettings.AutoFarmKiller,
            function(autoFarmKiller)
                if autoFarmKiller then
                    if featureSettings.AutoFarmAFKTotal then
                        featureSettings.AutoFarmAFKTotal = false
                        if _G.VD_SetTotalAFKToggle then
                            _G.VD_SetTotalAFKToggle(false)
                        end
                    end
                    if featureSettings.AutoServerHopEscape then
                        featureSettings.AutoServerHopEscape = false

                            _G.VD_SetHopEscapeToggle(false)
                        end

                        featureSettings.InstantFinishlineEscape = false
                        if _G.VD_SetInstantEscapeToggle then
                            _G.VD_SetInstantEscapeToggle(false)
                        end
                    end
                end

                    _G.VD_FarmState.farmTeamStartTime = tick()
                    _G.VD_FarmState.farmLastTeamName = ""
                    showNotification("Killer Auto Farm Enabled", "Starting automatic survivor hunting.", "success")
                end
                pcall(saveSettings)
            end,
            UI.Accent,
            "KillerAutoFarm"
        )
        _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle = autoFarmKiller.setValue
        _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle = _G.VD_SetKillerFarmToggle
        controlRegistry.AutoFarmKiller = autoFarmKiller
        local antiWiggle = createToggle(
            tabFarm,
            "Anti Wiggle (Auto-Drop Survivor)",
            featureSettings.AntiWiggle,
            function(antiWiggle)
                if not hasPremiumAccess() then
                    showNotification("Premium Feature +", "Unlock the Premium version to use this feature!", "warning")
                    return
                end
                featureSettings.AntiWiggle = antiWiggle
                if antiWiggle and hasPremiumAccess() then
                    showNotification(
                        "Anti Wiggle Enabled",
                        "Will auto-drop survivors right before wiggle escapes.",

                    )
                end

            end,

            "AntiWiggle"
        )

        controlRegistry.AntiWiggle = antiWiggle
        createSection(tabFarm, "Telemetry & State", UI.Accent)
        local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
        frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
        frame.Parent = tabFarm

        uiStroke.Color = UI.StrokeDim
        uiStroke.Thickness = 0.8
        _G.VD_FarmStatusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        _G.VD_FarmStatusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
        _G.VD_FarmStatusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
        _G.VD_FarmStatusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1

        _G.VD_FarmStatusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
        _G.VD_FarmStatusLabel.TextSize = 11.5
        _G.VD_FarmStatusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        _G.VD_FarmStatusLabel.Parent = frame
    end

                    local name = team and team.Name
                    local modifierTeamFilter = featureSettings.ModifierTeamFilter or "Both"
                    local matchesCondition = false
                    if modifierTeamFilter == "Both" then
                        matchesCondition = name == "Survivors" or name == "Killer"
                    elseif modifierTeamFilter == "Survivors" then
                        matchesCondition = name == "Survivors"
                    elseif modifierTeamFilter == "Killer" then
                        matchesCondition = name == "Killer"

                    if not matchesCondition then
                        featureSettings.SpeedBoostEnabled = false
                        pcall(saveSettings)
                        if applySettingsToControls then
                            pcall(applySettingsToControls)
                        end
                        showNotification("Speed Boost", "Speed Boost team filter active!", "warning")
                        return
                    end
                end
                featureSettings.SpeedBoostEnabled = speedBoostEnabled
                pcall(applyLocalPlayerModifiers)
                pcall(saveSettings)
            end,
            nil,
            "ToggleSpeedBoost"
        )

        local function handleAction4()
            local items = {}
            pcall(function()
                local spectator = localPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Spectator")
                local inventory = spectator and spectator:FindFirstChild("Inventory", true)
                local browseItems = inventory and inventory:FindFirstChild("Browse_items", true)
                local loadout = browseItems and browseItems:FindFirstChild("loadout", true)
                local perks = loadout and loadout:FindFirstChild("Perks", true)
                if perks then
                    for _, child in ipairs(perks:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Name ~= "UIListLayout" and child.Name ~= "UIGridLayout" then
                            table.insert(items, child.Name)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            if #items == 0 then
                items = {
                    "Group Project",
                    "No Pain No Gain",
                    "On Screen Fear",
                    "Flowstate",
                    "Adrenaline",
                    "Sprint Burst",
                    "Self Care",
                    "Decisive Strike",
                    "Dead Hard",
                    "Iron Will",
                    "Resilience",
                    "Prove Thyself",
                    "Kindred",
                    "Spine Chill",
                    "Urban Evasion",
                    "Borrowed Time",
                    "We're Gonna Live Forever",
                    "Blast Mine",
                    "Flashbang",
                }
            end
            table.sort(items)
            return items
        end
        local function handleAction5(resultValue)
            if not resultValue then
                return
            end
            local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            remotes = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Shop")
            remotes = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("UnequipPerk")
            local remotes2 = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            remotes2 = remotes2 and remotes2:FindFirstChild("Shop")
            remotes2 = remotes2 and remotes2:FindFirstChild("EquipPerk")
            if not remotes or not remotes2 then
                showNotification("Perk Loadouts", "Shop remotes not found! Make sure you are in game.", "error")
                return
            end
            pcall(function()
                remotes:FireServer(3)
                task.wait(0.05)
                remotes:FireServer(2)
                task.wait(0.05)
                remotes:FireServer(1)
                task.wait(0.05)
                if resultValue.Perk3 and resultValue.Perk3 ~= "None" and resultValue.Perk3 ~= "" then
                    remotes2:FireServer(resultValue.Perk3, 3)
                    task.wait(0.05)
                end
                if resultValue.Perk2 and resultValue.Perk2 ~= "None" and resultValue.Perk2 ~= "" then
                    remotes2:FireServer(resultValue.Perk2, 2)
                    task.wait(0.05)
                end
                if resultValue.Perk1 and resultValue.Perk1 ~= "None" and resultValue.Perk1 ~= "" then
                    remotes2:FireServer(resultValue.Perk1, 1)
                    task.wait(0.05)
                end
                showNotification("Perk Loadouts", "Loadout applied successfully!", "success")
            end)
        end

                end
            end
            table.sort(items2)

            end

        end

        local selector4 = nil

                showNotification("Perk Loadouts", "Please enter a valid loadout name!", "warning")

            end

        selector4 = createSelector(
            collapsibleGroup.content,
            "Select Saved Loadout",
            resultValue2,

        local function getRootPart()

        local enabled = false
        local transform = nil
        local function doAutoUnhook()
            local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
            local humanoidRootPart = characterValue
                and (characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or characterValue:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
            local humanoid = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not humanoidRootPart or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                showNotification("Auto Unhook", "Character not found or dead!", "error")
                return
            end
            if enabled then
                enabled = false
                if transform and humanoidRootPart and humanoidRootPart.Parent then
                    humanoidRootPart.CFrame = transform
                    humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                end
                showNotification("Auto Unhook", "Auto Unhook cancelled! Returned to hook.", "warning")
                return
            end
            transform = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
            enabled = true
            showNotification("Auto Unhook", "Starting Auto Unhook sequence...", "info")
            task.spawn(function()
                local succeeded, result = pcall(function()
                    local item = nil
                    local items2 = {}
                    for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                        if
                            descendant:IsA("Model")
                            and (descendant.Name == "Generator" or descendant.Name:find("Generator"))
                        then
                            table.insert(items2, descendant)
                        end
                    end
                    for _, item2 in ipairs(items2) do
                        local mainPart = item2:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
                            or item2:FindFirstChild("Engine")
                            or item2:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                        if mainPart then
                            item = item2
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    local replicatedStorageService = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
                    local remotes = replicatedStorageService:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                    local generator = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Generator")
                    local repairEvent = generator and generator:FindFirstChild("RepairEvent")
                        or replicatedStorageService:FindFirstChild("RepairEvent", true)
                    if item then
                        local mainPart = item:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
                            or item:FindFirstChild("Engine")
                            or item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                        if mainPart then
                            humanoidRootPart.CFrame = mainPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
                            humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                            task.wait(0.2)
                        end
                        local child = nil
                        for _, child2 in ipairs(item:GetChildren()) do
                            if child2.Name:lower():find("point") then
                                child = child2
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if repairEvent and child then
                            local httpServiceService = game:GetService("HttpService")
                            local guid = "FEB67C57-1E59-4609-B765-6304242AC088"
                            pcall(function()
                                guid = httpServiceService:GenerateGUID(false)
                            end)
                            local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
                            pcall(function()
                                repairEvent:FireServer(child, true, nil, guid, characterValue)
                            end)
                            task.wait(0.25)
                            pcall(function()
                                repairEvent:FireServer(child, false, nil, guid, characterValue)
                            end)
                            task.wait(0.2)
                        end
                    end
                    local function handleAction()
                        local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
                        local anticampCharge = nil
                        if characterValue then
                            anticampCharge = characterValue:GetAttribute("anticampCharge")
                                or characterValue:GetAttribute("AntiCampCharge")
                                or characterValue:GetAttribute("AnticampCharge")
                                or characterValue:GetAttribute("antiCampCharge")
                        end
                        if anticampCharge == nil then
                            anticampCharge = localPlayer:GetAttribute("anticampCharge")
                                or localPlayer:GetAttribute("AntiCampCharge")
                                or localPlayer:GetAttribute("AnticampCharge")
                                or localPlayer:GetAttribute("antiCampCharge")
                        end
                        if anticampCharge == nil and characterValue then
                            local anticampCharge2 = characterValue:FindFirstChild("anticampCharge", true)
                                or characterValue:FindFirstChild("AntiCampCharge", true)
                            if anticampCharge2 and anticampCharge2:IsA("ValueObject") then
                                anticampCharge = anticampCharge2.Value
                            end
                        end
                        return tonumber(anticampCharge) or 0
                    end
                    local timestamp = tick()
                    local numberValue = 60
                    local integerValue = -1
                    while enabled and tick() - timestamp < numberValue do
                        local resultValue = handleAction()
                        if resultValue >= 100 then
                            break
                        end
                        local integerValue2 = math.floor(resultValue)
                        if integerValue2 % 25 == 0 and integerValue2 ~= integerValue and integerValue2 > 0 then
                            integerValue = integerValue2
                            showNotification(
                                "Auto Unhook",
                                string.format("Charging Anti-Camp: %d%%", integerValue2),
                                "info"
                            )
                        end
                        local humanoidRootPart2 = nil
                        if getKillerCharacters then
                            local killerCharacters = getKillerCharacters()
                            if killerCharacters and #killerCharacters > 0 then
                                for _, item in ipairs(killerCharacters) do
                                    local humanoidRootPart = item
                                        and (item:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or item:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
                                    if humanoidRootPart then
                                        humanoidRootPart2 = humanoidRootPart
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if not humanoidRootPart2 then
                            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                                if player ~= localPlayer and player.Character then
                                    local characterValue = player.Character
                                    local matchesCondition = player:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer"
                                        or player:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true
                                        or characterValue:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer"
                                        or characterValue:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true
                                    if not matchesCondition and player.Team then
                                        local lowercaseText = player.Team.Name:lower()
                                        if
                                            lowercaseText:find("killer")
                                            or lowercaseText:find("slasher")
                                            or lowercaseText:find("monster")
                                        then
                                            matchesCondition = true
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if matchesCondition then
                                        humanoidRootPart2 = characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                            or characterValue:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                                            or characterValue:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                                        if humanoidRootPart2 then
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if humanoidRootPart2 and humanoidRootPart and humanoidRootPart.Parent then
                            humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(humanoidRootPart2.Position - Vector3.new(0, 16, 0))
                            humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                        end
                        task.wait(0.06)
                    end
                    if humanoidRootPart and humanoidRootPart.Parent and transform then
                        humanoidRootPart.CFrame = transform
                        humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                        task.wait(0.2)
                    end
                    local selfUnHookEvent = nil
                    pcall(function()
                        local carry = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Carry")
                        selfUnHookEvent = carry and carry:FindFirstChild("SelfUnHookEvent")
                        if not selfUnHookEvent then
                            selfUnHookEvent = replicatedStorageService:FindFirstChild("SelfUnHookEvent", true)
                        end
                    end)
                    if selfUnHookEvent then
                        selfUnHookEvent:FireServer()
                        showNotification("Auto Unhook", "Self-Unhook event executed successfully!", "success")
                    else
                        showNotification("Auto Unhook", "SelfUnHookEvent not found in Remotes!", "error")
                    end
                end)
                enabled = false
                if not succeeded then
                    showNotification("Auto Unhook", "Error: " .. tostring(result), "error")
                end
            end)
        end
        _G.doAutoUnhook = doAutoUnhook
        controlRegistry.AutoSelfUnhook = createButton(tabSelf, "Auto Unhook", "Trigger", function()
            if doAutoUnhook then
                pcall(doAutoUnhook)
            end
        end, UI.Accent, "AutoSelfUnhook")

        local function handleAction8()
            local part = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not part then
                return nil
            end
            local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
            raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
            local filterDescendantsInstances = {}
            for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
                if pallet and pallet.Parent then
                    table.insert(filterDescendantsInstances, pallet)
                end
            end
            raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
            local position = part.CFrame.Position
            local scaledValue = part.CFrame.LookVector * 500
            local raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(position, scaledValue, raycastParams)
            if raycastResult and raycastResult.Instance then
                local instance = raycastResult.Instance
                local parent = instance
                while parent and parent ~= workspace do
                    if table.find(cachedPallets, parent) then
                        return parent
                    end
                    parent = parent.Parent
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function handleAction9()
            if not featureSettings.RemoteDropPallet then
                if remotePalletHighlight then
                    pcall(function()
                        remotePalletHighlight:Destroy()
                    end)
                    remotePalletHighlight = nil
                end
                return
            end
            local adornee = handleAction8()
            if adornee then
                local fillColor = featureSettings.RemoteDropPalletColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
                if not remotePalletHighlight or remotePalletHighlight.Parent == nil then
                    pcall(function()
                        if remotePalletHighlight then
                            remotePalletHighlight:Destroy()
                        end
                    end)
                    remotePalletHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    remotePalletHighlight.Name = "VD_PalletTargetHighlight"
                    remotePalletHighlight.FillColor = fillColor
                    remotePalletHighlight.FillTransparency = 0.6
                    remotePalletHighlight.OutlineColor = fillColor
                    remotePalletHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
                else
                    remotePalletHighlight.FillColor = fillColor
                    remotePalletHighlight.OutlineColor = fillColor
                end
                if remotePalletHighlight.Adornee ~= adornee then
                    remotePalletHighlight.Adornee = adornee
                    remotePalletHighlight.Parent = adornee
                end
            else
                if remotePalletHighlight then
                    remotePalletHighlight.Adornee = nil
                    remotePalletHighlight.Parent = nil
                end
            end
        end
        local function handleAction10()
            if not featureSettings.RemoteDropPallet then
                return
            end
            local resultValue5 = handleAction8()
            if not resultValue5 then
                showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "No pallet targeted!", "warning")
                return
            end
            local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            local pallet = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Pallet")
            local palletDropEvent = pallet and pallet:FindFirstChild("PalletDropEvent")
            if not palletDropEvent then
                showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "PalletDropEvent remote not found!", "error")
                return
            end
            local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
            local humanoidRootPart = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not humanoidRootPart then
                showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "Character root not found!", "error")
                return
            end
            local intact = resultValue5:FindFirstChild("Intact")
            if not intact then
                showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "Pallet already dropped or broken!", "warning")
                return
            end
            local children = intact:GetChildren()
            local basePart = children[8] and children[8]:IsA("BasePart") and children[8]
                or intact:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                or children[1] and children[1]:IsA("BasePart") and children[1]
                or resultValue5:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                or resultValue5:IsA("Model") and resultValue5.PrimaryPart
            if not basePart then
                showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "No valid pallet part found!", "error")
                return
            end
            local position = basePart.Position
            local distance = (humanoidRootPart.Position - position).Magnitude
            local guid = game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
            local enabled2 = false
            if distance <= 14 then
                pcall(function()
                    _G.VD_LastRemoteDropTime = tick()
                    palletDropEvent:FireServer(basePart, position, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), guid, characterValue)
                    enabled2 = true
                end)
            else
                local transform2 = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
                local sum = position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
                safeSegmentedTeleport(humanoidRootPart, sum)
                task.wait(0.05)
                pcall(function()
                    _G.VD_LastRemoteDropTime = tick()
                    palletDropEvent:FireServer(basePart, position, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), guid, characterValue)
                    enabled2 = true
                end)
                task.wait(0.08)
                safeSegmentedTeleport(humanoidRootPart, transform2)
            end
            if enabled2 then
                showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "Pallet dropped remotely!", "success")
            else
                showNotification("Remote Drop Pallet", "Failed to drop pallet (already dropped?)", "warning")
            end
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            while activeLoop do
                if featureSettings.RemoteDropPallet then
                    pcall(handleAction9)
                    task.wait(0.05)
                else
                    if remotePalletHighlight then
                        pcall(function()
                            remotePalletHighlight:Destroy()
                        end)
                        remotePalletHighlight = nil
                    end
                    task.wait(0.5)
                end
            end
        end)
        local function handleAction11()
            local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            local pallet = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Pallet")
            local palletDropEvent = pallet and pallet:FindFirstChild("PalletDropEvent")
            if not palletDropEvent then
                showNotification("Drop Pallets", "PalletDropEvent remote not found!", "error")
                return
            end
            local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
            local humanoidRootPart = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not humanoidRootPart then
                showNotification("Drop Pallets", "Character root not found!", "error")
                return
            end
            local sum = 0
            local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
            local resources = map and map:FindFirstChild("resources")
            local pallets = resources and resources:FindFirstChild("Pallets")
            local items2 = {}
            if pallets then
                for _, child in ipairs(pallets:GetChildren()) do
                    table.insert(items2, child)
                end
            end
            for _, pallet2 in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
                if not table.find(items2, pallet2) then
                    table.insert(items2, pallet2)
                end
            end
            local httpServiceService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            local transform2 = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
            task.spawn(function()
                for _, item in ipairs(items2) do
                    if item and item.Parent then
                        local intact = item:FindFirstChild("Intact")
                        if intact then
                            local children = intact:GetChildren()
                            local basePart = children[8] and children[8]:IsA("BasePart") and children[8]
                                or intact:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                                or children[1] and children[1]:IsA("BasePart") and children[1]
                                or item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                                or item:IsA("Model") and item.PrimaryPart
                            if basePart then
                                local position = basePart.Position
                                local distance = (humanoidRootPart.Position - position).Magnitude
                                if distance > 14 then
                                    safeSegmentedTeleport(humanoidRootPart, position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
                                    task.wait(0.04)
                                end
                                local guid = httpServiceService:GenerateGUID(false)
                                pcall(function()
                                    _G.VD_LastRemoteDropTime = tick()
                                    palletDropEvent:FireServer(
                                        basePart,
                                        position,
                                        Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
                                        guid,
                                        characterValue
                                    )
                                    sum = sum + 1
                                end)
                                task.wait(0.06)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if humanoidRootPart and humanoidRootPart.Parent then
                    safeSegmentedTeleport(humanoidRootPart, transform2)
                end
                if sum > 0 then
                    showNotification("Drop Pallets", "Dropped " .. sum .. " pallets successfully!", "success")
                else
                    showNotification("Drop Pallets", "No intact pallets found to drop!", "warning")
                end
            end)
        end

        do
            local enabled2 = false

            local function handleAction12()
                local items2 = {}
                local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") or workspace
                for _, descendant in ipairs(map:GetDescendants()) do
                    if
                        (descendant.Name == "VaultTrigger" or descendant.Name == "VaultPoint")
                        and descendant:IsA("BasePart")
                    then
                        table.insert(items2, descendant)
                    end
                end
                for _, vault in ipairs(cachedVaults) do
                    if vault and vault.Parent then
                        for _, descendant in ipairs(vault:GetDescendants()) do
                            if
                                (descendant.Name == "VaultTrigger" or descendant.Name == "VaultPoint")
                                and descendant:IsA("BasePart")
                                and not table.find(items2, descendant)
                            then
                                table.insert(items2, descendant)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return items2
            end
            local function handleAction()
                local items2 = {}
                for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
                    if pallet and pallet.Parent then
                        for _, descendant in ipairs(pallet:GetDescendants()) do
                            if descendant.Name == "PalletPointSlide" or descendant.Name:find("Slide") then
                                table.insert(items2, descendant)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") or workspace
                local resources = map:FindFirstChild("resources")
                local pallets = resources and resources:FindFirstChild("Pallets")
                if pallets then
                    for _, child in ipairs(pallets:GetChildren()) do
                        for _, descendant in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
                            if
                                (descendant.Name == "PalletPointSlide" or descendant.Name:find("Slide"))
                                and not table.find(items2, descendant)
                            then
                                table.insert(items2, descendant)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if getnilinstances then
                    pcall(function()
                        for _, getnilinstance in ipairs(getnilinstances()) do
                            if
                                getnilinstance
                                and (getnilinstance.Name == "PalletPointSlide" or getnilinstance.Name:find(
                                    "PalletPointSlide"
                                ))
                                and not table.find(items2, getnilinstance)
                            then
                                table.insert(items2, getnilinstance)
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
                return items2
            end
            local function handleAction2(resultValue5)
                local resultValue6 = handleAction12()
                local item, huge = nil, math.huge
                for _, item2 in ipairs(resultValue6) do
                    if item2 and item2.Parent then
                        local distance = (resultValue5 - item2.Position).Magnitude
                        if distance < huge then
                            huge = distance
                            item = item2
                        end
                    end
                end
                return item, huge
            end
            local function handleAction3(resultValue5)
                local resultValue6 = handleAction()
                local palletPointSlide, huge = nil, math.huge
                for _, item in ipairs(resultValue6) do
                    if item and item.Parent then
                        local position = item:IsA("BasePart") and item.Position
                            or item.Parent and item.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and item.Parent.Position
                        if position then
                            local distance = (resultValue5 - position).Magnitude
                            if distance < huge then
                                huge = distance
                                palletPointSlide = item
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not palletPointSlide then
                    for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
                        if pallet and pallet.Parent then
                            local basePart = pallet:IsA("Model") and pallet.PrimaryPart
                                or pallet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                            if basePart then
                                local distance = (resultValue5 - basePart.Position).Magnitude
                                if distance < huge then
                                    huge = distance
                                    palletPointSlide = pallet:FindFirstChild("PalletPointSlide", true) or basePart
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return palletPointSlide, huge
            end
            local function handleAction4()
                if enabled4 then
                    return
                end
                enabled4 = true
                task.spawn(function()
                    local httpServiceService = game:GetService("HttpService")
                    local replicatedStorageService = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
                    local remotes = replicatedStorageService:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                    local pallet = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Pallet")
                    local window = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Window")
                    local palletSlideEvent = pallet and pallet:FindFirstChild("PalletSlideEvent")
                    local vaultEvent = window and window:FindFirstChild("VaultEvent")
                    while (enabled2 or enabled3) and activeLoop do
                        local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
                        local humanoidRootPart = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if humanoidRootPart then
                            local position = humanoidRootPart.Position
                            if enabled2 and palletSlideEvent then
                                local resultValue = handleAction3(position)
                                if resultValue and resultValue.Parent then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        palletSlideEvent:FireServer(
                                            resultValue,
                                            true,
                                            httpServiceService:GenerateGUID(false),
                                            characterValue
                                        )
                                    end)
                                end
                            end
                            if enabled3 and vaultEvent then
                                local resultValue = handleAction2(position)
                                if resultValue and resultValue.Parent then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        vaultEvent:FireServer(
                                            resultValue,
                                            true,
                                            httpServiceService:GenerateGUID(false),
                                            characterValue,
                                            "fast"
                                        )
                                    end)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        task.wait(0.2)
                    end
                    enabled4 = false
                end)
            end

        do
            local dbdSoundsEnabled = createCollapsibleToggle(
                tabSelf,
                "DBD Sounds",
                featureSettings.DBDSounds and featureSettings.DBDSounds.Enabled or false,
                function(enabled2)
                    if enabled2 and not hasPremiumAccess("DBDSounds") then
                        showNotification(
                            "Premium Feature +",
                            "Unlock the Premium version to use this feature!",
                            "warning"
                        )
                        if dbdGroup and dbdGroup.setValue then
                            dbdGroup.setValue(false)
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    if not featureSettings.DBDSounds then
                        featureSettings.DBDSounds = {}
                    end
                    featureSettings.DBDSounds.Enabled = enabled2
                    pcall(saveSettings)
                    if enabled2 then
                        if _G.VD_DBD and not _G.VD_DBD.isCached() then
                            _G.VD_DBD.downloadAll()
                        end

        createSection(tabCombat, "Killers", UI.Accent)
        local collapsibleGroup = createCollapsibleGroup(tabCombat, "GENERAL", UI.Accent)
        local item = nil
        local afterAttack = nil
        local item2 = nil
        local timestamp = 0
        local enabled2 = false
        local characterValue = nil
        local function handleAction3()
            local characterValue2 = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
            if
                not characterValue2
                or not characterValue2:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                or not characterValue2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            then
                enabled2 = false
                return false
            end
            if item2 and item2.character == characterValue2 and item2.state then
                enabled2 = true
                return true
            end
            local timestamp2 = tick()
            if characterValue2 == characterValue and timestamp2 - timestamp < 0.5 then
                return enabled2
            end
            timestamp = timestamp2
            characterValue = characterValue2
            local team = localPlayer.Team
            if team then
                local lowercaseText = team.Name:lower()
                if
                    lowercaseText == "survivors"
                    or lowercaseText:find("survivor")
                    or lowercaseText:find("spectat")
                    or lowercaseText:find("lobby")
                then
                    enabled2 = false
                    return false
                end
                if
                    lowercaseText == "killer"
                    or lowercaseText == "killers"
                    or lowercaseText:find("killer")
                    or lowercaseText:find("slasher")
                then
                    enabled2 = true
                    return true
                end
            end
            if
                characterValue2:GetAttribute("Killer") == true
                or characterValue2:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer"
                or localPlayer:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer"
                or characterValue2:FindFirstChild("Machete")
                or characterValue2:FindFirstChild("Knife")
                or characterValue2:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
            then
                enabled2 = true
                return true
            end
            local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            if playerGui then
                for _, child in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("ScreenGui") then
                        local lowercaseText = child.Name:lower()
                        if
                            not lowercaseText:find("survivor")
                            and (
                                string.find(lowercaseText, "killer")
                                or string.find(lowercaseText, "slasher")
                                or string.find(lowercaseText, "stalker")
                                or string.find(lowercaseText, "hidden")
                                or string.find(lowercaseText, "abyss")
                                or string.find(lowercaseText, "cure")
                                or string.find(lowercaseText, "veil")
                            )
                        then
                            enabled2 = true
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            enabled2 = false
            return false
        end
        local function handleAction4()
            local replicatedStorageService = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
            local remotes = replicatedStorageService:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            if not remotes then
                return nil
            end
            local killers = remotes:FindFirstChild("Killers")
            if killers then
                local attack = killers:FindFirstChild("Attack")
                    or killers:FindFirstChild("BasicAttack")
                    or killers:FindFirstChild("Slash")
                if attack and attack:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                    return attack
                end
            end
            local attacks = remotes:FindFirstChild("Attacks")
            if attacks then
                local basicAttack = attacks:FindFirstChild("BasicAttack") or attacks:FindFirstChild("Attack")
                if basicAttack and basicAttack:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                    return basicAttack
                end
            end
            local basicAttack = remotes:FindFirstChild("BasicAttack") or remotes:FindFirstChild("Attack")
            if basicAttack and basicAttack:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                return basicAttack
            end
            return nil
        end
        local timestamp2 = 0
        local enabled3 = false
        local function handleAction5()
            if not hasPremiumAccess() then
                return
            end
            if not (featureSettings.GeneralKiller and featureSettings.GeneralKiller.DoubleTap) then
                return
            end
            if enabled3 then
                return
            end
            if not handleAction3() then
                return
            end
            local timestamp3 = tick()
            if timestamp3 - timestamp2 < 0.35 then
                return
            end
            timestamp2 = timestamp3
            enabled3 = true
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(0.05)
                pcall(function()
                    if not handleAction3() then
                        return
                    end
                    local resultValue = handleAction4()
                    if resultValue and resultValue:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                        resultValue:FireServer(false)
                    end
                end)
                task.wait(0.25)
                enabled3 = false
            end)
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                local replicatedStorageService = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
                local remotes = replicatedStorageService:WaitForChild("Remotes", 5)
                    and replicatedStorageService.Remotes:WaitForChild("Killers", 5)
                    and replicatedStorageService.Remotes.Killers:WaitForChild("SlowAttack", 5)
                if remotes and remotes:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                    registerConnection(remotes.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
                        if featureSettings.GeneralKiller and featureSettings.GeneralKiller.DoubleTap then
                            handleAction5()
                        end
                    end))
                end
            end)
        end)
        local timestamp3 = 0
        local enabled4 = false
        local sum = 0
        local characterValue2 = nil
        local function handleAction6(resultValue, argument, argument2, maxHold)
            if not resultValue or type(resultValue) ~= "table" then
                return
            end
            if rawget(resultValue, "_origMaxHold") == nil and resultValue.maxHold ~= math.huge then
                rawset(resultValue, "_origMaxHold", resultValue.maxHold)
            end
            local maxHold2 = rawget(resultValue, "_origMaxHold") or 0.6
            if argument then
                if argument2 == "Custom" or argument2 == "Custom Duration" then
                    resultValue.maxHold = maxHold
                else
                    resultValue.maxHold = math.huge
                end
            else
                resultValue.maxHold = maxHold2
            end
        end
        local function handleAction7(resultValue)
            if not resultValue then
                return
            end
            if rawget(resultValue, "_origCustom") == nil and rawget(resultValue, "_cdHooked") == nil then
                rawset(resultValue, "_origCustom", rawget(resultValue, "custom"))
            end
            local custom = rawget(resultValue, "_origCustom")
            local generalKiller = featureSettings.GeneralKiller or {}
            if hasPremiumAccess() and generalKiller.AttackCooldown then
                rawset(resultValue, "_cdHooked", true)
                resultValue.custom = function(resultValue2, argument, argument2, argument3)
                    if resultValue2 then
                        item2 = resultValue2
                    end
                    local generalKiller = featureSettings.GeneralKiller or {}
                    if
                        not hasPremiumAccess()
                        or not generalKiller.AttackCooldown
                        or resultValue2 and resultValue2.state and resultValue2.state.isTrueStunned
                    then
                        if custom then
                            return custom(resultValue2, argument, argument2, argument3)
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    local text = argument or "Nothing"
                    if text == "Parried" then
                        if custom then
                            return custom(resultValue2, argument, argument2, argument3)
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    if not resultValue2.afterAttackPlaying then
                        resultValue2.afterAttackPlaying = true
                        resultValue2.state.isStunned = true
                        resultValue2.state.canUpdateSpeed = false
                        if resultValue2.humanoid then
                            resultValue2.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
                        end
                        local scaledValue = 16
                        if resultValue2.character then
                            scaledValue = (resultValue2.character:GetAttribute("Speed") or 16)
                                * (resultValue2.character:GetAttribute("speedboost") or 1)
                        end
                        if resultValue2.humanoid then
                            resultValue2.humanoid.WalkSpeed = scaledValue * 0.1535
                        end
                        pcall(function()
                            if text == "Nothing" then
                                if resultValue2.stopAllAnimations then
                                    resultValue2.stopAllAnimations()
                                end
                                resultValue2.state.isAttacking = false
                            else
                                if resultValue2.stopAllAnimations then
                                    resultValue2.stopAllAnimations()
                                end
                                resultValue2.state.isAttacking = false
                                if text == "WallHitStun" and resultValue2.playAnimation then
                                    resultValue2.playAnimation("wallhitvm", true)
                                elseif text == "WipeMachete" and resultValue2.playAnimation then
                                    resultValue2.playAnimation("wipevm", true)
                                end
                                local animations = resultValue2.animations and resultValue2.animations[text]
                                if animations then
                                    animations:Play()
                                    animations:AdjustSpeed(argument2 or 1.5)
                                end
                            end
                        end)
                        local numberValue = tonumber(generalKiller.AttackCooldownTime) or 0.1
                        if numberValue > 0 then
                            task.wait(numberValue)
                        end
                        pcall(function()
                            if resultValue2.stopAllAnimations then
                                resultValue2.stopAllAnimations()
                            end
                            resultValue2.state.isStunned = false
                            resultValue2.state.isAttacking = false
                            resultValue2.state.attackCount = 0
                            if resultValue2.motherscript then
                                resultValue2.motherscript:SetAttribute("action", false)
                            end
                            if resultValue2.setAction then
                                resultValue2.setAction(false)
                            end
                            if
                                resultValue2.character
                                and not resultValue2.state.isTrueStunned
                                and resultValue2.humanoid
                            then
                                local walkSpeed = (resultValue2.character:GetAttribute("Speed") or 16)
                                    * (resultValue2.character:GetAttribute("speedboost") or 1)
                                resultValue2.humanoid.WalkSpeed = walkSpeed
                                resultValue2.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
                            end
                            resultValue2.state.canUpdateSpeed = true
                            resultValue2.afterAttackPlaying = false
                        end)
                    end
                end
            else
                if custom then
                    resultValue.custom = custom
                end
            end
        end
        local function callback(resultValue)
            local premiumAvailable2 = hasPremiumAccess()
            local generalKiller = featureSettings.GeneralKiller or {}
            local infiniteLunge = premiumAvailable2
                and (generalKiller.InfiniteLunge or featureSettings.Hidden and featureSettings.Hidden.InfiniteLunge)
            local lungeMode = generalKiller.LungeMode or "Infinite"
            local numberValue = tonumber(generalKiller.LungeDuration) or 2
            if item then
                handleAction6(item, infiniteLunge, lungeMode, numberValue)
            end
            if afterAttack then
                handleAction7(afterAttack)
            end
            if item2 and type(item2.afterAttack) == "table" then
                handleAction7(item2.afterAttack)
            end
            if not premiumAvailable2 or not (infiniteLunge or generalKiller.AttackCooldown) or not handleAction3() then
                return
            end
            local timestamp4 = tick()
            if enabled4 or not resultValue and timestamp4 - timestamp3 < 2.5 then
                return
            end
            timestamp3 = timestamp4
            enabled4 = true
            local characterValue3 = localPlayer and localPlayer.Character
            if getgc and characterValue3 then
                pcall(function()
                    local gc = getgc(true)
                    if not gc then
                        return
                    end
                    for _, item3 in ipairs(gc) do
                        if type(item3) == "table" then
                            if rawget(item3, "maxHold") ~= nil and rawget(item3, "lungeThreshold") ~= nil then
                                item = item3
                                handleAction6(item3, infiniteLunge, lungeMode, numberValue)
                            end
                            if
                                rawget(item3, "character") == characterValue3
                                and rawget(item3, "state") ~= nil
                                and rawget(item3, "humanoid") ~= nil
                                and (
                                    rawget(item3, "playAnimation") ~= nil
                                    or rawget(item3, "playAnimationNoStop") ~= nil
                                )
                            then
                                item2 = item3
                                if item3.humanoid and item3.humanoid.JumpPower ~= 0 then
                                    item3.humanoid.JumpPower = 0
                                end
                                if type(item3.afterAttack) == "table" then
                                    afterAttack = item3.afterAttack
                                    handleAction7(item3.afterAttack)
                                end
                            end
                            if
                                rawget(item3, "parriedVmTrack") ~= nil
                                or rawget(item3, "onTrackPlay") ~= nil
                                    and (rawget(item3, "custom") ~= nil or rawget(item3, "_origCustom") ~= nil)
                            then
                                afterAttack = item3
                                handleAction7(item3)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    table.clear(gc)
                end)
            end
            enabled4 = false
        end

local function doAimableArchJump()
    Humanoid_upv_1:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
    local LookVector_1 = CurrentCamera_upv_1.CFrame.LookVector
    local v31 = math.asin(LookVector_1.Y)
    local v32 = math.sin(v31)
    local v33 = Vector3.new(LookVector_1.X, 0, LookVector_1.Z)
    if v33.Magnitude <= 0 then
        v33 = Vector3.new(HumanoidRootPart_upv_1.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, HumanoidRootPart_upv_1.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
    end
    HumanoidRootPart_upv_1.Velocity = (v33.Unit * (((math.cos(v31) * 0.3) + 0.7) * 65 * __VD_JUMP_DIST_MULT__)) + Vector3.new(0, ((math.max(0, v32) * 30) + 20) * 1.5 * __VD_JUMP_HEIGHT_MULT__, 0)
    u5 = true
    task.spawn(
        function()
            task.wait(0.15)
            local v34 = RaycastParams.new()
            v34.FilterDescendantsInstances = {u7}
            v34.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            while u5 and (HumanoidRootPart_upv_1) and (HumanoidRootPart_upv_1.Parent) do
                if not (HumanoidRootPart_upv_1.Velocity.Y <= 0) or not (workspace:Raycast(HumanoidRootPart_upv_1.Position, Vector3.new(0, -3, 0), v34)) then
                    task.wait()
                    continue
                end
                Humanoid_upv_1:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
                return
            end
        end
    )
    task.delay(
        3,
        function()
            if not u5 or not Humanoid_upv_1 or not Humanoid_upv_1.Parent then
                return
            end
            Humanoid_upv_1:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
        end
    )
end

                        HumanoidRootPart_upv_1.Velocity = Vector3.new(v55.X, HumanoidRootPart_upv_1.Velocity.Y, v55.Z)

            end

            end
            u4 = false
            u2 = false
        end)
        return
    end
end

                local playerGui = localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
                if not playerGui then
                    return nil

                if platform == "PC" then
                    return playerGui:FindFirstChild("Hidden")
                elseif platform == "Mobile" then
                    return playerGui:FindFirstChild("Hidden-mob")
                elseif platform == "Console" then
                    return playerGui:FindFirstChild("Hidden-con")
                end
                return playerGui:FindFirstChild("Hidden")
                    or playerGui:FindFirstChild("Hidden-mob")
                    or playerGui:FindFirstChild("Hidden-con")
            end

    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, argument)
        if argument or isBindingKey then
            return
        end
        local matchesCondition = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad3
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad4
        local matchesCondition2 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or matchesCondition
        local matchesCondition3 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
        if matchesCondition2 or matchesCondition3 then
            local name = matchesCondition2 and input.KeyCode.Name or input.UserInputType.Name
            if name ~= "Unknown" and name ~= "None" and featureSettings.Keybinds then
                for key, keybind in pairs(featureSettings.Keybinds) do
                    if keybind and keybind ~= "None" then
                        local enabled = false
                        local keybind2 = keybind
                        if type(keybind) == "string" and keybind:sub(1, 5):lower() == "hold " then
                            enabled = true
                            keybind2 = keybind:sub(6)
                        end
                        local enabled2 = false
                        if type(keybind2) == "string" and keybind2:find("+") then
                            local items = {}
                            for key in keybind2:gmatch("[^+]+") do
                                table.insert(items, key)
                            end
                            if #items >= 2 then
                                local enabled3 = false
                                for _, item in ipairs(items) do
                                    if item == name then
                                        enabled3 = true
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                                if enabled3 then
                                    local enabled4 = true
                                    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
                                        if item ~= name then
                                            local enabled = false
                                            pcall(function()
                                                if item == "MouseButton3" then
                                                    enabled = UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(
                                                        Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
                                                    )
                                                elseif Enum.KeyCode[item] then
                                                    enabled = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode[item])
                                                end
                                            end)
                                            if not enabled then
                                                enabled4 = false
                                                break
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if enabled4 then
                                        enabled2 = true
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            if keybind2 == name then
                                enabled2 = true
                            end
                        end
                        if enabled2 then
                            if enabled and key ~= "ToggleUI" then
                                heldHotkeyStates[key] = true
                                if hotkeyStateSetters[key] then
                                    pcall(hotkeyStateSetters[key], true)
                                elseif hotkeyActions[key] then
                                    pcall(hotkeyActions[key])
                                end
                            else
                                local resultValue = hotkeyActions[key]
                                if resultValue then
                                    pcall(resultValue)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end))
    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, _)
        if isBindingKey then
            return
        end
        local matchesCondition = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad3
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad4
        local matchesCondition2 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or matchesCondition
        local matchesCondition3 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
        if matchesCondition2 or matchesCondition3 then
            local name = matchesCondition2 and input.KeyCode.Name or input.UserInputType.Name
            if name ~= "Unknown" and name ~= "None" and featureSettings.Keybinds then
                for key, keybind in pairs(featureSettings.Keybinds) do
                    if heldHotkeyStates[key] and keybind and keybind ~= "None" then
                        local matchesCondition = type(keybind) == "string" and keybind:sub(1, 5):lower() == "hold "
                        local keybind2 = matchesCondition and keybind:sub(6) or keybind
                        local enabled = false
                        if type(keybind2) == "string" and keybind2:find("+") then
                            for key2 in keybind2:gmatch("[^+]+") do
                                if key2 == name then
                                    enabled = true
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            if keybind2 == name then
                                enabled = true
                            end
                        end
                        if enabled then
                            heldHotkeyStates[key] = nil
                            if hotkeyStateSetters[key] then
                                pcall(hotkeyStateSetters[key], false)
                            elseif hotkeyActions[key] then
                                pcall(hotkeyActions[key])
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end))
end
buildCombatTab()
local function buildTeleportTab()
    activeTPFilter = activeTPFilter or "All"
    do
        local function handleAction(resultValue, argument)
            local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
            local humanoidRootPart = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not humanoidRootPart then
                showNotification("Teleport", "Character root not found!", "error")
                return
            end
            local items = {}
            if resultValue == "Generator" then
                local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
                local gens = map and map:FindFirstChild("Gens")
                if gens then
                    for _, child in ipairs(gens:GetChildren()) do
                        if child.Name == "Generator" or string.find(child.Name:lower(), "generator") then
                            table.insert(items, child)
                        end
                    end
                end
                for _, generator in ipairs(cachedGenerators) do
                    if generator and generator.Parent and not table.find(items, generator) then
                        table.insert(items, generator)
                    end
                end
                if #items == 0 then
                    for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                        if descendant.Name == "Generator" then
                            table.insert(items, descendant)
                        end
                    end
                end
            elseif resultValue == "Hook" then
                for _, hook in ipairs(cachedHooks) do
                    if hook and hook.Parent then
                        table.insert(items, hook)
                    end
                end
                if #items == 0 then
                    for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                        if descendant.Name == "Hook" or descendant.Name:lower():find("hook") then
                            table.insert(items, descendant)
                        end
                    end
                end
            elseif resultValue == "Gate" then
                for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if
                        descendant.Name == "Gate"
                        or descendant.Name:lower():find("gate")
                        or descendant.Name:lower():find("door")
                    then
                        table.insert(items, descendant)
                    end
                end
            elseif resultValue == "Pallet" then
                for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
                    if pallet and pallet.Parent then
                        table.insert(items, pallet)
                    end
                end
                if #items == 0 then
                    for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                        if descendant.Name == "Pallet" or descendant.Name:lower():find("pallet") then
                            table.insert(items, descendant)
                        end
                    end
                end
            elseif resultValue == "Vault" then
                for _, vault in ipairs(cachedVaults) do
                    if vault and vault.Parent then
                        table.insert(items, vault)
                    end
                end
                if #items == 0 then
                    for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                        if
                            descendant.Name == "Vault"
                            or descendant.Name:lower():find("vault")
                            or descendant.Name == "Window"
                        then
                            table.insert(items, descendant)
                        end
                    end
                end
            elseif resultValue == "Survivor" then
                for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                    if
                        player ~= localPlayer
                        and player.Team
                        and player.Team.Name == "Survivors"
                        and player.Character
                        and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    then
                        table.insert(items, player.Character)
                    end
                end
            elseif resultValue == "Killer" then
                for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                    local enabled = false
                    if player.Team and player.Team.Name == "Killer" then
                        enabled = true
                    elseif player.Name:lower():find("killer") then
                        enabled = true
                    end
                    if enabled and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                        table.insert(items, player.Character)
                    end
                end
            elseif resultValue == "Pumpkin" or resultValue == "Pumpkins" then
                for _, item in ipairs(cachedPumpkins or {}) do
                    if item and item.Parent then
                        table.insert(items, item)
                    end
                end
                if #items == 0 then
                    local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
                    local pumpkins = map and map:FindFirstChild("Pumpkins")
                    if pumpkins then
                        for _, child in ipairs(pumpkins:GetChildren()) do
                            table.insert(items, child)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local part = nil
            local huge = argument and -1 or math.huge
            for _, item in ipairs(items) do
                local basePart = item:IsA("BasePart") and item
                    or item:IsA("Model") and (item.PrimaryPart or item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
                    or item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                if basePart then
                    local distance = (basePart.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                    if argument then
                        if distance > huge then
                            huge = distance
                            part = basePart
                        end
                    else
                        if distance < huge then
                            huge = distance
                            part = basePart
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if part then
                if _G.VD_StopAllInteractions then
                    pcall(_G.VD_StopAllInteractions)
                    task.wait(0.15)
                end
                local sum = part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
                if featureSettings.PathfindingTP ~= false and _G.VD_SmartWalkTo then
                    _G.VD_AbortPathfinding = true
                    task.wait(0.03)
                    _G.VD_AbortPathfinding = false
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local resultValue2 = _G.VD_SmartWalkTo(sum, 3.5)
                        if
                            not resultValue2
                            and (part.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude > 4
                            and not _G.VD_AbortPathfinding
                        then
                            safeSegmentedTeleport(humanoidRootPart, part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                        end
                    end)
                    showNotification(
                        "Teleport",
                        "Pathfinding to " .. (argument and "furthest" or "nearest") .. " " .. resultValue .. "...",
                        "info"
                    )
                else
                    safeSegmentedTeleport(humanoidRootPart, part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                    showNotification(
                        "Teleport",
                        "Teleported to " .. (argument and "furthest" or "nearest") .. " " .. resultValue .. "!",
                        "success"
                    )
                end
            else
                showNotification(
                    "Teleport",
                    "No " .. (argument and "furthest" or "nearest") .. " " .. resultValue .. " found!",
                    "error"
                )
            end
        end
