        createSection(tabVisuals, "Custom Background", UI.Accent)
        local function handleAction()
            local listfilesValue = listfiles or syn_io_listfiles or list_files
            local items3 = {}
            if listfilesValue then
                local succeeded, result = pcall(listfilesValue, "")
                if not succeeded or not result then
                    succeeded, result = pcall(listfilesValue)
                end
                if succeeded and type(result) == "table" then
                    for _, item2 in ipairs(result) do
                        local match = tostring(item2):match("[^/\\]+$") or tostring(item2)
                        local lowercaseText = match:lower()
                        if not lowercaseText:find("^dbd_hud_") and not lowercaseText:find("dbd_hud_") then
                            local match2 = match:match("%.([^%.]+)$")
                            if match2 then
                                match2 = match2:lower()
                                if match2 == "png" or match2 == "jpg" or match2 == "jpeg" or match2 == "webp" then
                                    table.insert(items3, match)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return items3
        end
        local function handleAction2(resultValue)
            local items3 = {
                "CustomBg_AssetId",
                "CustomBg_LocalFile",
                "CustomBg_LocalBrowse",
                "CustomBg_Overlay",
                "CustomBg_ScaleType",
            }
            for _, item2 in ipairs(items3) do
                local resultValue2 = controlRegistry[item2]
                local container = nil
                if typeof(resultValue2) == "Instance" and resultValue2:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    container = resultValue2
                elseif type(resultValue2) == "table" then
                    if typeof(resultValue2.container) == "Instance" then
                        container = resultValue2.container
                    end
                end
                if container then
                    pcall(function()
                        TweenService
                            :Create(
                                container,
                                TweenInfo.new(0.2),
                                { BackgroundTransparency = resultValue and 0.8 or 0.95 }
                            )
                            :Play()
                        for _, descendant in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
                            if descendant:IsA("TextLabel") then
                                TweenService
                                    :Create(
                                        descendant,
                                        TweenInfo.new(0.2),
                                        { TextTransparency = resultValue and 0 or 0.5 }
                                    )
                                    :Play()
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end

        local function handleAction3(resultValue)
            local topRainbowBar = mainFrame and mainFrame:FindFirstChild("TopRainbowBar")
            if not topRainbowBar then
                return
            end
            local backgroundColor = options[resultValue]
            if backgroundColor then
                topRainbowBar.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor
                local backgroundColor2 = backgroundColor
                featureSettings.TopBarColor = { r = backgroundColor2.R, g = backgroundColor2.G, b = backgroundColor2.B }
            else
                topRainbowBar.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Accent
                featureSettings.TopBarColor = nil
            end
            pcall(saveSettings)
        end
        local key = "auto"
        if featureSettings.TopBarColor and type(featureSettings.TopBarColor) == "table" then
            local color =
                Color3.new(featureSettings.TopBarColor.r, featureSettings.TopBarColor.g, featureSettings.TopBarColor.b)
            for key2, item in pairs(options) do
                if
                    item
                    and math.abs(item.R - color.R) < 0.01
                    and math.abs(item.G - color.G) < 0.01
                    and math.abs(item.B - color.B) < 0.01
                then
                    key = key2
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        task.defer(function()
            handleAction3(key)
        end)

        textButton4.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local text = textBox3.Text
            if text == "" then
                showNotification("Import Config", "Paste a JSON config string first!", "warning")
                return
            end
            local succeeded, decodedData = pcall(function()
                return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(text)
            end)
            if not succeeded or type(decodedData) ~= "table" then
                showNotification("Import Config", "Invalid JSON! Check the format.", "error")
                return
            end
            local sum = 0
            local succeeded2 = pcall(function()
                deserializeTable(featureSettings, defaultSettingsSnapshot)
                deserializeTable(featureSettings, decodedData)
                if not hasPremiumAccess() then
                    disablePremiumFeatures()
                end
            end)
            if succeeded2 then
                for _, _ in pairs(decodedData) do
                    sum = sum + 1
                end
            end
            pcall(saveSettings)
            if applySettingsToControls then
                pcall(applySettingsToControls)
            end
            showNotification("Import Config", "Imported " .. sum .. " settings successfully!", "success")
            textBox3.Text = ""
        end)

                end)
                if succeeded and text and #text > 0 then
                    local enabled = false
                    pcall(function()
                        if setclipboard then
                            setclipboard(text)
                            enabled = true
                        elseif Clipboard and Clipboard.set then
                            Clipboard.set(text)
                            enabled = true
                        end
                    end)
                    if textBox3 then
                        textBox3.Text = text
                    end
                    if enabled then
                        showNotification("Get Config JSON", "Config JSON copied to clipboard!", "success")
                    else
                        showNotification(
                            "Get Config JSON",
                            "Config JSON generated! (Copied to text box above)",
                            "success"
                        )
                    end
                else
                    showNotification("Get Config JSON", "Failed to encode settings!", "error")
                end
            end)
        end, UI.Accent, "GetConfigJson")

        local function handleAction4()
            local keybinds = featureSettings.Keybinds or {}
            local items6 = {}
            local items7 = {}
            for key2, val in pairs(keybinds) do
                if val and val ~= "None" and val ~= "" then
                    local resultValue = configuration[key2]
                    local name = resultValue and resultValue.name or key2
                    local short = resultValue and resultValue.short or name
                    local check = resultValue and resultValue.check
                        or function()
                            if hotkeyStateGetters and hotkeyStateGetters[key2] then
                                return hotkeyStateGetters[key2]() == true
                            end
                            if featureSettings[key2] ~= nil then
                                return featureSettings[key2] == true
                            end
                            return false
                        end
                    table.insert(items6, { key = key2, val = val, name = name, short = short, check = check })
                    items7[name] = true
                end
            end
            for _, item in ipairs(items5) do
                if item.check() and not items7[item.name] then
                    table.insert(items6, {
                        key = item.name,
                        val = "",
                        name = item.name,
                        short = item.short or item.name,
                        check = item.check,
                    })
                    items7[item.name] = true
                end
            end
            table.sort(items6, function(resultValue, argument)
                return resultValue.name:lower() < argument.name:lower()
            end)
            return items6
        end

            local function animateColor()
                if vdCooldownOverlay and vdCooldownOverlay.Parent then
                    local uiStroke = vdCooldownOverlay:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                    if uiStroke and UI.Stroke then
                        uiStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
                    end
                    for key2, item in pairs(items8) do
                        local matchesCondition = item.entry.check() == true
                        local text, textColor = handleAction(key2)
                        item.nameLabel.TextColor3 = matchesCondition and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                            or Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
                        if text then
                            item.keyLabel.Text = text
                            item.keyLabel.TextColor3 = textColor
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not showHotkeyOverlay or not vdHotkeyOverlay or not vdHotkeyOverlay.Parent then
                    return
                end
                local uiStroke = vdHotkeyOverlay:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if uiStroke and UI.Stroke then
                    uiStroke.Color = UI.Stroke
                end
                local sum = 0
                for key2, item in pairs(items7) do
                    local currentState = item.item.check() == true
                    if currentState then
                        sum = sum + 1
                    end
                    local flowstateCooldownUI = key2 == "Flowstate Perk" and featureSettings.FlowstateCooldownUI
                    local quickRecoveryCooldownUI = key2 == "Simulate Quick Recovery"
                        and featureSettings.QuickRecoveryCooldownUI
                    local perfectLandingCooldownUI = key2 == "Simulate Perfect Landing"
                        and featureSettings.PerfectLandingCooldownUI
                    if flowstateCooldownUI or quickRecoveryCooldownUI or perfectLandingCooldownUI then
                        local flowstateCooldownUI2 = flowstateCooldownUI and "Flowstate"
                            or quickRecoveryCooldownUI and "QuickRecovery"
                            or "PerfectLanding"
                        local resultValue, resultValue2 = handleAction(flowstateCooldownUI2)
                        local val = item.item.val
                                and item.item.val ~= ""
                                and "[" .. formatKeybindLabel(item.item.val):upper() .. "] "
                            or ""
                        item.nameLabel.TextColor3 = currentState and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                            or Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
                        item.keyLabel.Text = val .. (resultValue or "READY")
                        item.keyLabel.TextColor3 = resultValue2 or UI.Accent or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                        item.currentState = currentState
                    else
                        local text = item.item.val
                                and item.item.val ~= ""
                                and formatKeybindLabel(item.item.val):upper()
                            or ""
                        local textColor = UI.Accent or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                        if item.keyLabel.Text ~= text then
                            item.keyLabel.Text = text
                            item.keyLabel.TextColor3 = currentState and textColor or Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 120)
                        end
                        if item.currentState ~= currentState then
                            item.currentState = currentState
                            local color = currentState and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                                or Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
                            local color2 = currentState and textColor or Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 120)
                            TweenService
                                :Create(
                                    item.nameLabel,
                                    TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                                    { TextColor3 = color }
                                )
                                :Play()
                            TweenService
                                :Create(
                                    item.keyLabel,
                                    TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                                    { TextColor3 = color2 }
                                )
                                :Play()
                        elseif currentState and item.keyLabel.TextColor3 ~= textColor then
                            item.keyLabel.TextColor3 = textColor
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

buildConfigurationTab()
local function buildCommunityTab()
    tabCommunity = createTab("Community", "rbxassetid://7733746980", "Config Hub")
    do
        local items = {}
        local decodedData = items
        local items2 = {}
        local options = { likes = {}, loads = {} }
        local function handleAction(resultValue, method, body)
            local requestFunction = getRequestFunction()
            if not requestFunction then
                return nil
            end
            local headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", ["x-vd-build"] = buildId }
            if method == "POST" then
                headers.Prefer = "return=minimal"
            end
            local url = (apiBaseUrl or _G.VD_SERVER_URL or "http://78.154.103.2:9156")
                .. "/api/configs"
                .. (resultValue or "")
            local succeeded, result =
                pcall(requestFunction, { Url = url, Method = method, Headers = headers, Body = body })
            if not succeeded then
            else
            end
            return succeeded and result or nil
        end
        local function decodeJson()
            local response = handleAction(
                "/rest/v1/config_interactions?username=eq." .. httpService:UrlEncode(localPlayer.Name),
                "GET"
            )
            if response and (response.StatusCode == 200 or response.status == 200) then
                local succeeded, decodedData = pcall(function()
                    return httpService:JSONDecode(response.Body)
                end)
                if succeeded and type(decodedData) == "table" then
                    options.likes = {}
                    options.loads = {}
                    for _, item in ipairs(decodedData) do
                        if item.interaction_type == "like" then
                            options.likes[item.config_name] = true
                        elseif item.interaction_type == "load" then
                            options.loads[item.config_name] = true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local response2 = handleAction("/rest/v1/rpc/get_config_stats", "POST", "{}")
            if response2 and (response2.StatusCode == 200 or response2.status == 200) then
                local succeeded, decodedData = pcall(function()
                    return httpService:JSONDecode(response2.Body)
                end)
                if succeeded and type(decodedData) == "table" then
                    items2 = {}
                    for _, item in ipairs(decodedData) do
                        items2[item.config_name] = {
                            likes = tonumber(item.likes_count) or 0,
                            loads = tonumber(item.loads_count) or 0,
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local function handleAction2(configName)
            local resultValue = options.likes[configName]
            if resultValue then
                local formattedText = string.format(
                    "/rest/v1/config_interactions?username=eq.%s&config_name=eq.%s&interaction_type=eq.like",
                    httpService:UrlEncode(localPlayer.Name),
                    httpService:UrlEncode(configName)
                )
                task.spawn(function()
                    handleAction(formattedText, "DELETE")
                end)
                options.likes[configName] = nil
                if items2[configName] then
                    items2[configName].likes = math.max(0, items2[configName].likes - 1)
                end
            else
                local json = httpService:JSONEncode({
                    username = localPlayer.Name,
                    config_name = configName,
                    interaction_type = "like",
                })
                task.spawn(function()
                    handleAction("/rest/v1/config_interactions", "POST", json)
                end)
                options.likes[configName] = true
                if not items2[configName] then
                    items2[configName] = { likes = 0, loads = 0 }
                end
                items2[configName].likes = items2[configName].likes + 1
            end
        end
        local function handleAction3(configName)
            local resultValue = options.loads[configName]
            if not resultValue then
                local json = httpService:JSONEncode({
                    username = localPlayer.Name,
                    config_name = configName,
                    interaction_type = "load",
                })
                task.spawn(function()
                    handleAction("/rest/v1/config_interactions", "POST", json)
                end)
                options.loads[configName] = true
                if not items2[configName] then
                    items2[configName] = { likes = 0, loads = 0 }
                end
                items2[configName].loads = items2[configName].loads + 1
            end
        end
        createSection(tabCommunity, "Config Hub", UI.Accent)
        local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60)
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
        frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
        frame.Parent = tabCommunity
        Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, UI.CardRadius)
        Instance.new("UIStroke", frame).Color = UI.Stroke
        local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
        textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
        textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        textLabel.Text =
            "Browse & share configurations with the community. Submit your own or load one from the feed below."

        local function vdRefreshCommunityConfigs()
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(decodeJson)
                local responseBody = nil
                local url = _G.VD_SERVER_URL or "http://78.154.103.2:9156"
                local requestFunction = getRequestFunction()
                if requestFunction then
                    local succeeded, response = pcall(requestFunction, {
                        Url = url .. "/api/community_configs",
                        Method = "GET",
                        Headers = {
                            ["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
                            ["x-vd-build"] = buildId,
                            ["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate",
                        },
                    })
                    if
                        succeeded
                        and response
                        and (response.StatusCode == 200 or response.status == 200)
                        and response.Body
                        and #response.Body > 2
                    then
                        responseBody = response.Body
                    end
                end
                if not responseBody or #responseBody <= 2 then
                    local url2 = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lixxWW/ViolenceDistrict/main/community_configs.json?t="
                        .. tostring(math.floor(tick()))
                    local succeeded, responseBody2 = pcall(function()
                        return game:HttpGet(url2)
                    end)
                    if succeeded and responseBody2 and #responseBody2 > 2 then
                        responseBody = responseBody2
                    elseif requestFunction then
                        local succeeded2, response = pcall(requestFunction, {
                            Url = url2,
                            Method = "GET",
                            Headers = { ["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate" },
                        })
                        if
                            succeeded2
                            and response
                            and (response.StatusCode == 200 or response.status == 200)
                            and response.Body
                            and #response.Body > 2
                        then
                            responseBody = response.Body
                        end
                    end
                end
                if responseBody then
                    local succeeded, decodedData2 = pcall(function()
                        return httpService:JSONDecode(responseBody)
                    end)
                    if succeeded and type(decodedData2) == "table" then
                        decodedData = decodedData2
                        pcall(handleAction7)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        _G.VD_RefreshCommunityConfigs = vdRefreshCommunityConfigs
        vdRefreshCommunityConfigs()
    end

applySettingsToControls = function()
    if not hasPremiumAccess() then
        pcall(disablePremiumFeatures)
    end
    for key, item in pairs(controlRegistry) do
        local parts = string.split(key, ".")
        local featureSettings2 = featureSettings
        for _, item2 in ipairs(parts) do
            if featureSettings2 ~= nil then
                featureSettings2 = featureSettings2[item2]
            end
        end
        if featureSettings2 ~= nil and item.setValue then
            local enabled = featureSettings2
            if type(featureSettings2) == "table" and featureSettings2.Enabled ~= nil then
                enabled = featureSettings2.Enabled
            end
            pcall(function()
                item.setValue(enabled, false)
            end)
        end
    end
    if keybindRefreshCallbacks then
        for _, item in pairs(keybindRefreshCallbacks) do
            pcall(item)
        end
    end
    if refreshColorPicker and activeColorKey then
        pcall(function()
            refreshColorPicker(featureSettings.ESPColors[activeColorKey] or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
        end)
    end
    if refreshEspStyles then
        pcall(refreshEspStyles)
    end
    if isMobile and rebuildMobileButtons then
        pcall(rebuildMobileButtons)
    end
    if _G.VD_RefreshHotkeys then
        pcall(_G.VD_RefreshHotkeys)
    end
    if _G.VD_RefreshCooldownOverlay then
        pcall(_G.VD_RefreshCooldownOverlay)
    end
    pcall(function()
        local vdInfoBanner = screenGui:FindFirstChild("VD_InfoBanner")
        if vdInfoBanner then
            vdInfoBanner.Position = UDim2.new(
                featureSettings.InfoBannerPositionScaleX or 0.5,
                featureSettings.InfoBannerPositionOffsetX or 0,
                featureSettings.InfoBannerPositionScaleY or 0,
                featureSettings.InfoBannerPositionOffsetY or isMobile and 6 or 10
            )
            vdInfoBanner.Visible = featureSettings.ShowInfoBanner
                and hasPremiumAccess()
                and premiumCapabilities
                and premiumCapabilities.InfoBanner
        end
        local vdLiveFPSCounter = screenGui:FindFirstChild("VD_LiveFPSCounter")
        if vdLiveFPSCounter then
            vdLiveFPSCounter.Position = UDim2.new(
                featureSettings.LiveFPSPositionScaleX or 1,
                featureSettings.LiveFPSPositionOffsetX or isMobile and -65 or -80,
                featureSettings.LiveFPSPositionScaleY or 0,
                featureSettings.LiveFPSPositionOffsetY or isMobile and 6 or 10
            )
            vdLiveFPSCounter.Visible = featureSettings.ShowLiveFPS == true
        end
    end)
end

function updateFarmStatus(resultValue)
    local options = {
        OFF = "OFF",
        IDLE = "Idle...",
        REPAIRING = "Repairing Generator",
        RESCUING = "Saving Comrade",
        OPENINGGATE = "Opening Exit Gate",
        FLEEING = "Fleeing Killer",
        ESCAPING = "Escaping Match",
        ESCAPED = "ESCAPED",
        HUNTING = "Hunting Survivor",
        CARRYING = "Carrying Survivor",
        HANGING = "Hanging Survivor",
        ["PAUSED (Knocked/Hooked)"] = "PAUSED (Knocked/Hooked)",
        ["PAUSED (Spectating/Lobby)"] = "PAUSED (Spectating/Lobby)",
        ["PAUSED (Killer Team)"] = "PAUSED (Killer Team)",
        ["PAUSED (Survivors Team)"] = "PAUSED (Survivors Team)",
    }
    local options2 = {
        OFF = UI.Muted,
        IDLE = UI.TextSub,
        REPAIRING = UI.AccentCyan,
        RESCUING = UI.Warning,
        OPENINGGATE = UI.AccentGreen,
        FLEEING = UI.Danger,
        ESCAPING = UI.AccentGreen,
        ESCAPED = UI.AccentGreen,
        HUNTING = UI.Danger,
        CARRYING = UI.Warning,
        HANGING = UI.AccentCyan,
        ["PAUSED (Knocked/Hooked)"] = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 50),
        ["PAUSED (Spectating/Lobby)"] = UI.Muted,
        ["PAUSED (Killer Team)"] = UI.Danger,
        ["PAUSED (Survivors Team)"] = UI.Danger,
    }
    local text = options[resultValue] or tostring(resultValue)
    local textColor = options2[resultValue] or UI.Muted
    if tostring(resultValue):find("WAITING") then
        textColor = UI.AccentCyan
    elseif tostring(resultValue):find("PUMPKIN") then
        textColor = UI.Accent
    end
    if _G.VD_HomeStatusLabel then
        _G.VD_HomeStatusLabel.Text = text
        _G.VD_HomeStatusLabel.TextColor3 = textColor
    end
    if _G.VD_HomeStatusDot then
        _G.VD_HomeStatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = textColor
    end
    if _G.VD_FarmStatusLabel then
        _G.VD_FarmStatusLabel.Text = "Status: " .. text
        _G.VD_FarmStatusLabel.TextColor3 = textColor
    end
end

_G.VD_LastFlashlightEffect = "None"
_G.VD_FlashlightOnState = false
_G.VD_LastHookedLight = nil
_G.VD_LightChangedConn = nil
_G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = false
task.spawn(function()
    local remainder = 0
    local sum = 0
    local enabled = false
    while activeLoop do
        task.wait(0.05)
        sum = sum + 1
        if sum >= 2 then
            sum = 0
            enabled = not enabled
        end
        pcall(function()
            if sum % 4 == 0 then
                local color = featureSettings.KillerStainColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                    local characterValue = player.Character
                    local head = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    local redSurfaceLight = head and head:FindFirstChild("RedSurfaceLight")
                    if redSurfaceLight and redSurfaceLight:IsA("Light") then
                        if redSurfaceLight.Color ~= color then
                            redSurfaceLight.Color = color
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
            local flashlight = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChild("Flashlight")
            if flashlight then
                local spotLight = flashlight:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpotLight")
                    or flashlight:FindFirstChild("SpotLight", true)
                if spotLight then
                    if spotLight ~= _G.VD_LastHookedLight then
                        if _G.VD_LightChangedConn then
                            pcall(function()
                                _G.VD_LightChangedConn:Disconnect()
                            end)
                        end
                        _G.VD_LastHookedLight = spotLight
                        _G.VD_FlashlightOnState = spotLight.Enabled
                        _G.VD_LightChangedConn = spotLight:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
                            if _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled then
                                return
                            end
                            _G.VD_FlashlightOnState = spotLight.Enabled
                        end)
                        registerConnection(_G.VD_LightChangedConn)
                    end
                    local color = featureSettings.FlashlightColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    if featureSettings.FlashlightEffect == "Rainbow" then
                        remainder = (remainder + 0.008) % 1
                        color = Color3.fromHSV(remainder, 1, 1)
                    end
                    for _, descendant in ipairs(flashlight:GetDescendants()) do
                        if descendant:IsA("Light") then
                            descendant.Color = color
                            if _G.VD_FlashlightOnState then
                                if featureSettings.FlashlightEffect == "Ultra Bright" then
                                    _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = true
                                    descendant.Enabled = true
                                    _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = false
                                    descendant.Range = 250
                                    descendant.Brightness = 15
                                elseif featureSettings.FlashlightEffect == "Strobe" then
                                    _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = true
                                    descendant.Enabled = enabled
                                    _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = false
                                else
                                    if _G.VD_LastFlashlightEffect == "Ultra Bright" then
                                        descendant.Range = 51
                                        descendant.Brightness = 1
                                    end
                                end
                            else
                                _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = true
                                descendant.Enabled = false
                                _G.VD_IsChangingEnabled = false
                                if _G.VD_LastFlashlightEffect == "Ultra Bright" then
                                    descendant.Range = 51
                                    descendant.Brightness = 1
                                end
                            end
                        elseif descendant:IsA("Beam") then
                            descendant.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
                            if _G.VD_FlashlightOnState then
                                if featureSettings.FlashlightEffect == "Strobe" then
                                    descendant.Enabled = enabled
                                elseif featureSettings.FlashlightEffect == "Ultra Bright" then
                                    descendant.Enabled = true
                                end
                            else
                                descendant.Enabled = false
                            end
                        elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                            local lowercaseText = descendant.Name:lower()
                            if
                                lowercaseText:find("beam")
                                or lowercaseText:find("light")
                                or lowercaseText:find("cone")
                                or descendant.Transparency > 0 and descendant.Transparency < 1
                            then
                                descendant.Color = color
                                if _G.VD_FlashlightOnState then
                                    if featureSettings.FlashlightEffect == "Strobe" then
                                        descendant.Transparency = enabled and 0.5 or 1
                                    elseif featureSettings.FlashlightEffect == "Ultra Bright" then
                                        descendant.Transparency = 0.4
                                    end
                                else
                                    descendant.Transparency = 1
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                _G.VD_LastFlashlightEffect = featureSettings.FlashlightEffect
            end
        end)
    end
end)

local teleportTypeColors = {
    Generator = Color3.fromRGB(0, 210, 255),
    Hook = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 0),
    Pallet = Color3.fromRGB(200, 160, 80),
    Vault = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180),
    Gate = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0),
    Pumpkin = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0),
}
local teleportRows = {}
function teleportToInstance(resultValue)
    if not localPlayer or not localPlayer.Character or not localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        return
    end
    local basePart
    if resultValue:IsA("Model") then
        basePart = resultValue.PrimaryPart or resultValue:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    elseif resultValue:IsA("BasePart") then
        basePart = resultValue
    end
    if basePart then
        if _G.VD_StopAllInteractions then
            pcall(_G.VD_StopAllInteractions)
            task.wait(0.15)
        end
        local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if humanoidRootPart then
            local sum = basePart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
            if featureSettings.PathfindingTP ~= false and _G.VD_SmartWalkTo then
                _G.VD_AbortPathfinding = true
                task.wait(0.03)
                _G.VD_AbortPathfinding = false
                task.spawn(function()
                    local resultValue = _G.VD_SmartWalkTo(sum, 3.5)
                    if
                        not resultValue
                        and (basePart.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude > 4
                        and not _G.VD_AbortPathfinding
                    then
                        safeSegmentedTeleport(humanoidRootPart, basePart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                    end
                end)
                showNotification("Teleport", "Pathfinding to map object...", "info")
            else
                safeSegmentedTeleport(humanoidRootPart, basePart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                showNotification("Teleport", "Teleported to object!", "success")
            end
        end
    end
end
function clearTPRows()
    for key, item in pairs(teleportRows) do
        if item.row then
            item.row:Destroy()
        end
        teleportRows[key] = nil
    end
end
function createTPRow(resultValue)
    if not tpScroll then
        return
    end
    local instance = resultValue.instance
    local backgroundColor = teleportTypeColors[resultValue.label] or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    local textButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    textButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
    textButton.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card
    textButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
    textButton.Text = ""
    textButton.AutoButtonColor = false
    textButton.Parent = tpScroll
    local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    uiCorner.Parent = textButton
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -6)
    frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 3)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = textButton
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 1.5)
    local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
    textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
    textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    textLabel.Text = string.format("%s  [%dm]", resultValue.label, resultValue.dist)
    textLabel.TextColor3 = backgroundColor
    textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
    textLabel.TextSize = 11
    textLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    textLabel.Parent = textButton
    textButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(textButton, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { BackgroundColor3 = UI.HoverCard }):Play()
    end)
    textButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(textButton, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { BackgroundColor3 = UI.Card }):Play()
    end)
    textButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if instance and instance.Parent then
            teleportToInstance(instance)
        end
    end)
    teleportRows[instance] = { row = textButton, label = textLabel, typeLabel = resultValue.label }
end
function collectTPEntries()
    local items = {}
    local items2 = {}
    local function handleAction(instance, label)
        if instance and instance.Parent and not items2[instance] then
            items2[instance] = true
            table.insert(items, { instance = instance, label = label })
        end
    end
    local activeTPFilterValue = activeTPFilter or "All"
    if activeTPFilterValue == "All" or activeTPFilterValue == "Generator" then
        for _, item in ipairs(cachedGenerators or {}) do
            if not isGeneratorCompleted(item) then
                handleAction(item, "Generator")
            end
        end
        if #items == 0 and (activeTPFilterValue == "Generator" or activeTPFilterValue == "All") then
            local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
            local gens = map and map:FindFirstChild("Gens")
            if gens then
                for _, child in ipairs(gens:GetChildren()) do
                    if
                        (child.Name == "Generator" or string.find(child.Name:lower(), "generator"))
                        and not isGeneratorCompleted(child)
                    then
                        handleAction(child, "Generator")
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if
                    (descendant.Name == "Generator" or descendant.Name:lower():find("generator"))
                    and descendant:IsA("Model")
                    and not isGeneratorCompleted(descendant)
                then
                    handleAction(descendant, "Generator")
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if activeTPFilterValue == "All" or activeTPFilterValue == "Hook" then
        for _, item in ipairs(cachedHooks or {}) do
            handleAction(item, "Hook")
        end
        if #items == 0 and (activeTPFilterValue == "Hook" or activeTPFilterValue == "All") then
            for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if
                    descendant.Name == "Hook"
                    or descendant.Name == "HookPoint"
                    or descendant.Name:lower():find("hook")
                then
                    local hookPoint = descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant
                        or descendant:FindFirstChild("HookPoint")
                        or descendant:IsA("Model") and descendant.PrimaryPart
                        or descendant:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                    if hookPoint then
                        handleAction(hookPoint, "Hook")
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if activeTPFilterValue == "All" or activeTPFilterValue == "Pallet" then
        for _, item in ipairs(cachedPallets or {}) do
            handleAction(item, "Pallet")
        end
        if #items == 0 and (activeTPFilterValue == "Pallet" or activeTPFilterValue == "All") then
            for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if descendant.Name == "Pallet" or descendant.Name:lower():find("pallet") then
                    handleAction(descendant, "Pallet")
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if activeTPFilterValue == "All" or activeTPFilterValue == "Vault" then
        for _, item in ipairs(cachedVaults or {}) do
            handleAction(item, "Vault")
        end
        if #items == 0 and (activeTPFilterValue == "Vault" or activeTPFilterValue == "All") then
            for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if
                    descendant.Name == "Vault"
                    or descendant.Name:lower():find("vault")
                    or descendant.Name == "Window"
                    or descendant.Name:lower():find("window")
                then
                    handleAction(descendant, "Vault")
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if activeTPFilterValue == "All" or activeTPFilterValue == "Gate" then
        for _, item in ipairs(cachedGates or {}) do
            handleAction(item, "Gate")
        end
        if #items == 0 and (activeTPFilterValue == "Gate" or activeTPFilterValue == "All") then
            for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if
                    descendant.Name == "Gate"
                    or descendant.Name:lower():find("gate")
                    or descendant.Name:lower():find("door")
                then
                    handleAction(descendant, "Gate")
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if activeTPFilterValue == "All" or activeTPFilterValue == "Pumpkin" then
        for _, item in ipairs(cachedPumpkins or {}) do
            handleAction(item, "Pumpkin")
        end
        if #items == 0 and (activeTPFilterValue == "Pumpkin" or activeTPFilterValue == "All") then
            local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
            local pumpkins = map and map:FindFirstChild("Pumpkins")
            if pumpkins then
                for _, child in ipairs(pumpkins:GetChildren()) do
                    handleAction(child, "Pumpkin")
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        item.dist = getDistance(item.instance)
    end
    table.sort(items, function(resultValue, argument)
        return resultValue.dist < argument.dist
    end)
    return items
end
refreshTPMenu = function()
    if not tpScroll then
        return
    end
    local resultValue = collectTPEntries()
    clearTPRows()
    if #resultValue == 0 then
        if tpEmptyLabel then
            tpEmptyLabel.Visible = true
        end
        return
    end
    if tpEmptyLabel then
        tpEmptyLabel.Visible = false
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(resultValue) do
        createTPRow(item)
    end
end
function updateTPMenuDistances()
    for key, item in pairs(teleportRows) do
        if not key.Parent then
            if item.row then
                item.row:Destroy()
            end
            teleportRows[key] = nil
        else
            local distance = getDistance(key)
            local text = string.format("%s  [%dm]", item.typeLabel, distance)
            if item.label.Text ~= text then
                item.label.Text = text
            end
        end
    end
end
function makeDraggable(resultValue, argument)
    local enabled, input, position, position2
    local function handleAction(resultValue2)
        local vectorValue = resultValue2.Position - position
        resultValue.Position = UDim2.new(
            position2.X.Scale,
            position2.X.Offset + vectorValue.X,
            position2.Y.Scale,
            position2.Y.Offset + vectorValue.Y
        )
    end
    argument.InputBegan:Connect(function(input2)
        if
            input2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            enabled = true
            position = input2.Position
            position2 = resultValue.Position
            input2.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input2.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    enabled = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
    argument.InputChanged:Connect(function(input2)
        if
            input2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            input = input2
        end
    end)
    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(resultValue2)
        if resultValue2 == input and enabled then
            handleAction(resultValue2)
        end
    end))
end
makeDraggable(mainFrame, titleBar)
function makeResizable(resultValue, argument)
    local enabled = false
    local position = nil
    local size = nil
    local input = nil
    argument.InputBegan:Connect(function(input2)
        if
            input2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            enabled = true
            position = input2.Position
            size = resultValue.Size
            input2.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input2.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    enabled = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
    argument.InputChanged:Connect(function(input2)
        if
            input2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            input = input2
        end
    end)
    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(resultValue2)
        if resultValue2 == input and enabled then
            local vectorValue = resultValue2.Position - position
            local mainW = math.clamp(size.X.Offset + vectorValue.X, 420, 1000)
            local mainH = math.clamp(size.Y.Offset + vectorValue.Y, 260, 800)
            resultValue.Size = UDim2.new(0, mainW, 0, mainH)
            UI.MainW = mainW
            UI.MainH = mainH
        end
    end))
end

function doCleanup()
    activeLoop = false
    pcall(function()
        local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if playerGui then
            local items = {}
            local items2 = {}
            for _, descendant in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
                if descendant:IsA("GuiObject") and descendant.Name:find("^Survivor%d+$") then
                    local parent = descendant.Parent
                    if parent and not items2[parent] then
                        items2[parent] = true
                        table.insert(items, parent)
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, guiObject in ipairs(items) do
                if guiObject:GetAttribute("OrigVisible") ~= nil then
                    guiObject.Visible = guiObject:GetAttribute("OrigVisible")
                    guiObject:SetAttribute("OrigVisible", nil)
                end
                for _, child in ipairs(guiObject:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Name:find("^Survivor%d+$") then
                        if child:GetAttribute("OrigVisible") ~= nil then
                            child.Visible = child:GetAttribute("OrigVisible")
                            child:SetAttribute("OrigVisible", nil)
                        end
                    end
                end
                guiObject:SetAttribute("CachedOverlayPos", nil)
                guiObject:SetAttribute("CachedOverlaySize", nil)
                local violenceDistrictOverlay = guiObject:FindFirstChild("ViolenceDistrictOverlay")
                if violenceDistrictOverlay then
                    violenceDistrictOverlay:Destroy()
                end
            end
            for _, descendant in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
                if descendant:IsA("ImageLabel") and descendant:GetAttribute("DBDHud_OrigImage") ~= nil then
                    descendant.Image = descendant:GetAttribute("DBDHud_OrigImage")
                    descendant:SetAttribute("DBDHud_OrigImage", nil)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if _G.VD_DBD and _G.VD_DBD.restoreSounds then
            _G.VD_DBD.restoreSounds()
        end
    end)

            return
        end

            TweenService:Create(

function patchMobileControls()
    if not isMobile then
        return
    end
    local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if not playerGui then
        return
    end
    local descendant = nil
    for _, descendant2 in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant2.Name == "Controls" and descendant2:IsA("Frame") then
            descendant = descendant2
            break
        end
    end
    if not descendant then
        return
    end
    local resultValue = descendant:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
    if resultValue then
        pcall(function()
            resultValue.DisplayOrder = 20
            resultValue.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        end)
        descendant.ZIndex = 1000
        for _, descendant2 in ipairs(descendant:GetDescendants()) do
            if descendant2:IsA("GuiButton") then
                descendant2.Active = true
                descendant2.Selectable = true
                descendant2.ZIndex = 1001
            end
            if descendant2:IsA("Frame") and descendant2.BackgroundTransparency == 1 then
                descendant2.Active = false
            end
        end
    end
    if screenGui then
        screenGui.DisplayOrder = 99999
    end
    local vdMobileAimbotGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("VD_MobileAimbotGui")
    if vdMobileAimbotGui then
        vdMobileAimbotGui.DisplayOrder = 99998
    end
    local vdMobileHUD = playerGui:FindFirstChild("VD_MobileHUD")
    if vdMobileHUD then
        vdMobileHUD.DisplayOrder = 99997
    end
end
task.spawn(function()
    scanMapObjects()
    refreshTPMenu()
    local mapName = getMapName()
    local sum, sum2, sum3, sum4, remainder = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
    local enabled = false
    while activeLoop do
        pcall(function()
            if isSpectating() then
                if not enabled then
                    cleanupAll()
                    enabled = true
                end
                task.wait(0.5)
                return
            end
            enabled = false
            sum = sum + 0.1
            if sum >= 2 then
                local mapName2 = getMapName()
                if mapName2 ~= mapName then
                    mapName = mapName2
                    scanMapObjects()
                    refreshTPMenu()
                end
                sum = 0
            end
            sum4 = sum4 + 0.1
            if sum4 >= 2 then
                pcall(updateSCPCache)
                sum4 = 0
            end
            sum2 = sum2 + 0.1
            if sum2 >= 1 then
                updateTPMenuDistances()
                sum2 = 0
            end
            sum3 = sum3 + 0.1
            if sum3 >= 0.35 then
                applyLocalPlayerModifiers()
                sum3 = 0
            end
            remainder = (remainder + 1) % #mapObjectCacheDescriptors
            local resultValue = mapObjectCacheDescriptors[remainder + 1]
            updateMapESP(resultValue.typeKey, resultValue.cached())
            pcall(manageHighlights)
            if featureSettings.Minimap and featureSettings.Minimap.Enabled and featureSettings.MasterESP then
                pcall(function()
                    _G.VD_MinimapCard.Visible = true
                    local part = workspace.CurrentCamera
                    local transform = part.CFrame
                    local humanoidRootPart = cachedLocalRootPart and cachedLocalRootPart.Position
                        or localPlayer.Character
                            and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            and localPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
                    if not humanoidRootPart then
                        return
                    end
                    local numberValue = 130
                    local numberValue2 = 5
                    local numberValue3 = 130
                    local ratio = numberValue3 / 2
                    local unit = Vector3.new(transform.LookVector.X, 0, transform.LookVector.Z).Unit
                    local unit2 = Vector3.new(transform.RightVector.X, 0, transform.RightVector.Z).Unit
                    for _, child in ipairs(_G.VD_MinimapCard:GetChildren()) do
                        if child.Name == "RadarDot" then
                            child.Visible = false
                        end
                    end
                    local function handleAction()
                        for _, child in ipairs(_G.VD_MinimapCard:GetChildren()) do
                            if child.Name == "RadarDot" and not child.Visible then
                                return child
                            end
                        end
                        local radarDot = Instance.new("Frame")
                        radarDot.Name = "RadarDot"
                        radarDot.Size = UDim2.new(0, numberValue2, 0, numberValue2)
                        radarDot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                        radarDot.BorderSizePixel = 0
                        radarDot.ZIndex = 8
                        radarDot.Parent = _G.VD_MinimapCard
                        Instance.new("UICorner", radarDot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
                        return radarDot
                    end
                    local function handleAction2(resultValue, backgroundColor)
                        local difference = resultValue - humanoidRootPart
                        local resultValue2 = difference:Dot(unit2)
                        local resultValue3 = difference:Dot(unit)
                        local ratio2 = ratio / numberValue
                        local sum = ratio + resultValue2 * ratio2
                        local difference2 = ratio - resultValue3 * ratio2
                        local difference3 = ratio - numberValue2
                        if (Vector2.new(sum, difference2) - Vector2.new(ratio, ratio)).Magnitude > difference3 then
                            return
                        end
                        local guiObject = handleAction()
                        guiObject.Position = UDim2.new(0, sum, 0, difference2)
                        guiObject.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor
                        guiObject.Visible = true
                    end
                    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if player == localPlayer then
                            continue
                        end
                        local characterValue = player.Character
                        local humanoidRootPart = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if not humanoidRootPart then
                            continue
                        end
                        local team = player.Team
                        local team2 = team and team.Name == "Killer"
                        local color = team2 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70) or Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 130)
                        handleAction2(humanoidRootPart.Position, color)
                    end
                    for _, generator in ipairs(cachedGenerators) do
                        if not generator or not generator.Parent then
                            continue
                        end
                        if isGeneratorCompleted(generator) then
                            continue
                        end
                        local basePart = generator:IsA("Model") and generator.PrimaryPart
                            or generator:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                        if basePart then
                            handleAction2(basePart.Position, Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255))
                        end
                    end
                    for _, hook in ipairs(cachedHooks) do
                        if not hook or not hook.Parent then
                            continue
                        end
                        local position = hook:IsA("BasePart") and hook.Position or nil
                        if position then
                            handleAction2(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 0))
                        end
                    end
                    for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
                        if not pallet or not pallet.Parent then
                            continue
                        end
                        local basePart = pallet:IsA("Model") and pallet.PrimaryPart
                            or pallet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                        if basePart then
                            handleAction2(basePart.Position, Color3.fromRGB(180, 130, 70))
                        end
                    end
                end)
            else
                if _G.VD_MinimapCard.Visible then
                    _G.VD_MinimapCard.Visible = false
                end
            end
        end)
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end)

local lastMoonwalkObstacleCheckAt = 0
local moonwalkBlockedByObstacle = false
local lastMoonwalkSwayAt = 0
local moonwalkSwayDirection = 1
local moonwalkSmoothedSway = 0
registerConnection(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(resultValue)
    if not activeLoop then
        return
    end
    pcall(function()
        local camera2 = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera2 and featureSettings.FOV and type(featureSettings.FOV) == "number" then
            if camera2.FieldOfView ~= featureSettings.FOV then
                camera2.FieldOfView = featureSettings.FOV
            end
        end
    end)
    debug.profilebegin("Helper_RenderStepped_Main")
    if featureSettings.RainbowCharacter then
        pcall(function()
            local parent = localPlayer.Character
            if parent then
                local ratio = tick() % 4 / 4
                local fillColor = Color3.fromHSV(ratio, 1, 1)
                if featureSettings.RainbowCharacterMode == "Highlight" then
                    if next(_G.VD_OriginalPartStates) then
                        for key, vdOriginalPartState in pairs(_G.VD_OriginalPartStates) do
                            pcall(function()
                                if key and key.Parent then
                                    key.Color = vdOriginalPartState.Color
                                    key.Material = vdOriginalPartState.Material
                                    key.Transparency = vdOriginalPartState.Transparency
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                        _G.VD_OriginalPartStates = {}
                    end
                    local rainbowHighlight = parent:FindFirstChild("RainbowHighlight")
                    if not rainbowHighlight then
                        rainbowHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                        rainbowHighlight.Name = "RainbowHighlight"
                        rainbowHighlight.FillTransparency = 0.4
                        rainbowHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
                        rainbowHighlight.Parent = parent
                    end
                    rainbowHighlight.FillColor = fillColor
                    rainbowHighlight.OutlineColor = fillColor
                    rainbowHighlight.Enabled = true
                else
                    local rainbowHighlight = parent:FindFirstChild("RainbowHighlight")
                    if rainbowHighlight then
                        pcall(function()
                            rainbowHighlight:Destroy()
                        end)

                    if _G.VD_LastCacheChar ~= parent then

                    end
                    for _, item in ipairs(_G.VD_RainbowPartsCache) do
                        if item and item.Parent then
                            if not _G.VD_OriginalPartStates[item] then
                                _G.VD_OriginalPartStates[item] = {
                                    Color = item.Color,
                                    Material = item.Material,
                                    Transparency = item.Transparency,
                                }
                            end
                            item.Color = fillColor
                            if featureSettings.RainbowCharacterMode == "ForceField" then
                                item.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                            else
                                item.Material = _G.VD_OriginalPartStates[item].Material
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    if
        featureSettings.NoclipVaultsPallets
        and hasPremiumAccess()
        and premiumCapabilities
        and premiumCapabilities.NoclipVaultsPallets
    then
        pcall(function()
            for _, vault in ipairs(cachedVaults) do
                if vault and vault.Parent and not obstaclePartCache[vault] then
                    obstaclePartCache[vault] = {}
                    for _, descendant in ipairs(vault:GetDescendants()) do
                        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                            local lowercaseText = descendant.Name:lower()
                            if
                                lowercaseText == "inviswall"
                                or lowercaseText == "bottom"

                                or lowercaseText == "glass"
                                or lowercaseText == "pane"

                                if originalObstacleCollision[descendant] == nil then
                                    originalObstacleCollision[descendant] = descendant.CanCollide

                                descendant.CanCollide = false
                                table.insert(obstaclePartCache[vault], descendant)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
                if pallet and pallet.Parent and not obstaclePartCache[pallet] then
                    obstaclePartCache[pallet] = {}
                    for _, descendant in ipairs(pallet:GetDescendants()) do
                        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                            if originalObstacleCollision[descendant] == nil then
                                originalObstacleCollision[descendant] = descendant.CanCollide
                            end
                            descendant.CanCollide = false
                            table.insert(obstaclePartCache[pallet], descendant)
                        end
                    end

        end)
    else
        if next(originalObstacleCollision) ~= nil then
            pcall(function()

                        key.CanCollide = canCollide
