                end
            end)
            originalObstacleCollision = {}
            obstaclePartCache = {}
        end
    end
    if featureSettings.AutoMoonwalk then
        pcall(function()
            debug.profilebegin("Helper_AutoMoonwalk")
            local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
            local humanoidRootPart = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local part = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if humanoidRootPart and humanoid and part then
                local enabled = moonwalkBlockedByObstacle
                local timestamp = tick()
                if timestamp - lastMoonwalkObstacleCheckAt >= 0.1 then
                    lastMoonwalkObstacleCheckAt = timestamp
                    enabled = false
                    if featureSettings.MoonwalkDisableOnVault then
                        if cachedVaults then
                            for _, vault in ipairs(cachedVaults) do
                                if vault and vault.Parent then
                                    local basePart = vaultRootPartCache[vault]
                                    if basePart == nil then
                                        basePart = vault:IsA("BasePart") and vault
                                            or vault:IsA("Model") and vault.PrimaryPart
                                            or vault:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                                            or false
                                        vaultRootPartCache[vault] = basePart
                                    end
                                    if basePart then
                                        local distance = (basePart.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                                        if distance <= 20 then
                                            enabled = true
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if not enabled and cachedPallets then
                            for _, pallet in ipairs(cachedPallets) do
                                if pallet and pallet.Parent then
                                    local basePart = vaultRootPartCache[pallet]
                                    if basePart == nil then
                                        local humanoidRootPart2 = pallet:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                        if
                                            humanoidRootPart2
                                            and (
                                                humanoidRootPart2:FindFirstChild("inviswall")
                                                or humanoidRootPart2:FindFirstChild("inviswall1")
                                            )
                                        then
                                            basePart = pallet:IsA("Model") and pallet.PrimaryPart
                                                or humanoidRootPart2
                                                or pallet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                                                or false
                                        else
                                            basePart = false
                                        end
                                        vaultRootPartCache[pallet] = basePart
                                    end
                                    if basePart then
                                        local distance = (basePart.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                                        if distance <= 18 then
                                            enabled = true
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    moonwalkBlockedByObstacle = enabled
                end
                if not enabled then
                    humanoid.AutoRotate = false
                    local resultValue2
                    if
                        featureSettings.MoonwalkMovementBased
                        and hasPremiumAccess()
                        and premiumCapabilities
                        and premiumCapabilities.MovementMoonwalk
                        and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.01
                    then
                        local resultValue3 = humanoid.MoveDirection:Dot(part.CFrame.LookVector)
                        local resultValue4 = humanoid.MoveDirection:Dot(part.CFrame.RightVector)
                        if math.abs(resultValue3) > math.abs(resultValue4) then
                            resultValue2 = math.atan2(humanoid.MoveDirection.X, humanoid.MoveDirection.Z)
                        else
                            local lookVector = part.CFrame.LookVector
                            resultValue2 = math.atan2(lookVector.X, lookVector.Z)
                        end
                    else
                        local lookVector = part.CFrame.LookVector
                        resultValue2 = math.atan2(lookVector.X, lookVector.Z)
                    end
                    local sum = 0
                    if humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                        local moonwalkSwaySpeed = featureSettings.MoonwalkSwaySpeed or 14
                        local moonwalkSwayAmplitude = featureSettings.MoonwalkSwayAmplitude or 0.28
                        local moonwalkShaking = featureSettings.MoonwalkShaking or 0.05
                        local scaledValue = math.sin(tick() * moonwalkSwaySpeed) * moonwalkSwayAmplitude
                        local scaledValue2 = (math.random() - 0.5) * moonwalkShaking
                        sum = scaledValue + scaledValue2
                    end
                    local _, resultValue4, _ = humanoidRootPart.CFrame:ToOrientation()
                    local sum2 = resultValue2
                    if featureSettings.ReverseMoonwalk then
                        sum2 = sum2 + math.pi
                    end
                    local difference = (sum2 - resultValue4 + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
                    local numberValue = resultValue or 0.0166
                    local clampedValue = math.clamp(numberValue * 5.5, 0, 1)
                    local sum3 = resultValue4 + difference * clampedValue
                    local sum4 = 0
                    if humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                        local moonwalkSwaySpeed = featureSettings.MoonwalkSwaySpeed or 14
                        local ratio = 1.2 / moonwalkSwaySpeed
                        local timestamp = tick()
                        if timestamp - lastMoonwalkSwayAt >= ratio then
                            lastMoonwalkSwayAt = timestamp
                            moonwalkSwayDirection = -moonwalkSwayDirection
                        end
                        local scaledValue = moonwalkSwayDirection * (featureSettings.MoonwalkSwayAmplitude or 0.65)
                        moonwalkSmoothedSway = moonwalkSmoothedSway
                            + (scaledValue - moonwalkSmoothedSway) * math.clamp(numberValue * 18, 0, 1)
                        local moonwalkShaking = featureSettings.MoonwalkShaking or 0.05
                        local scaledValue2 = (math.random() - 0.5) * moonwalkShaking
                        sum4 = moonwalkSmoothedSway + scaledValue2
                    else
                        moonwalkSmoothedSway = 0
                    end
                    local magnitude = math.abs(difference)
                    local clampedValue2 = math.clamp(1 - magnitude / (math.pi / 2), 0, 1)
                    sum4 = sum4 * clampedValue2
                    local sum5 = sum3 + sum4
                    humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(humanoidRootPart.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, sum5, 0)
                else
                    humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                end
            end
            debug.profileend()
        end)
    end
    debug.profileend()
end))
local function getCameraRelativeMoveDirection()
    local part = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not part then
        return Vector3.zero
    end
    local sum = 0
    local sum2 = 0
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Up) then
        sum = sum + 1
    end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Down) then
        sum = sum - 1
    end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Right) then
        sum2 = sum2 + 1
    end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Left) then
        sum2 = sum2 - 1
    end
    if sum == 0 and sum2 == 0 then
        return Vector3.zero
    end
    local transform = part.CFrame
    local vectorValue = Vector3.new(transform.LookVector.X, 0, transform.LookVector.Z)
    local vectorValue2 = Vector3.new(transform.RightVector.X, 0, transform.RightVector.Z)
    if vectorValue.Magnitude > 0 then
        vectorValue = vectorValue.Unit
    end
    if vectorValue2.Magnitude > 0 then
        vectorValue2 = vectorValue2.Unit
    end
    local sum3 = vectorValue * sum + vectorValue2 * sum2
    return sum3.Magnitude > 0 and sum3.Unit or Vector3.zero
end
registerConnection(RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(resultValue)
    if not activeLoop then
        return
    end
    if not featureSettings.NoTurnSpeedLoss then
        return
    end
    if _G.VD_IsParrying then
        return
    end
    if featureSettings.AutoMoonwalk then
        return
    end
    local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
    if not characterValue then
        return
    end
    local humanoidRootPart = characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = characterValue:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoidRootPart or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        return
    end
    local moveDirection = getCameraRelativeMoveDirection()
    local matchesCondition = moveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
    if matchesCondition then
        humanoid.AutoRotate = false
        humanoid:Move(moveDirection, false)
        local speedboost = characterValue:GetAttribute("speedboost") or 1
        local speed = characterValue:GetAttribute("Speed") or 16
        local numberValue = featureSettings.AntiRubberbandSpeed ~= false
                and (tonumber(featureSettings.SafeSpeedCap) or 1.14)
            or 3
        local clampedValue = math.clamp(speedboost, 1, numberValue)
        local scaledValue = speed * clampedValue
        local y = humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
        humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
            Vector3.new(moveDirection.X * scaledValue, y, moveDirection.Z * scaledValue)
        local lookVector = humanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector
        local unit = Vector3.new(lookVector.X, 0, lookVector.Z).Unit
        local resultValue2 = unit:Dot(moveDirection)
        if resultValue2 < 0.999 then
            local resultValue3 = math.atan2(-moveDirection.X, -moveDirection.Z)
            local resultValue4 = math.atan2(-unit.X, -unit.Z)
            local difference = (resultValue3 - resultValue4 + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
            local clampedValue2 = math.clamp(26 * (resultValue or 0.0166), 0, 1)
            local sum = resultValue4 + difference * clampedValue2
            local position = humanoidRootPart.Position
            humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0, sum, 0)
        end
    else
        humanoid.AutoRotate = true
        humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
    end
end))
_G.VD_FlowstateCooldownEnd = 0
_G.VD_FlowstateActiveOverrideEnd = 0
local function hasFlowstatePerk()
    local team = localPlayer.Team
    if team and team.Name == "Killer" then
        return false
    end
    if featureSettings.FlowstatePerk then
        return true
    end
    local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
    if characterValue then
        if characterValue:GetAttribute("Flowstate") == true or characterValue:FindFirstChild("Flowstate") ~= nil then
            return true
        end
    end
    local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if playerGui then
        local survivorPerks = playerGui:FindFirstChild("SurvivorPerks")
        local perks = survivorPerks and survivorPerks:FindFirstChild("Perks")
        if perks then
            for _, child in ipairs(perks:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Frame") or child:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    local icon = child:FindFirstChild("Icon", true) or child:FindFirstChildOfClass("ImageLabel")
                    if icon and icon:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                        if tostring(icon.Image):find("108420950668748") then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
function triggerFastVaultCooldown()
    if not hasFlowstatePerk() then
        return
    end
    if tick() < _G.VD_FlowstateCooldownEnd then
        return
    end
    _G.VD_FlowstateActiveOverrideEnd = tick() + 0.5
    _G.VD_FlowstateCooldownEnd = tick() + (featureSettings.FlowstateCooldown or 15)
end
_G.VD_QuickRecoveryBoostEnd = 0
_G.VD_QuickRecoveryCooldownEnd = 0
_G.VD_PerfectLandingBoostEnd = 0
_G.VD_PerfectLandingCooldownEnd = 0
local temporaryBoostWorkerRunning = false
local function startTemporaryBoostWorker()
    if temporaryBoostWorkerRunning then
        return
    end
    temporaryBoostWorkerRunning = true
    task.spawn(function()
        while activeLoop do
            local timestamp = tick()
            local simulateQuickRecovery = featureSettings.SimulateQuickRecovery
                and timestamp < (_G.VD_QuickRecoveryBoostEnd or 0)
            local simulatePerfectLanding = featureSettings.SimulatePerfectLanding
                and timestamp < (_G.VD_PerfectLandingBoostEnd or 0)
            if not simulateQuickRecovery and not simulatePerfectLanding then
                break
            end
            pcall(applyLocalPlayerModifiers)
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
        temporaryBoostWorkerRunning = false
        pcall(applyLocalPlayerModifiers)
    end)
end
function triggerQuickRecovery()
    if not featureSettings.SimulateQuickRecovery then
        return
    end
    local team = localPlayer.Team
    if team and team.Name == "Killer" then
        return
    end
    local timestamp = tick()
    if timestamp < (_G.VD_QuickRecoveryCooldownEnd or 0) then
        return
    end
    local numberValue = tonumber(featureSettings.QuickRecoveryCooldown) or 15
    _G.VD_QuickRecoveryBoostEnd = timestamp + 3
    _G.VD_QuickRecoveryCooldownEnd = timestamp + math.max(numberValue, 0.2)
    pcall(applyLocalPlayerModifiers)
    startTemporaryBoostWorker()
end
function triggerPerfectLanding()
    if not featureSettings.SimulatePerfectLanding then
        return
    end
    local team = localPlayer.Team
    if team and team.Name == "Killer" then
        return
    end
    local timestamp = tick()
    if timestamp < (_G.VD_PerfectLandingCooldownEnd or 0) then
        return
    end
    local numberValue = tonumber(featureSettings.PerfectLandingCooldown) or 15
    _G.VD_PerfectLandingBoostEnd = timestamp + 3
    _G.VD_PerfectLandingCooldownEnd = timestamp + math.max(numberValue, 0.2)
    if modelSpeedMultipliers then
        for key, item in pairs(modelSpeedMultipliers) do
            if type(item) == "number" and item < 1 then
                modelSpeedMultipliers[key] = 1
            end
        end
    end
    pcall(applyLocalPlayerModifiers)
    startTemporaryBoostWorker()
end
function watchLocalPlayerCharacter(resultValue)
    if not resultValue then
        return
    end
    if humanoidStateConnection then
        pcall(function()
            humanoidStateConnection:Disconnect()
        end)
        humanoidStateConnection = nil
    end
    if characterAnimationConnection then
        pcall(function()
            characterAnimationConnection:Disconnect()
        end)
        characterAnimationConnection = nil
    end
    if characterAuxiliaryConnection then
        pcall(function()
            characterAuxiliaryConnection:Disconnect()
        end)
        characterAuxiliaryConnection = nil
    end
    if characterChildAddedConnection then
        pcall(function()
            characterChildAddedConnection:Disconnect()
        end)
        characterChildAddedConnection = nil
    end
    local vdStashedSkillchecks = {}
    _G.VD_StashedSkillchecks = vdStashedSkillchecks
    _G.VD_StashSkillchecks = function()
        if
            not (
                hasPremiumAccess("NoSkillChecks")
                and premiumCapabilities
                and type(premiumCapabilities.NoSkillChecks) == "function"
            )
        then
            return
        end
        local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
        if not characterValue then
            return
        end
        premiumCapabilities.NoSkillChecks(characterValue, vdStashedSkillchecks)
    end
    _G.VD_RestoreSkillchecks = function()
        local parent = localPlayer.Character
        if not parent then
            return
        end
        for loopIndex = #vdStashedSkillchecks, 1, -1 do
            local resultValue = vdStashedSkillchecks[loopIndex]
            if resultValue and resultValue.Parent == nil then
                pcall(function()
                    resultValue.Parent = parent
                end)
            end
        end
        table.clear(vdStashedSkillchecks)
    end
    local function callback(resultValue2)
        if
            featureSettings.NoSkillChecks
            and hasPremiumAccess("NoSkillChecks")
            and premiumCapabilities
            and type(premiumCapabilities.NoSkillChecks) == "function"
        then
            local lowercaseText = resultValue2.Name:lower()
            if lowercaseText:find("skillcheck") then
                if not table.find(vdStashedSkillchecks, resultValue2) then
                    table.insert(vdStashedSkillchecks, resultValue2)
                end
                pcall(function()
                    resultValue2.Parent = nil
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    pcall(function()
        for _, child in ipairs(resultValue:GetChildren()) do
            callback(child)
        end
    end)

            elseif player:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or player:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true then
                enabled2 = true
            elseif player.Name:lower():find("killer") then
                enabled2 = true
            end
            if enabled2 and player.Character then
                for _, child in ipairs(player.Character:GetChildren()) do
                    if string.find(child.Name, "King's Scourge") then
                        enabled = true
                        return true
                    end
                end
                for _, descendant in ipairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                    if string.find(descendant.Name, "King's Scourge") then
                        enabled = true
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Model") and child ~= localPlayer.Character then
                for _, child2 in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
                    if string.find(child2.Name, "King's Scourge") then
                        enabled = true
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        enabled = false
        return false
    end
    local function handleAction2()
        local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
        local humanoidRootPart = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoidRootPart then
            return nil
        end
        local generator = nil
        local huge = math.huge
        for _, generator2 in ipairs(cachedGenerators) do
            if generator2 and generator2.Parent and not isGeneratorCompleted(generator2) then
                local humanoidRootPart2 = generator2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    or generator2:FindFirstChild("Engine")
                    or generator2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Part")
                if humanoidRootPart2 then
                    local distance = (humanoidRootPart.Position - humanoidRootPart2.Position).Magnitude
                    if distance < huge then
                        huge = distance
                        generator = generator2
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for key, _ in pairs(ActiveESP.Generators) do
            if key and key.Parent and not isGeneratorCompleted(key) then
                local humanoidRootPart2 = key:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    or key:FindFirstChild("Engine")
                    or key:FindFirstChildOfClass("Part")
                if humanoidRootPart2 then
                    local distance = (humanoidRootPart.Position - humanoidRootPart2.Position).Magnitude
                    if distance < huge then
                        huge = distance
                        generator = key
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if huge < 10 then
            return generator
        end
        return nil
    end

_G.VD_KillerFovFolder = nil
_G.VD_ActiveFovVisuals = {}
cleanupKillerGroundFOV = function()
    if _G.VD_KillerFovFolder then
        pcall(function()
            _G.VD_KillerFovFolder:Destroy()
        end)
        _G.VD_KillerFovFolder = nil
    end
    _G.VD_ActiveFovVisuals = {}
end
_G.VD_FovGroundRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
_G.VD_FovGroundRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
_G.VD_FovGroundRayParams.IgnoreWater = true
local function resolveGroundFovPoint(vectorValue, argument, argument2, argument3, argument4)
    _G.VD_FovGroundRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = argument3 or {}
    local vectorValue2 = Vector3.new(vectorValue.X, argument2 + 0.5, vectorValue.Z)
    local position
    if argument4 then
        position = vectorValue2 + argument
    else
        local raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(vectorValue2, argument, _G.VD_FovGroundRayParams)
        position = raycastResult and raycastResult.Position or vectorValue2 + argument
    end
    local raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(
        Vector3.new(position.X, argument2 + 3, position.Z),
        Vector3.new(0, -10, 0),
        _G.VD_FovGroundRayParams
    )
    if raycastResult then
        return Vector3.new(position.X, raycastResult.Position.Y + 0.08, position.Z)
    end
    return Vector3.new(position.X, argument2 + 0.08, position.Z)
end
local function createGroundFovSegment(parent, argument, argument2, argument3)
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
    part.Transparency = 1
    part.Anchored = true
    part.CanCollide = false
    part.CanQuery = false
    part.CanTouch = false
    part.Parent = parent
    local part2 = Instance.new("Part")
    part2.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
    part2.Transparency = 1
    part2.Anchored = true
    part2.CanCollide = false
    part2.CanQuery = false
    part2.CanTouch = false
    part2.Parent = parent
    local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment", part)
    local attachment2 = Instance.new("Attachment", part2)
    local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
    beam.Attachment0 = attachment
    beam.Attachment1 = attachment2
    beam.Width0 = argument2 or 0.18
    beam.Width1 = argument2 or 0.18
    beam.FaceCamera = true
    beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(argument or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60))
    beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(argument3 or 0.25)
    beam.Segments = 1
    beam.Parent = part
    return {
        p0 = part,
        p1 = part2,
        beam = beam,
        update = function(position, position2, argument, width0, argument2)
            part.Position = position
            part2.Position = position2
            if argument then
                beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(argument)
            end
            if width0 then
                beam.Width0 = width0
                beam.Width1 = width0
            end
            if argument2 then
                beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(argument2)
            end
        end,
        destroy = function()
            pcall(function()
                part:Destroy()
            end)
            pcall(function()
                part2:Destroy()
            end)
        end,
    }
end
function updateKillerGroundFOV()
    local masterESP = featureSettings.MasterESP
        and featureSettings.KillerESP
        and featureSettings.KillerESP.Enabled
        and featureSettings.KillerESP.GroundFOV
    if not masterESP then
        if _G.VD_KillerFovFolder then
            cleanupKillerGroundFOV()
        end
        return
    end
    local killerCharacters = {}
    if getKillerCharacters then
        killerCharacters = getKillerCharacters()
    end
    if #killerCharacters == 0 then
        if _G.VD_KillerFovFolder then
            cleanupKillerGroundFOV()
        end
        return
    end
    if not _G.VD_KillerFovFolder or not _G.VD_KillerFovFolder.Parent then
        _G.VD_KillerFovFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
        _G.VD_KillerFovFolder.Name = "VD_KillerGroundFOV"
        _G.VD_KillerFovFolder.Parent = workspace
    end
    local color = featureSettings.KillerESP.GroundFOVColor
        or featureSettings.ESPColors and featureSettings.ESPColors.Killer
        or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
    local groundFOVStyle = featureSettings.KillerESP.GroundFOVStyle or "Outline Cone"
    local groundFOVDistance = featureSettings.KillerESP.GroundFOVDistance or 12
    local groundFOVTransparency = featureSettings.KillerESP.GroundFOVTransparency or 0.25
    local groundFOVWidth = featureSettings.KillerESP.GroundFOVWidth or 0.18
    local resultValue = math.rad(35)
    local numberValue = 14
    local items = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(killerCharacters) do
        if not item or not item.Parent then
            continue
        end
        local humanoidRootPart = item:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoidRootPart then
            continue
        end
        items[item] = true
        local options = _G.VD_ActiveFovVisuals[item]
        if not options or not options.beams then
            if options and options.leftLine then
                pcall(function()
                    options.leftLine.destroy()
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    options.rightLine.destroy()
                end)
                if options.arcLines then
                    for _, arcLine in ipairs(options.arcLines) do
                        pcall(function()
                            arcLine.destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            options = { beams = {} }
            _G.VD_ActiveFovVisuals[item] = options
        end
        local lookVector = humanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector
        local vectorValue = Vector3.new(lookVector.X, 0, lookVector.Z)
        if vectorValue.Magnitude < 0.001 then
            vectorValue = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
        else
            vectorValue = vectorValue.Unit
        end
        local resultValue2 = math.atan2(vectorValue.Z, vectorValue.X)
        local filterDescendantsInstances = { item }
        if localPlayer.Character then
            table.insert(filterDescendantsInstances, localPlayer.Character)
        end
        local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
        raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
        raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true
        local raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(humanoidRootPart.Position, Vector3.new(0, -15, 0), raycastParams)
        local y = raycastResult and raycastResult.Position.Y or humanoidRootPart.Position.Y - 2.8
        local vectorValue2 = Vector3.new(humanoidRootPart.Position.X, y + 0.08, humanoidRootPart.Position.Z)
        local items2 = {}
        local function handleAction(resultValue3, argument, numberValue2, argument2, argument3, argument4)
            numberValue2 = numberValue2 or 6
            for loopIndex = 0, numberValue2 - 1, 1 do
                if loopIndex % 2 == 0 then
                    local resultValue4 = resultValue3:Lerp(argument, loopIndex / numberValue2)
                    local resultValue = resultValue3:Lerp(argument, (loopIndex + 1) / numberValue2)
                    table.insert(items2, { resultValue4, resultValue, argument2, argument3, argument4 })
                end
            end
        end
        local killerESP = featureSettings.KillerESP and featureSettings.KillerESP.GroundFOVThroughWalls == true
        local items3 = {}
        for loopIndex2 = 0, numberValue, 1 do
            local ratio = loopIndex2 / numberValue
            local sum = resultValue2 - resultValue + ratio * resultValue * 2
            local scaledValue = Vector3.new(math.cos(sum), 0, math.sin(sum)) * groundFOVDistance
            local resultValue3 =
                resolveGroundFovPoint(vectorValue2, scaledValue, y, filterDescendantsInstances, killerESP)
            table.insert(items3, resultValue3)
        end
        if groundFOVStyle == "Dotted Arc" or groundFOVStyle == "Dotted Cone" then
            handleAction(vectorValue2, items3[1], 8, color, groundFOVWidth, groundFOVTransparency)
            handleAction(vectorValue2, items3[#items3], 8, color, groundFOVWidth, groundFOVTransparency)
            for loopIndex2 = 1, numberValue, 1 do
                if loopIndex2 % 2 == 1 then
                    table.insert(
                        items2,
                        { items3[loopIndex2], items3[loopIndex2 + 1], color, groundFOVWidth, groundFOVTransparency }
                    )
                end
            end
        else
            table.insert(items2, { vectorValue2, items3[1], color, groundFOVWidth, groundFOVTransparency })
            table.insert(items2, { vectorValue2, items3[#items3], color, groundFOVWidth, groundFOVTransparency })
            for loopIndex2 = 1, numberValue, 1 do
                table.insert(
                    items2,
                    { items3[loopIndex2], items3[loopIndex2 + 1], color, groundFOVWidth, groundFOVTransparency }
                )
            end
        end
        for loopIndex2, item2 in ipairs(items2) do
            local groundFovSegment = options.beams[loopIndex2]
            if not groundFovSegment then
                groundFovSegment = createGroundFovSegment(_G.VD_KillerFovFolder, item2[3], item2[4], item2[5])
                options.beams[loopIndex2] = groundFovSegment
            end
            groundFovSegment.update(item2[1], item2[2], item2[3], item2[4], item2[5])
        end
        while #options.beams > #items2 do
            local resultValue3 = table.remove(options.beams)
            if resultValue3 then
                resultValue3.destroy()
            end
        end
    end
    for key, vdActiveFovVisual in pairs(_G.VD_ActiveFovVisuals) do
        if not items[key] then
            if vdActiveFovVisual.beams then
                for _, item in ipairs(vdActiveFovVisual.beams) do
                    item.destroy()
                end
            end
            if vdActiveFovVisual.leftLine then
                vdActiveFovVisual.leftLine.destroy()
            end
            if vdActiveFovVisual.rightLine then
                vdActiveFovVisual.rightLine.destroy()
            end
            if vdActiveFovVisual.arcLines then
                for _, arcLine in ipairs(vdActiveFovVisual.arcLines) do
                    arcLine.destroy()
                end
            end
            _G.VD_ActiveFovVisuals[key] = nil
        end
    end
end
function updateParryESP()
    local autoParry = featureSettings.AutoParry and featureSettings.ParryRangeESP and featureSettings.MasterESP
    local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
    local humanoidRootPart = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not autoParry or not humanoidRootPart then
        if _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment then
            pcall(function()
                _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment:Destroy()
            end)
            _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment = nil
        end
        return
    end
    if not _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment or _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Parent == nil then
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment = Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Name = "VD_ParryRangeESP"
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Height = 0.05
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Transparency = 0.6
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.AlwaysOnTop = true
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.ZIndex = 10
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -3.1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
    end
    if _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Adornee ~= humanoidRootPart then
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Adornee = humanoidRootPart
    end
    if _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Parent ~= humanoidRootPart then
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Parent = humanoidRootPart
    end
    local radius = featureSettings.ParryRange or 12
    if _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Radius ~= radius then
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Radius = radius
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.InnerRadius = radius - 0.2
    end
    local enabled = false
    if getKillerCharacters then
        local parryRange = featureSettings.ParryRange or 16
        local killerCharacters = getKillerCharacters()
        for _, item in ipairs(killerCharacters) do
            if item and item.Parent then
                local humanoidRootPart2 = item:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if humanoidRootPart2 then
                    local distance = (humanoidRootPart2.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                    if distance <= parryRange then
                        enabled = true
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if featureSettings.ParryRangeViewInRange and not enabled then
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Visible = false
    else
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Visible = true
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Transparency = 0.6
        _G.VD_ParryEspAdornment.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end
end

                local hookedProgress = getModelValue(characterValue, "HookedProgress")
                if hookedProgress and tonumber(hookedProgress) then
                    local numberValue = tonumber(hookedProgress)

                        if
                            featureSettings.RevolverAutofarm
                            and hasPremiumAccess()
                            and premiumCapabilities

                            )
                            if tick() - timestamp > 3 then
                                timestamp = tick()
                                if performInstantEscape then
                                    pcall(performInstantEscape)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

    local function vdIsInLobby()
        local team = localPlayer.Team
        local name = team and team.Name or ""
        if name ~= "Survivors" and name ~= "Killer" then
            return true
        end
        local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
        if not map then
            return true
        end
        local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby") or workspace:FindFirstChild("lobby")
        local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
        if lobby and characterValue and characterValue:IsDescendantOf(lobby) then
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

task.spawn(function()
    local timestamp = 0
    local timestamp2 = 0
    while activeLoop do
        task.wait(0.25)
        if
            featureSettings.AutoFleeKiller
            and hasPremiumAccess("AutoFleeKiller")
            and not featureSettings.AutoFarmSurvivor
        then
            local succeeded, result = pcall(function()
                local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
                local humanoidRootPart = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not humanoidRootPart then
                    return
                end
                local matchesCondition = characterValue:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
                    or localPlayer:GetAttribute("Knocked") == true
                if not matchesCondition and getModelValue then
                    matchesCondition = getModelValue(characterValue, "Knocked") == true
                end
                local matchesCondition2 = characterValue:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
                    or localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
                if not matchesCondition2 and getModelValue then
                    matchesCondition2 = getModelValue(characterValue, "IsHooked") == true
                end
                if matchesCondition or matchesCondition2 then
                    return
                end
                local position = humanoidRootPart.Position
                local huge = math.huge
                local position2 = nil
                for _, player in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                    if player == localPlayer then
                        continue
                    end
                    local team = player.Team
                    if team and team.Name == "Killer" and player.Character then
                        local humanoidRootPart2 = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if humanoidRootPart2 then
                            local distance = (humanoidRootPart2.Position - position).Magnitude
                            if distance < huge then
                                huge = distance
                                position2 = humanoidRootPart2.Position
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if tick() - timestamp2 > 1.5 then
                    timestamp2 = tick()
                    local _ = cachedGenerators and #cachedGenerators or 0
                end
                if tick() - timestamp < 3 then
                    return
                end
                if huge < 35 and position2 then
                    if premiumCapabilities and type(premiumCapabilities.AutoFleeKiller) == "function" then
                        local resultValue = premiumCapabilities.AutoFleeKiller(
                            characterValue,
                            humanoidRootPart,
                            position2,
                            cachedGenerators,
                            getGenPartSafe,
                            isGeneratorCompleted,
                            isGeneratorPaused,
                            getGeneratorPoint,
                            showNotification
                        )
                        if resultValue then
                            timestamp = tick()
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            if not succeeded then
                warn("[Auto Flee Killer Loop Error] " .. tostring(result))
            end
        end
    end
end)
function queueTeleportScript()
    local queueOnTeleport = queue_on_teleport or syn and syn.queue_on_teleport
    if not queueOnTeleport then
        return
    end
    local enabled = false
    pcall(function()
        if readfile and isfile and isfile("roblox_helper.lua") then
            enabled = true
        end
    end)
    local text = ""
    if enabled then
        text = [[
            local success, content = pcall(function() return readfile("roblox_helper.lua") end)
            if success and content then
                local fn = loadstring(content)
                if fn then task.spawn(fn) end
            end
        ]]
    else
        text = [[
            local url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lixxWW/ViolenceDistrict/refs/heads/main/ViolenceDistrict.lua"
            local success, content = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url, true) end)
            if success and content and #content > 0 then
                local fn = loadstring(content)
                if fn then task.spawn(fn) end
            end
        ]]
    end
    pcall(queueOnTeleport, text)
end
function getTimerSeconds()
    local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local playerGui = player and player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    local spectator = playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("Spectator")
    local time = spectator and spectator:FindFirstChild("time")
    local timerLabel = time and time:FindFirstChild("TimerLabel")
    if timerLabel and timerLabel:IsA("TextLabel") then
        local text = timerLabel.Text
        if text then
            if string.find(text:lower(), "not enough players") then
                return -1, text
            end
            local match, match2 = string.match(text, "(%d+):(%d+)")
            if match and match2 then
                return tonumber(match) * 60 + tonumber(match2), text
            end
        end
    end
    return nil, nil
end
function serverHop()
    pcall(queueTeleportScript)
    local teleportServiceService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
    local playersService = game:GetService("Players")
    local httpServiceService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local placeId = game.PlaceId
    local jobId = game.JobId
    local url = "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" .. tostring(placeId) .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100"
    local url2 = "https://games.roproxy.com/v1/games/" .. tostring(placeId) .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100"
    local httpRequest = syn and syn.request
        or http and http.request
        or http_request
        or fluxus and fluxus.request
        or request
    local enabled, responseBody = false, nil
    if httpRequest then
        local succeeded, response = pcall(function()
            return httpRequest({
                Url = url,
                Method = "GET",
                Headers = {
                    ["User-Agent"] = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
                    Accept = "application/json",
                },
            })
        end)
        if succeeded and response and response.Body and not string.find(response.Body, "<!DOCTYPE html>") then
            enabled = true
            responseBody = response.Body
        else
        end
    end
    if not enabled then
        local succeeded, responseBody2 = pcall(function()
            return game:HttpGet(url)
        end)
        if succeeded and responseBody2 and not string.find(responseBody2, "<!DOCTYPE html>") then
            enabled = true
            responseBody = responseBody2
        else
        end
    end
    if not enabled and httpRequest then
        local succeeded, response = pcall(function()
            return httpRequest({
                Url = url2,
                Method = "GET",
                Headers = {
                    ["User-Agent"] = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
                    Accept = "application/json",
                },
            })
        end)
        if succeeded and response and response.Body and not string.find(response.Body, "<!DOCTYPE html>") then
            enabled = true
            responseBody = response.Body
        else
        end
    end
    if not enabled then
        local succeeded, responseBody2 = pcall(function()
            return game:HttpGet(url2)
        end)
        if succeeded and responseBody2 and not string.find(responseBody2, "<!DOCTYPE html>") then
            enabled = true
            responseBody = responseBody2
        else
        end
    end
    if enabled and responseBody then
        local decodedData = nil
        pcall(function()
            decodedData = httpServiceService:JSONDecode(responseBody)
        end)
        if decodedData and decodedData.data then
            local data = decodedData.data
            if #data > 0 then
                local resultValue = data[1]
                local json = "N/A"
                pcall(function()
                    json = httpServiceService:JSONEncode(resultValue)
                end)
            end
            local items = {}
            for _, item in ipairs(data) do
                local matchesCondition = tostring(item.id) == tostring(jobId)
                if item.playing and item.maxPlayers and not matchesCondition then
                    if item.playing >= 3 and item.playing < item.maxPlayers then
                        table.insert(items, item)
                    end
                end
            end
            if #items == 0 then
                for _, item in ipairs(data) do
                    local matchesCondition = tostring(item.id) == tostring(jobId)
                    if item.playing and item.playing < item.maxPlayers and not matchesCondition then
                        table.insert(items, item)
                    end
                end
            end
            if #items > 0 then
                table.sort(items, function(resultValue, argument)
                    return (resultValue.playing or 0) > (argument.playing or 0)
                end)
                local resultValue = math.min(5, #items)
                local resultValue2 = items[math.random(1, resultValue)]
                if resultValue2 and resultValue2.id then
                    local succeeded = pcall(function()
                        teleportServiceService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(
                            placeId,
                            resultValue2.id,
                            playersService.LocalPlayer
                        )
                    end)
                    if succeeded then
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            if not decodedData then
            else
            end
        end
    else
    end
    pcall(function()
        teleportServiceService:Teleport(placeId, playersService.LocalPlayer)
    end)
end

task.spawn(function()
    local items = {}

        local remotes = replicatedStorageService:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        if remotes then

            if events then
                local halloween = events:FindFirstChild("Halloween")
                if halloween then
                    local crush = halloween:FindFirstChild("Crush")
                    if crush then
                        return crush
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, descendant in ipairs(remotes:GetDescendants()) do
                if
                    (descendant:IsA("RemoteEvent") or descendant:IsA("RemoteFunction"))
                    and descendant.Name == "Crush"
                then
                    return descendant
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function handleAction2(resultValue)
        if not resultValue then
            return nil
        end
        if resultValue:IsA("BasePart") then
            return resultValue
        end

            local hb = resultValue:FindFirstChild("HB")
                or resultValue:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
                or resultValue:FindFirstChild("HitBox")
            if hb and hb:IsA("BasePart") then
                return hb
            end
            return resultValue.PrimaryPart or resultValue:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        end
        return nil
    end

            return nil
        end

                            local transform = CFrame.new(resultValue.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
                            local distance = (resultValue.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                            if distance > 4.5 then
                                local enabled = false
                                if featureSettings.AutoFarmPathfinding and _G.VD_SmartWalkTo then
                                    enabled = _G.VD_SmartWalkTo(transform, 4, function()
                                        return not featureSettings.AutoPumpkin
                                    end)
                                end
                                if
                                    not enabled
                                    and (resultValue.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude > 6
                                    and featureSettings.AutoPumpkin
                                then
                                    safeSegmentedTeleport(humanoidRootPart, transform)
                                end
                            end
                            if
                                humanoidRootPart
                                and item.Parent
                                and (resultValue.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude <= 7
                            then
                                local resultValue2 = handleAction()
                                local resultValue3 = handleAction3(item)
                                local sum = 0
                                local enabled = false
                                while
                                    sum < 3
                                    and item.Parent
                                    and item:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
                                    and featureSettings.AutoPumpkin
                                do
                                    sum = sum + 1
                                    if resultValue2 then
                                        pcall(function()
                                            resultValue2:FireServer(resultValue3)
                                        end)
                                    end
                                    pcall(function()
                                        local playerGui = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
                                        local pcprompts = playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("pcprompts")
                                        local frame = pcprompts and pcprompts:FindFirstChild("Frame")
                                        local pumpkinstomp = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("pumpkinstomp")
                                        if pumpkinstomp and pumpkinstomp.Visible then
                                            local virtualInputManagerService = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
                                            if virtualInputManagerService then
                                                virtualInputManagerService:SendKeyEvent(
                                                    true,
                                                    Enum.KeyCode.Space,
                                                    false,
                                                    game
                                                )
                                                task.wait(0.05)
                                                virtualInputManagerService:SendKeyEvent(
                                                    false,
                                                    Enum.KeyCode.Space,
                                                    false,
                                                    game
                                                )
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end)
                                    task.wait(0.35)
                                    if not item.Parent or not item:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
                                        enabled = true
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                                if not enabled and item.Parent then
                                    items[item] = tick() + 15
                                else
                                    local matchIndex = table.find(cachedPumpkins, item)
                                    if matchIndex then
                                        table.remove(cachedPumpkins, matchIndex)
                                    end
                                    pcall(function()
                                        removeModelESP(item, "Pumpkins")
                                    end)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        _G.VD_CurrentFarmState = "ALL PUMPKINS CRUSHED"
                        if _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus then
                            pcall(function()
                                _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus("ALL PUMPKINS CRUSHED")
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                else
                    _G.VD_CurrentFarmState = "PUMPKIN (KILLER NEAR)"
                    if _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus then
                        pcall(function()
                            _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus("PUMPKIN (KILLER NEAR)")
                        end)
                    end
                    task.wait(0.5)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
_G.VD_KillerFarmState = _G.VD_KillerFarmState or {}

task.spawn(function()
    local player = nil
    local function handleAction()
        local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
        local characterValue2 = localPlayer:GetAttribute("IsCarrying") == true
            or characterValue and characterValue:GetAttribute("IsCarrying") == true
        if characterValue2 then
            local enabled = false
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player ~= localPlayer then
                    local characterValue = player.Character
                    if
                        player:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true
                        or characterValue and characterValue:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true
                        or getModelValue and characterValue and getModelValue(characterValue, "IsCarried") == true
                    then
                        enabled = true
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if not enabled then
                local lastGrabTime = _G.VD_KillerFarmState.lastGrabTime or 0
                if tick() - lastGrabTime > 4 then
                    characterValue2 = false
                end
            end
        end
        return characterValue2
    end
    local function handleAction2(resultValue, argument)
        local timestamp = tick()
        local hookedBlacklist = _G.VD_KillerFarmState.hookedBlacklist
        if hookedBlacklist[resultValue] and timestamp < hookedBlacklist[resultValue] then
            return true
        elseif hookedBlacklist[resultValue] then
            hookedBlacklist[resultValue] = nil
        end
        if resultValue:GetAttribute("IsOccupied") == true or resultValue:GetAttribute("Occupied") == true then
            return true
        end
        local parent = resultValue.Parent
        if parent then
            if parent:GetAttribute("IsOccupied") == true or parent:GetAttribute("Occupied") == true then
                return true
            end
        end
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player == localPlayer or player == argument then
                continue
            end
            local characterValue = player.Character
            if not characterValue then
                continue
            end
            local humanoidRootPart = characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not humanoidRootPart then
                continue
            end
            local distance = (
                humanoidRootPart.Position
                - (
                    localPlayer.Character
                        and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        and localPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
                    or humanoidRootPart.Position
                )
            ).Magnitude
            local getModelValue2 = player:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true
                or characterValue:GetAttribute("IsCarried") == true
                or getModelValue and getModelValue(characterValue, "IsCarried") == true
                or distance < 4
            if getModelValue2 then
                continue

                or player:GetAttribute("IsHooked") == true
                or getModelValue and getModelValue(characterValue, "IsHooked") == true

            if getModelValue3 and distance2 < 15 then
                return true
            end
            if not getModelValue3 and distance2 < 8 then
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function handleAction3(resultValue, argument)
        local hookPoint = nil
        local huge = math.huge
        for _, hook in ipairs(cachedHooks) do

                or hook:IsA("Model") and hook.PrimaryPart
                or hook:FindFirstChild("HookPoint", true)
                or hook:FindFirstChild("Handle", true)
                or hook:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            if hookPoint2 and not handleAction2(hookPoint2, argument) then
                local distance = (hookPoint2.Position - resultValue).Magnitude
                if distance < huge then
                    huge = distance
                    hookPoint = hookPoint2
                end
            end
        end
        return hookPoint

    local function handleAction4()
        local items = {}

                continue

                    team.Name == "Survivors"

                        table.insert(items2, humanoidRootPart.Position)
                    else
                        table.insert(items, player)
                    end

    local function handleAction5(resultValue)

            return nil

                end

                if distance < huge2 then
                    huge2 = distance
                end
            end
            if huge2 > huge then
                huge = huge2
                item = item2
            end
        end

            for _, item2 in ipairs(resultValue) do

            if vectorValue3.Magnitude < 0.1 then
                vectorValue3 = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
            else
                vectorValue3 = vectorValue3.Unit
            end
            item = vectorValue + vectorValue3 * 180 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)

    local function handleAction6()
        local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoidRootPart then

    local function handleAction7(vdCurrentFarmState)

        if _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus then
            pcall(function()
                _G.VD_UpdateFarmStatus(vdCurrentFarmState)

        end
    end
    while activeLoop do

        if not isKillerFarmAllowed() then
            task.wait(numberValue)
            continue
        end
        local characterValue = localPlayer.Character

        else
            numberValue = 0.15

                                    hookCommit:FireServer(resultValue2)
                                end)
                            end
                            task.wait(0.15)
                        end

                        if not proximityPrompt and parent then

(function()
    rebuildMobileButtons = function()
        if not isMobile then
            return
        end
        if mobileFloatingButtons then
            for _, button in pairs(mobileFloatingButtons) do
                pcall(function()
                    button:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            table.clear(mobileFloatingButtons)
        end
        if featureSettings.MobileButtons then
            for key, mobileButton in pairs(featureSettings.MobileButtons) do
                if mobileButton and mobileButton ~= "" and mobileButton ~= "None" then
                    pcall(createOrUpdateMobileFloatingButton, key, mobileButton)
                end
            end
        end
    end
