function updateMobileAimbotButton()
    local enabled = featureSettings.RevolverAimbot.Enabled
    if enabled and isMobile then
        if not _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton or not _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton.Parent then
            if _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton then
                pcall(function()
                    _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            local vdMobileAimbotGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            vdMobileAimbotGui.Name = "VD_MobileAimbotGui"
            vdMobileAimbotGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
            vdMobileAimbotGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
            pcall(function()
                vdMobileAimbotGui.Parent = guiParent
            end)
            if not vdMobileAimbotGui.Parent then
                vdMobileAimbotGui.Parent = billboardParent
            end
            local aimbotButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
            aimbotButton.Name = "AimbotButton"
            aimbotButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 75)
            aimbotButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.8, -37, 0.55, -37)
            aimbotButton.BackgroundColor3 = _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive and Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 255)
                or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            aimbotButton.BackgroundTransparency = _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive and 0.3 or 0.5
            aimbotButton.Text = "AIM"
            aimbotButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            aimbotButton.Font = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
            aimbotButton.TextSize = 16
            aimbotButton.Parent = vdMobileAimbotGui
            local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
            uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
            uiCorner.Parent = aimbotButton
            local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            uiStroke.Thickness = 2
            uiStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            uiStroke.Transparency = 0.3
            uiStroke.Parent = aimbotButton
            local position = nil
            local position2 = nil
            local enabled = false
            local input = nil
            aimbotButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input2)
                if
                    input2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                    or input2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                then
                    position = input2.Position
                    position2 = aimbotButton.Position
                    enabled = false
                    local connection
                    connection = input2.Changed:Connect(function()
                        if input2.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                            position = nil
                            input = nil
                            if connection then
                                connection:Disconnect()
                            end
                            if not enabled then
                                _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive = not _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive
                                if _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive then
                                    aimbotButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 255)
                                    aimbotButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
                                else
                                    aimbotButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                                    aimbotButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
            aimbotButton.InputChanged:Connect(function(input2)
                if
                    input2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                    or input2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                then
                    input = input2
                end
            end)
            registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(resultValue)
                if resultValue == input and position then
                    local vectorValue = resultValue.Position - position
                    if vectorValue.Magnitude > 5 then
                        enabled = true
                    end
                    aimbotButton.Position = UDim2.new(
                        position2.X.Scale,
                        position2.X.Offset + vectorValue.X,
                        position2.Y.Scale,
                        position2.Y.Offset + vectorValue.Y
                    )
                end
            end))
            _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton = vdMobileAimbotGui
        else
            _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton.Enabled = true
            local aimbotButton = _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton:FindFirstChild("AimbotButton")
            if aimbotButton then
                aimbotButton.BackgroundColor3 = _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive and Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 255)
                    or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                aimbotButton.BackgroundTransparency = _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive and 0.3 or 0.5
            end
        end
    else
        if _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton then
            _G.VD_AimbotMobileButton.Enabled = false
            _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive = false
        end
    end
end
local function selectPriorityTarget(candidates, priority, limit)
    if not candidates or #candidates == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    limit = math.max(limit or 150, 1)
    if priority == "Furthest" then
        table.sort(candidates, function(resultValue, argument)
            if math.abs(resultValue.dist - argument.dist) > 0.01 then
                return resultValue.dist > argument.dist
            end
            return resultValue.health < argument.health
        end)
    elseif priority == "Injured" then
        table.sort(candidates, function(resultValue, argument)
            if math.abs(resultValue.health - argument.health) > 0.01 then
                return resultValue.health < argument.health
            end
            return resultValue.dist < argument.dist
        end)
    elseif priority == "Healed" then
        table.sort(candidates, function(resultValue, argument)
            if math.abs(resultValue.health - argument.health) > 0.01 then
                return resultValue.health > argument.health
            end
            return resultValue.dist < argument.dist
        end)
    elseif priority == "NearestInjured" then
        table.sort(candidates, function(resultValue, argument)
            local ratio = resultValue.dist / limit
            local ratio2 = argument.dist / limit
            local resultValue2 = math.max(resultValue.maxHealth or 100, 1)
            local resultValue3 = math.max(argument.maxHealth or 100, 1)
            local clampedValue = math.clamp(resultValue.health / resultValue2, 0, 1)
            local clampedValue2 = math.clamp(argument.health / resultValue3, 0, 1)
            local sum = 0.5 * ratio + 0.5 * clampedValue
            local sum2 = 0.5 * ratio2 + 0.5 * clampedValue2
            if math.abs(sum - sum2) > 0.001 then
                return sum < sum2
            end
            return resultValue.dist < argument.dist
        end)
    elseif priority == "NearestHealed" then
        table.sort(candidates, function(resultValue, argument)
            local ratio = resultValue.dist / limit
            local ratio2 = argument.dist / limit
            local resultValue2 = math.max(resultValue.maxHealth or 100, 1)
            local resultValue3 = math.max(argument.maxHealth or 100, 1)
            local clampedValue = math.clamp(resultValue.health / resultValue2, 0, 1)
            local clampedValue2 = math.clamp(argument.health / resultValue3, 0, 1)
            local sum = 0.5 * ratio + 0.5 * (1 - clampedValue)
            local sum2 = 0.5 * ratio2 + 0.5 * (1 - clampedValue2)
            if math.abs(sum - sum2) > 0.001 then
                return sum < sum2
            end
            return resultValue.dist < argument.dist
        end)
    elseif priority == "FurthestInjured" then
        table.sort(candidates, function(resultValue, argument)
            local ratio = resultValue.dist / limit
            local ratio2 = argument.dist / limit
            local resultValue2 = math.max(resultValue.maxHealth or 100, 1)
            local resultValue3 = math.max(argument.maxHealth or 100, 1)
            local clampedValue = math.clamp(resultValue.health / resultValue2, 0, 1)
            local clampedValue2 = math.clamp(argument.health / resultValue3, 0, 1)
            local sum = 0.5 * (1 - ratio) + 0.5 * clampedValue
            local sum2 = 0.5 * (1 - ratio2) + 0.5 * clampedValue2
            if math.abs(sum - sum2) > 0.001 then
                return sum < sum2
            end
            return resultValue.dist > argument.dist
        end)
    elseif priority == "FurthestHealed" then
        table.sort(candidates, function(resultValue, argument)
            local ratio = resultValue.dist / limit
            local ratio2 = argument.dist / limit
            local resultValue2 = math.max(resultValue.maxHealth or 100, 1)
            local resultValue3 = math.max(argument.maxHealth or 100, 1)
            local clampedValue = math.clamp(resultValue.health / resultValue2, 0, 1)
            local clampedValue2 = math.clamp(argument.health / resultValue3, 0, 1)
            local sum = 0.5 * (1 - ratio) + 0.5 * (1 - clampedValue)
            local sum2 = 0.5 * (1 - ratio2) + 0.5 * (1 - clampedValue2)
            if math.abs(sum - sum2) > 0.001 then
                return sum < sum2
            end
            return resultValue.dist > argument.dist
        end)
    else
        table.sort(candidates, function(resultValue, argument)
            if math.abs(resultValue.dist - argument.dist) > 0.01 then
                return resultValue.dist < argument.dist
            end
            return resultValue.health < argument.health
        end)
    end
    return candidates[1]
end
function getClosestPlayerToMouse()
    local revolverAimbot = featureSettings.RevolverAimbot or {}
    local radius = revolverAimbot.Radius or 150
    local priority = revolverAimbot.Priority or "Nearest"
    local camera2 = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera2 then
        return nil
    end
    local vectorValue = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    if isMobile then
        vectorValue = Vector2.new(camera2.ViewportSize.X / 2, camera2.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    end
    local team = localPlayer.Team
    local items = {}
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player == localPlayer then
            continue
        end
        if team and player.Team == team then
            continue
        end
        local characterValue = player.Character
        local humanoid = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local humanoidRootPart = characterValue
            and (
                characterValue:FindFirstChild(revolverAimbot.TargetPart or "UpperTorso")
                or characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            )
        if characterValue and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and humanoidRootPart then
            local vectorValue2, resultValue = camera2:WorldToViewportPoint(humanoidRootPart.Position)
            if resultValue then
                local dist = (Vector2.new(vectorValue2.X, vectorValue2.Y) - vectorValue).Magnitude
                if dist <= radius then
                    table.insert(items, {
                        root = humanoidRootPart,
                        dist = dist,
                        health = humanoid.Health,
                        maxHealth = math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1),
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local resultValue = selectPriorityTarget(items, priority, radius)
    return resultValue and resultValue.root or nil
end
function updateFOVCircle()
    local revolverAimbot = featureSettings.RevolverAimbot
        and featureSettings.RevolverAimbot.Enabled
        and featureSettings.RevolverAimbot.ShowFOV
    local revolverAimbot2 = featureSettings.RevolverAimbot and featureSettings.RevolverAimbot.Radius or 150
    local camera2 = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera2 then
        return
    end
    local vectorValue = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    if isMobile then
        vectorValue = Vector2.new(camera2.ViewportSize.X / 2, camera2.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    end
    pcall(function()
        if not _G.VD_FovGui or not _G.VD_FovGui.Parent then
            if _G.VD_FovGui then
                pcall(function()
                    _G.VD_FovGui:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            _G.VD_FovGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            _G.VD_FovGui.Name = "VD_AimbotFOVScreenGui"
            _G.VD_FovGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
            _G.VD_FovGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
            if isMobile then
                _G.VD_FovGui.Parent = billboardParent
            else
                pcall(function()
                    _G.VD_FovGui.Parent = guiParent
                end)
                if not _G.VD_FovGui.Parent then
                    _G.VD_FovGui.Parent = billboardParent
                end
            end
            _G.VD_FovFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
            _G.VD_FovFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            _G.VD_FovFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            _G.VD_FovFrame.Active = false
            _G.VD_FovFrame.Selectable = false
            _G.VD_FovFrame.Parent = _G.VD_FovGui
            local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", _G.VD_FovFrame)
            uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
            local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", _G.VD_FovFrame)
            uiStroke.Thickness = 1.5
            uiStroke.Color = UI.Accent
            uiStroke.Transparency = 0.4
        end
        if revolverAimbot then
            _G.VD_FovFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, vectorValue.X, 0, vectorValue.Y)
            _G.VD_FovFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, revolverAimbot2 * 2, 0, revolverAimbot2 * 2)
            _G.VD_FovGui.Enabled = true
        else
            _G.VD_FovGui.Enabled = false
        end
    end)
end
local crosshairCacheKey = ""
function updateCrosshair()
    local showCrosshair = featureSettings.ShowCrosshair
        or featureSettings.RevolverAimbot
            and featureSettings.RevolverAimbot.Enabled
            and featureSettings.RevolverAimbot.ShowCrosshair
    local crosshairStyle = featureSettings.CrosshairStyle
        or featureSettings.RevolverAimbot and featureSettings.RevolverAimbot.CrosshairStyle
        or "Classic"
    local backgroundColor = featureSettings.CrosshairColor or Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
    local crosshairSize = featureSettings.CrosshairSize or 10
    local ratio = crosshairSize / 10
    local combinedText = tostring(showCrosshair)
        .. "_"
        .. tostring(crosshairStyle)
        .. "_"
        .. tostring(backgroundColor:ToHex())
        .. "_"
        .. tostring(crosshairSize)
    if combinedText == crosshairCacheKey and _G.VD_CrosshairGui and _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Parent then
        return
    end
    crosshairCacheKey = combinedText
    pcall(function()
        if _G.VD_CrosshairGui then
            pcall(function()
                _G.VD_CrosshairGui:Destroy()
            end)
            _G.VD_CrosshairGui = nil
        end
        if not showCrosshair then
            return
        end
        _G.VD_CrosshairGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Name = "VD_CrosshairScreenGui"
        _G.VD_CrosshairGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        _G.VD_CrosshairGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        if isMobile then
            _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Parent = billboardParent
        else
            pcall(function()
                _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Parent = guiParent
            end)
            if not _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Parent then
                _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Parent = billboardParent
            end
        end
        local centerContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
        centerContainer.Name = "CenterContainer"
        centerContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        centerContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        centerContainer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        centerContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        centerContainer.Parent = _G.VD_CrosshairGui
        local matchesCondition = crosshairStyle == "Tactical"
            or crosshairStyle == "Dot"
            or crosshairStyle == "Dot & Circle"
        local matchesCondition2 = crosshairStyle == "Tactical"
            or crosshairStyle == "Circle"
            or crosshairStyle == "Dot & Circle"
        local matchesCondition3 = crosshairStyle == "Tactical" or crosshairStyle == "Classic"
        if matchesCondition then
            local resultValue = math.max(2, math.round(3 * ratio))
            _G.VD_CenterDot = Instance.new("Frame")
            _G.VD_CenterDot.Name = "CenterDot"
            _G.VD_CenterDot.Size = UDim2.new(0, resultValue, 0, resultValue)
            _G.VD_CenterDot.Position = UDim2.new(0, -resultValue / 2, 0, -resultValue / 2)
            _G.VD_CenterDot.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor
            _G.VD_CenterDot.BorderSizePixel = 0
            _G.VD_CenterDot.Parent = centerContainer
            local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", _G.VD_CenterDot)
            uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
            local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", _G.VD_CenterDot)
            uiStroke.Thickness = 1
            uiStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        end
        if matchesCondition2 then
            local matchesCondition4 = crosshairStyle == "Circle" and 12 or 14
            local resultValue = math.max(6, math.round(matchesCondition4 * ratio))
            local sum = resultValue + 2
            local gapCircle = Instance.new("Frame")
            gapCircle.Name = "GapCircle"
            gapCircle.Size = UDim2.new(0, resultValue, 0, resultValue)
            gapCircle.Position = UDim2.new(0, -resultValue / 2, 0, -resultValue / 2)
            gapCircle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            gapCircle.Parent = centerContainer
            local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", gapCircle)
            uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
            local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", gapCircle)
            uiStroke.Thickness = math.max(1, 1.2 * ratio)
            uiStroke.Color = backgroundColor
            local shadowCircle = Instance.new("Frame")
            shadowCircle.Name = "ShadowCircle"
            shadowCircle.Size = UDim2.new(0, sum, 0, sum)
            shadowCircle.Position = UDim2.new(0, -sum / 2, 0, -sum / 2)
            shadowCircle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            shadowCircle.Parent = centerContainer
            local uiCorner2 = Instance.new("UICorner", shadowCircle)
            uiCorner2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
            local uiStroke2 = Instance.new("UIStroke", shadowCircle)
            uiStroke2.Thickness = 1
            uiStroke2.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            uiStroke2.Transparency = 0.5
        end
        if matchesCondition3 then
            local resultValue = math.max(1, math.round(1.5 * ratio))
            local ratio2 = resultValue / 2
            local items = {}
            if crosshairStyle == "Tactical" then
                local resultValue2 = math.max(2, math.round(4 * ratio))
                local resultValue3 = math.max(4, math.round(9 * ratio))
                items = {
                    {
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, resultValue, 0, resultValue2),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, -ratio2, 0, -(resultValue3 + resultValue2)),
                    },
                    {
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, resultValue, 0, resultValue2),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, -ratio2, 0, resultValue3),
                    },
                    {
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, resultValue2, 0, resultValue),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, -(resultValue3 + resultValue2), 0, -ratio2),
                    },
                    {
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, resultValue2, 0, resultValue),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, resultValue3, 0, -ratio2),
                    },
                }
            else
                local resultValue2 = math.max(3, math.round(8 * ratio))
                local resultValue3 = math.max(1, math.round(2 * ratio))
                items = {
                    {
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, resultValue, 0, resultValue2),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, -ratio2, 0, -(resultValue3 + resultValue2)),
                    },
                    {
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, resultValue, 0, resultValue2),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, -ratio2, 0, resultValue3),
                    },
                    {
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, resultValue2, 0, resultValue),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, -(resultValue3 + resultValue2), 0, -ratio2),
                    },
                    {
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, resultValue2, 0, resultValue),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, resultValue3, 0, -ratio2),
                    },
                }
            end
            for _, item in ipairs(items) do
                local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
                frame.Size = item.Size
                frame.Position = item.Position
                frame.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor
                frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
                frame.Parent = centerContainer
                local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
                uiStroke.Thickness = 1
                uiStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            end
        end
        _G.VD_CrosshairGui.Enabled = true
    end)
end
function runAimbot()
    local enabled = featureSettings.RevolverAimbot.Enabled
    if not enabled then
        updateFOVCircle()
        if isMobile then
            updateMobileAimbotButton()
        end
        _G.VD_AimbotTarget = nil
        return
    end
    updateFOVCircle()
    if isMobile then
        updateMobileAimbotButton()
    end
    local vdIsMobileAimbotActive = false
    if isMobile then
        vdIsMobileAimbotActive = _G.VD_IsMobileAimbotActive
    else
        local key = featureSettings.RevolverAimbot.Key or "MouseButton2"
        if key == "MouseButton2" then
            vdIsMobileAimbotActive = UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2)
        elseif key == "MouseButton1" then
            vdIsMobileAimbotActive = UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
        else
            pcall(function()
                vdIsMobileAimbotActive = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode[key])
            end)
        end
    end
    if vdIsMobileAimbotActive then
        if
            not _G.VD_AimbotTarget
            or not _G.VD_AimbotTarget.Parent
            or not _G.VD_AimbotTarget.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            or _G.VD_AimbotTarget.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health <= 0
        then
            _G.VD_AimbotTarget = getClosestPlayerToMouse()
        end
        if _G.VD_AimbotTarget then
            local part = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if part then
                local position = _G.VD_AimbotTarget.Position
                if featureSettings.RevolverAimbot.PredictionEnabled then
                    local parent = _G.VD_AimbotTarget.Parent
                    local humanoidRootPart = parent and parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if humanoidRootPart then
                        local distance = (part.CFrame.Position - position).Magnitude
                        local bulletVelocity = featureSettings.RevolverAimbot.BulletVelocity or 800
                        local ratio = distance / bulletVelocity
                        local assemblyLinearVelocity = humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                        position = position + assemblyLinearVelocity * ratio
                    end
                end
                position = position
                    + part.CFrame.RightVector * ((featureSettings.RevolverAimbot.OffsetX or 0) / 10)
                    + part.CFrame.UpVector * ((featureSettings.RevolverAimbot.OffsetY or 0) / 10)
                pcall(function()
                    local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
                    local humanoidRootPart = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if humanoidRootPart then
                        local vectorValue = Vector3.new(position.X, humanoidRootPart.Position.Y, position.Z)
                        humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(humanoidRootPart.Position, vectorValue)
                    end
                end)
                local transform = CFrame.new(part.CFrame.Position, position)
                local smoothness = featureSettings.RevolverAimbot.Smoothness or 0.15
                if smoothness <= 0 then
                    part.CFrame = transform
                else
                    part.CFrame = part.CFrame:Lerp(transform, smoothness)
                end
            end
        end
    else
        _G.VD_AimbotTarget = nil
    end
end
RunService:BindToRenderStep("VD_Aimbot", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, runAimbot)

                local lowercaseText = descendant.Parent.Name:lower()
                if lowercaseText:find("twist") or lowercaseText:find("fate") or lowercaseText:find("revolver") then

            end
        end

    end
    local function getHumanoid(resultValue3)
        pcall(function()

            local humanoid = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if humanoid and not resultValue2 then
                local animation = Instance.new("Animation")

                resultValue2 = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animation)
                resultValue2:Play()

            if characterValue then

            local resultValue3 = handleAction2()

        end)

    local function handleAction5()
        pcall(function()
            if resultValue2 then
                resultValue2:Stop()
                resultValue2 = nil
            end
            local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
            if characterValue then
                characterValue:SetAttribute("Aiming", false)
            end
        end)
    end
    local function handleAction6()

(function()
    local aimAssistClosestTarget = nil
    local resultValue = false
    local vdAimAssistFOVScreenGui = nil
    local frame = nil
    local drawing = nil
    local vdMobileAimAssistGui = nil
    local resultValue2 = false
    local function handleAction(player)
        if player:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or player:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true then
            return true
        end
        if
            player.Character
            and (player.Character:GetAttribute("Role") == "Killer" or player.Character:GetAttribute("IsKiller") == true)
        then
            return true
        end
        local team = player.Team
        if team then
            local lowercaseText = team.Name:lower()
            if lowercaseText:find("killer") or lowercaseText:find("slasher") or lowercaseText:find("monster") then
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    function getAimAssistClosestTarget()
        local aimAssist = featureSettings.AimAssist or {}
        local fov = aimAssist.FOV or 150
        local childName = aimAssist.TargetPart or "UpperTorso"
        local targetTeam = aimAssist.TargetTeam or "Both"
        local priority = aimAssist.Priority or "Nearest"
        local camera2 = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera2 then
            return nil
        end
        local vectorValue = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        if isMobile then
            vectorValue = Vector2.new(camera2.ViewportSize.X / 2, camera2.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
        end
        local items = {}
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player == localPlayer then
                continue
            end
            local resultValue = handleAction(player)
            if targetTeam == "Survivors" and resultValue then
                continue
            end
            if targetTeam == "Killer" and not resultValue then
                continue
            end
            local characterValue = player.Character
            local humanoid = characterValue and characterValue:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local humanoidRootPart = characterValue
                and (
                    characterValue:FindFirstChild(childName)
                    or characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    or characterValue:FindFirstChild("Head")
                )
            if characterValue and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and humanoidRootPart then
                local vectorValue2, resultValue2 = camera2:WorldToViewportPoint(humanoidRootPart.Position)
                if resultValue2 then
                    local dist = (Vector2.new(vectorValue2.X, vectorValue2.Y) - vectorValue).Magnitude
                    if dist <= fov then
                        table.insert(items, {
                            part = humanoidRootPart,
                            dist = dist,
                            health = humanoid.Health,
                            maxHealth = math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1),
                        })
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local resultValue = selectPriorityTarget(items, priority, fov)
        return resultValue and resultValue.part or nil
    end

                        or input2.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                    then
                        input = input2
                    end
                end)
                registerConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(resultValue)
                    if resultValue == input and position then
                        local vectorValue = resultValue.Position - position
                        if vectorValue.Magnitude > 5 then
                            enabled = true
                        end
                        aimAssistButton.Position = UDim2.new(
                            position2.X.Scale,
                            position2.X.Offset + vectorValue.X,
                            position2.Y.Scale,
                            position2.Y.Offset + vectorValue.Y
                        )
                    end
                end))
                vdMobileAimAssistGui = vdMobileAimAssistGui2
            else
                vdMobileAimAssistGui.Enabled = true
                local aimAssistButton = vdMobileAimAssistGui:FindFirstChild("AimAssistButton")
                if aimAssistButton then
                    aimAssistButton.BackgroundColor3 = resultValue2 and Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)
                        or Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 25)
                    aimAssistButton.BackgroundTransparency = resultValue2 and 0.25 or 0.5
                end
            end
        else
            if vdMobileAimAssistGui then
                vdMobileAimAssistGui.Enabled = false
                resultValue2 = false
            end
        end
    end
    registerConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, argument)
        if argument or isBindingKey then
            return
        end
        local aimAssist = featureSettings.AimAssist
        if not aimAssist or not aimAssist.Enabled then
            return
        end
        if aimAssist.Mode == "Toggle" then
            local key = aimAssist.Key or "MouseButton2"
            local enabled = false
            if key == "MouseButton2" and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
                enabled = true
            elseif key == "MouseButton1" and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                enabled = true
            elseif
                (
                    input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard
                    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
                ) and input.KeyCode.Name == key
            then
                enabled = true
            end
            if enabled then
                resultValue = not resultValue
                showNotification(
                    "Aim Assist",
                    resultValue and "Aim Assist ACTIVATED" or "Aim Assist DEACTIVATED",
                    resultValue and "success" or "info"
                )
            end
        end
    end))
    local enabled = nil
    local function handleAction4()
        local aimAssist = featureSettings.AimAssist or {}
        if not aimAssist.Enabled then
            if enabled ~= false then
                enabled = false
                handleAction2()
                if isMobile then
                    handleAction3()
                end
                aimAssistClosestTarget = nil
            end
            return
        end
        enabled = true
        handleAction2()
        if isMobile then
            handleAction3()
        end
        local resultValue3 = false
        if isMobile then
            resultValue3 = resultValue2
        elseif aimAssist.Mode == "Toggle" then
            resultValue3 = resultValue
        else
            local key = aimAssist.Key or "MouseButton2"
            if key == "MouseButton2" then
                resultValue3 = UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2)
            elseif key == "MouseButton1" then
                resultValue3 = UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
            else
                pcall(function()
                    if key:find("Button") or key:find("DPad") then
                        resultValue3 =
                            UserInputService:IsGamepadButtonDown(Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1, Enum.KeyCode[key])
                    else
                        resultValue3 = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode[key])
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        if resultValue3 then
            if
                not aimAssistClosestTarget
                or not aimAssistClosestTarget.Parent
                or not aimAssistClosestTarget.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                or aimAssistClosestTarget.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health <= 0
            then
                aimAssistClosestTarget = getAimAssistClosestTarget()
            end
            if aimAssistClosestTarget then
                local part = workspace.CurrentCamera
                if part then
                    local position = aimAssistClosestTarget.Position
                    if aimAssist.Prediction then
                        local parent = aimAssistClosestTarget.Parent
                        local humanoidRootPart = parent and parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if humanoidRootPart then
                            local distance = (part.CFrame.Position - position).Magnitude
                            local ratio = distance / 1000
                            position = position + humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity * ratio
                        end
                    end
                    local transform = CFrame.new(part.CFrame.Position, position)
                    local smoothness = aimAssist.Smoothness or 0.2
                    if smoothness >= 0.95 then
                        part.CFrame = transform
                    else
                        part.CFrame = part.CFrame:Lerp(transform, smoothness)
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            aimAssistClosestTarget = nil
        end
    end
    RunService:BindToRenderStep("VD_AimAssist", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, handleAction4)
end)()

local velocityCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
function getSmoothedVelocity(target, velocity, part)
    local items = velocityCache[target]
    local time = tick()
    local ratio = velocity
    if part and typeof(part) == "Instance" and part:IsA("BasePart") then
        if items and items.lastPos and time - items.time > 0.001 and time - items.time < 0.5 then
            local difference = time - items.time
            ratio = (part.Position - items.lastPos) / difference
        end
    end
    if velocity.Magnitude < 0.5 and ratio.Magnitude < 0.5 then
        if not items then
            items = {}
            velocityCache[target] = items
        end
        items.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        items.time = time
        items.lastPos = part and typeof(part) == "Instance" and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Position or nil
        return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    end
    if ratio.Magnitude > 60 then
        ratio = velocity
    end
    if velocity.Magnitude > 60 then
        velocity = ratio.Magnitude <= 60 and ratio or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    end
    local velocity2 = velocity:Lerp(ratio, 0.5)
    if velocity2.Magnitude > 40 then
        velocity2 = velocity2.Unit * 40
    end
    if not items or time - items.time > 0.5 then
        if not items then
            items = {}
            velocityCache[target] = items
        end
        items.velocity = velocity2
        items.time = time
        items.lastPos = part and typeof(part) == "Instance" and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Position or nil
        return velocity2
    end
    if items.velocity and items.velocity.Magnitude > 1.5 and velocity2.Magnitude > 1.5 then
        local resultValue = items.velocity.Unit:Dot(velocity2.Unit)
        if resultValue < 0.25 then
            items.velocity = velocity2
            items.time = time
            items.lastPos = part and typeof(part) == "Instance" and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Position or nil
            return velocity2
        end
    end
    local numberValue = 0.45
    local velocity3 = items.velocity:Lerp(velocity2, numberValue)
    if velocity3.Magnitude < 0.2 then
        velocity3 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    elseif velocity3.Magnitude > 32 then
        velocity3 = velocity3.Unit * 32
    end
    items.velocity = velocity3
    items.time = time
    items.lastPos = part and typeof(part) == "Instance" and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Position or nil
    return velocity3
end
local function getHalfPingSeconds()
    local succeeded, result = pcall(function()
        return game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing()
    end)
    if succeeded and type(result) == "number" and result > 0 then
        return math.clamp(result * 0.5, 0, 0.25)
    end
    return 0.035
end
function solveProjectileAim(resultValue, argument, argument2, argument3, argument4, argument5)
    local matchesCondition = argument4 and argument4 > 50 and argument4 or 150
    local matchesCondition2 = argument5 and argument5 > 0 and argument5 or 98
    local zero = argument2 or Vector3.zero
    local vectorValue = Vector3.new(zero.X, 0, zero.Z)
    local clampedValue = math.clamp(zero.Y, -4, 1.5)
    local vectorValue2 = Vector3.new(vectorValue.X, clampedValue, vectorValue.Z)
    local halfPing = getHalfPingSeconds()
    local distance = (argument - resultValue).Magnitude
    local ratio = distance / matchesCondition
    local sum = argument
    for _ = 1, 4, 1 do
        local sum2 = ratio + halfPing
        local scaledValue = vectorValue2 * sum2
        local scaledValue2 = 32 * sum2
        if scaledValue.Magnitude > scaledValue2 then
            scaledValue = scaledValue.Unit * scaledValue2
        end
        sum = argument + scaledValue + 0.5 * (argument3 or Vector3.zero) * sum2 ^ 2
        local vectorValue3 = sum - resultValue
        local distance2 = Vector3.new(vectorValue3.X, 0, vectorValue3.Z).Magnitude
        local y = vectorValue3.Y
        if matchesCondition2 == 0 then
            ratio = vectorValue3.Magnitude / matchesCondition
        else
            local scaledValue3 = 0.25 * matchesCondition2 ^ 2
            local difference = y * matchesCondition2 - matchesCondition ^ 2
            local sum3 = distance2 ^ 2 + y ^ 2
            local difference2 = difference ^ 2 - 4 * scaledValue3 * sum3
            if difference2 >= 0 then
                local ratio2 = (-difference - math.sqrt(difference2)) / (2 * scaledValue3)
                local ratio3 = (-difference + math.sqrt(difference2)) / (2 * scaledValue3)
                local ratio4 = -1
                if ratio2 > 0 and ratio3 > 0 then
                    ratio4 = math.min(ratio2, ratio3)
                elseif ratio2 > 0 then
                    ratio4 = ratio2
                elseif ratio3 > 0 then
                    ratio4 = ratio3
                end
                if ratio4 > 0 then
                    ratio = math.sqrt(ratio4)
                else
                    ratio = vectorValue3.Magnitude / matchesCondition
                end
            else
                ratio = vectorValue3.Magnitude / matchesCondition
                break
            end
        end
    end
    local difference = sum - resultValue
    local vectorValue3 = Vector3.new(0, -matchesCondition2, 0)
    local ratio2 = (difference - 0.5 * vectorValue3 * ratio ^ 2) / ratio
    return ratio2.Unit, sum
end
_G.VD_SolveProjectileAim = solveProjectileAim
_G.VD_GetSmoothedVelocity = getSmoothedVelocity

                            or humanoidRootPart.Velocity

                    end
                end
            end

            textLabel3.Parent = frame
            local hideSuggestion = false
            local function callback()
                hideSuggestion = not hideSuggestion
                textButton3.Text = hideSuggestion and "✓" or ""
                textButton3.TextColor3 = UI.AccentGreen
                options.HideSuggestion = hideSuggestion
                savePopupPreferences()
            end
            textButton3.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
            textButton4 = Instance.new("TextButton")
            textButton4.Size = textLabel3.Size
            textButton4.Position = textLabel3.Position
            textButton4.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            textButton4.Text = ""
            textButton4.ZIndex = 12
            textButton4.Parent = frame
            textButton4.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
        end
        local function destroyInstance()
            TweenService:Create(
                frame,
                TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) }
            ):Play()
            task.wait(0.25)
            frame:Destroy()
            if resultValue then
                if argument then
                    argument()
                else
                    mainFrame.Visible = true
                end
            end
        end
        textButton2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            pcall(function()
                textBox:ReleaseFocus()
            end)
            destroyInstance()
        end)
        textButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            pcall(function()
                textBox:ReleaseFocus()
            end)
            local text = textBox.Text:gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
            if #text < 5 then
                showNotification("Suggestion", "Please enter at least 5 characters!", "warning")
                return
            end
            textButton.Text = "Sending..."
            textButton.Active = false
            task.spawn(function()
                local succeeded, _ = pcall(function()
                    return sendSuggestionMessage(text)
                end)
                if succeeded then
                    showNotification("Suggestion", "Thank you for your feedback!", "success")
                    destroyInstance()
                else
                    showNotification("Error", "Failed to send suggestion. Check your connection!", "error")
                    textButton.Text = "Submit"
                    textButton.Active = true
                    TweenService:Create(textButton, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundColor3 = UI.Accent }):Play()
                end
            end)
        end)
        TweenService:Create(
            frame,
            TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, resultValue and 250 or 220) }
        ):Play()
    end

            elseif resultValue == "[/]" then
                return '<font color="#FFDC00">[/]</font>' .. resultValue2:sub(4)
            elseif resultValue == "[-]" then

                if textButton.Active then
                    TweenService:Create(textButton, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundColor3 = UI.HoverCard }):Play()
                end
            end)
            textButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                if textButton.Active then

                or fluxus and fluxus.request

            ):Play()

            frame:Destroy()
            if resultValue then
                resultValue()
            else
                mainFrame.Visible = true
            end
        end)
        TweenService:Create(
            frame,
            TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 220) }
        ):Play()

            for loopIndex = 5, 1, -1 do
                textButton.Text = "Got it (" .. tostring(loopIndex) .. "s)"

            end

            textButton.BackgroundColor3 = UI.Accent
            textButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            textButton.Active = true
            textButton.AutoButtonColor = true
        end)
    end

(function()
    local httpServiceService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local function handleAction()
        if identifyexecutor then
            local succeeded, result = pcall(identifyexecutor)
            if succeeded and result then
                return tostring(result)
            end
        end
        if getexecutorname then
            local succeeded, result = pcall(getexecutorname)
            if succeeded and result then
                return tostring(result)
            end
        end
        return "Unknown"
    end
    local function handleAction2(playtime)
        local options = { username = localPlayer.Name, executor = handleAction(), playtime = playtime }
        local httpRequest = syn and syn.request
            or http and http.request
            or http_request
            or fluxus and fluxus.request
            or request
        if httpRequest then
            pcall(function()
                httpRequest({
                    Url = (apiBaseUrl or _G.VD_SERVER_URL or "http://78.154.103.2:9156") .. "/api/log",
                    Method = "POST",
                    Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
                    Body = httpServiceService:JSONEncode(options),
                })
            end)
        end
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(60)
        handleAction2(60)
        while true do
            task.wait(300)
            handleAction2(300)
        end
    end)
end)()

                    for key, enabled3 in pairs(cachedDoFs) do

                            pcall(function()

                            end)

                    table.clear(cachedDoFs)
                end

                end

                            cachedDoFs[resultValue] = resultValue.Enabled
                        end
                        if resultValue.Enabled ~= false then
                            resultValue.Enabled = false
                        end

                end

                        pcall(function()

                        end)
                    end
                end

        end)
    end

(function()
    local name = nil
    local enabled = false
    local function handleAction()
        if enabled then
            return
        end
        if not localPlayer then
            return
        end
        local team = localPlayer.Team
        local name2 = team and team.Name or ""
        if name2 == name then
            return
        end
        name = name2
        if name2 == "Survivors" then
            local survivorConfigProfile = featureSettings.SurvivorConfigProfile
            if
                survivorConfigProfile
                and survivorConfigProfile ~= "None"
                and profileStore.profiles[survivorConfigProfile]
            then
                enabled = true
                task.spawn(function()
                    showNotification(
                        "Team Switcher",
                        "Survivor detected, loading Config: " .. survivorConfigProfile,
                        "success"
                    )
                    loadProfile(survivorConfigProfile)
                    if _G.VD_RefreshProfileList then
                        pcall(_G.VD_RefreshProfileList)
                    end
                    enabled = false
                end)
            end
        elseif name2 == "Killer" then
            local killerConfigProfile = featureSettings.KillerConfigProfile
            if killerConfigProfile and killerConfigProfile ~= "None" and profileStore.profiles[killerConfigProfile] then
                enabled = true
                task.spawn(function()
                    showNotification(
                        "Team Switcher",
                        "Killer detected, loading Config: " .. killerConfigProfile,
                        "success"
                    )
                    loadProfile(killerConfigProfile)
                    if _G.VD_RefreshProfileList then
                        pcall(_G.VD_RefreshProfileList)
                    end
                    enabled = false
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    function connectTeamSwitcher()
        if not localPlayer then
            return
        end
        registerConnection(localPlayer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(function()
            handleAction()
        end))
        handleAction()
    end
    task.spawn(connectTeamSwitcher)
end)()

local function getSurvivorHudBounds(resultValue)
    local huge, huge2 = math.huge, math.huge
    local sum, sum2 = -math.huge, -math.huge
    local enabled = false
    for _, child in ipairs(resultValue:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Name:find("^Survivor%d+$") and child.Visible then
            enabled = true
            local vectorValue = child.AbsolutePosition - resultValue.AbsolutePosition
            local absoluteSize = child.AbsoluteSize
            local x = vectorValue.X
            local y = vectorValue.Y
            local x2 = absoluteSize.X
            local y2 = absoluteSize.Y
            if x < huge then
                huge = x
            end
            if y < huge2 then
                huge2 = y
            end
            if x + x2 > sum then
                sum = x + x2
            end
            if y + y2 > sum2 then
                sum2 = y + y2
            end
        end
    end
    if enabled and sum > huge and sum2 > huge2 then
        return UDim2.new(0, huge, 0, huge2), UDim2.new(0, sum - huge, 0, sum2 - huge2)
    end
    return nil, nil
end

                    end
                    if not welcomeBackLabel or not welcomeBackLabel.Parent then
                        welcomeBackLabel = screenGui:FindFirstChild("WelcomeBackLabel", true)
                    end
                    if not welcomeBackAvatar or not welcomeBackAvatar.Parent then
                        welcomeBackAvatar = screenGui:FindFirstChild("WelcomeBackAvatar", true)
                    end
                    if not homePlayerScroll or not homePlayerScroll.Parent then
                        homePlayerScroll = screenGui:FindFirstChild("HomePlayerScroll", true)
                    end
                    local sidebarDisplayName2 = sidebarDisplayName
                    local sidebarUsername2 = sidebarUsername
                    local sidebarAvatar2 = sidebarAvatar
                    local homeHeaderName2 = homeHeaderName
                    local homeHeaderAvatar2 = homeHeaderAvatar
                    local welcomeBackLabel2 = welcomeBackLabel
                    local welcomeBackAvatar2 = welcomeBackAvatar
                    local homePlayerScroll2 = homePlayerScroll
                    if matchesCondition then
                        if sidebarDisplayName2 and sidebarDisplayName2.Text ~= "Anonymous User" then
                            sidebarDisplayName2.Text = "Anonymous User"
                        end
                        if sidebarUsername2 and sidebarUsername2.Text ~= "@Anonymous" then
                            sidebarUsername2.Text = "@Anonymous"
                        end
                        if sidebarAvatar2 and sidebarAvatar2.Image ~= "rbxassetid://0" then
                            sidebarAvatar2.Image = "rbxassetid://0"
                        end
                        if welcomeBackLabel2 and welcomeBackLabel2.Text ~= "Welcome back, Anonymous User!" then
                            welcomeBackLabel2.Text = "Welcome back, Anonymous User!"
                        end
                        if welcomeBackAvatar2 and welcomeBackAvatar2.Image ~= "rbxassetid://0" then
                            welcomeBackAvatar2.Image = "rbxassetid://0"
                        end
                        local player = _G.VD_CurrentSelectedPlayer or localPlayer
                        if player == localPlayer or player and player.UserId == localPlayer.UserId then
                            if homeHeaderName2 and homeHeaderName2.Text ~= "Anonymous User (@Anonymous)" then
                                homeHeaderName2.Text = "Anonymous User (@Anonymous)"
                            end
                            if homeHeaderAvatar2 and homeHeaderAvatar2.Image ~= "rbxassetid://0" then
                                homeHeaderAvatar2.Image = "rbxassetid://0"
                            end
                        end
                        if homePlayerScroll2 then
                            for _, child in ipairs(homePlayerScroll2:GetChildren()) do
                                if child:IsA("TextButton") and child:GetAttribute("PlayerName") == localPlayer.Name then
                                    local textLabel = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
                                    local imageLabel = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("ImageLabel")
                                    if textLabel and textLabel.Text ~= "Anonymous User" then
                                        textLabel.Text = "Anonymous User"
                                    end
                                    if imageLabel and imageLabel.Image ~= "rbxassetid://0" then
                                        imageLabel.Image = "rbxassetid://0"
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        local text = localPlayer and localPlayer.DisplayName or "User"
                        local name = localPlayer and localPlayer.Name or "User"
                        if sidebarDisplayName2 and sidebarDisplayName2.Text ~= text then
                            sidebarDisplayName2.Text = text
                        end
                        if sidebarUsername2 and sidebarUsername2.Text ~= "@" .. name then
                            sidebarUsername2.Text = "@" .. name
                        end
                        if welcomeBackLabel2 and welcomeBackLabel2.Text ~= "Welcome back, " .. text .. "!" then
                            welcomeBackLabel2.Text = "Welcome back, " .. text .. "!"
                        end
                        local player = _G.VD_CurrentSelectedPlayer or localPlayer
                        if player == localPlayer or player and player.UserId == localPlayer.UserId then
                            local text2 = text .. " (@" .. name .. ")"
                            if homeHeaderName2 and homeHeaderName2.Text ~= text2 then
                                homeHeaderName2.Text = text2
                            end
                            if homeHeaderAvatar2 then
                                local image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id="
                                    .. tostring(localPlayer.UserId)
                                    .. "&w=150&h=150"
                                if homeHeaderAvatar2.Image ~= image then
                                    homeHeaderAvatar2.Image = image
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if homePlayerScroll2 then
                            for _, child in ipairs(homePlayerScroll2:GetChildren()) do
                                if child:IsA("TextButton") and child:GetAttribute("PlayerName") == localPlayer.Name then
                                    local textLabel = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
                                    local imageLabel = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("ImageLabel")
                                    if textLabel and textLabel.Text ~= text then
                                        textLabel.Text = text
                                    end
                                    if imageLabel and imageLabel.Image == "rbxassetid://0" then
                                        imageLabel.Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id="
                                            .. tostring(localPlayer.UserId)
                                            .. "&w=150&h=150"
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
end)
local smoothedCameraPosition = nil
local function updateRenderFrame(resultValue)
    if not activeLoop then
        return
    end
    pcall(function()
        local part = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not part then
            return
        end
        local cameraStiffnessEnabled = featureSettings.CameraStiffnessEnabled
        local cameraStiffness = cameraStiffnessEnabled and featureSettings.CameraStiffness or 1
        if
            cameraStiffnessEnabled
            and cameraStiffness
            and type(cameraStiffness) == "number"
            and cameraStiffness < 0.999
            and cameraStiffness > 0
        then
            local position = part.CFrame.Position
            local difference = part.CFrame - position
            if smoothedCameraPosition then
                if (position - smoothedCameraPosition).Magnitude > 60 then
                    smoothedCameraPosition = position
                end
                local clampedValue = math.clamp(resultValue or 0.016666666666667, 0.001, 0.1)
                local scaledValue = math.clamp(cameraStiffness, 0.005, 1) * 45
                local clampedValue2 = math.clamp(1 - math.exp(-scaledValue * clampedValue), 0.001, 1)
                local resultValue2 = smoothedCameraPosition:Lerp(position, clampedValue2)
                part.CFrame = CFrame.new(resultValue2) * difference
                smoothedCameraPosition = resultValue2
            else
                smoothedCameraPosition = position
            end
        else
            smoothedCameraPosition = part.CFrame.Position
        end
        local aspectRatioEnabled = featureSettings.AspectRatioEnabled
        local aspectRatio = aspectRatioEnabled and featureSettings.AspectRatio or 1.7777777777778
        if aspectRatioEnabled and not aspectRatio and featureSettings.StretchedResolutionMode then
            local options = {
                ["4:3"] = 1.3333333333333,
                ["5:4"] = 1.25,
                ["16:10"] = 1.6,
                ["21:9"] = 2.3333333333333,
                Normal = 1.7777777777778,
                ["16:9"] = 1.7777777777778,
            }
            aspectRatio = options[featureSettings.StretchedResolutionMode] or 1.7777777777778
        end
        aspectRatio = aspectRatio or 1.7777777777778
        local numberValue = 1.7777777777778
        local aspectRatioEnabled2 = aspectRatioEnabled and math.abs(aspectRatio - numberValue) > 0.03
        local aspectRatioEnabled3 = featureSettings.FOV > 120 or aspectRatioEnabled2
        if not aspectRatioEnabled3 then
            if part.FieldOfView ~= featureSettings.FOV then
                part.FieldOfView = featureSettings.FOV
            end
            local transform = part.CFrame
            if transform.X ~= transform.X or transform.Y ~= transform.Y or transform.Z ~= transform.Z then
                return
            end
            if transform.RightVector.Magnitude < 0.01 or transform.UpVector.Magnitude < 0.01 then
                return
            end
            if
                transform.RightVector.Magnitude > 1.001
                or transform.RightVector.Magnitude < 0.999
                or transform.UpVector.Magnitude > 1.001
                or transform.UpVector.Magnitude < 0.999
            then
                part.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(transform.Position, transform.RightVector.Unit, transform.UpVector.Unit)
            end
            return
        end
        local clampedValue = 1
        local clampedValue2 = 1
        if aspectRatioEnabled2 then
            if aspectRatio < numberValue then
                clampedValue = 1
                clampedValue2 = math.clamp(aspectRatio / numberValue, 0.1, 1)
            else
                clampedValue = math.clamp(numberValue / aspectRatio, 0.1, 1)
                clampedValue2 = 1
            end
        end
        local fieldOfView = math.min(featureSettings.FOV, 120)
        if part.FieldOfView ~= fieldOfView then
            part.FieldOfView = fieldOfView
        end
        local ratio = 1
        if featureSettings.FOV > 120 then
            local resultValue2 = math.rad(featureSettings.FOV / 2)
            local resultValue = math.rad(fieldOfView / 2)
            ratio = math.tan(resultValue) / math.tan(resultValue2)
        end
        local transform = part.CFrame
        if transform.X ~= transform.X or transform.Y ~= transform.Y or transform.Z ~= transform.Z then
            return
        end
        if transform.RightVector.Magnitude < 0.01 or transform.UpVector.Magnitude < 0.01 then
            return
        end
        local resultValue2 = CFrame.fromMatrix(transform.Position, transform.RightVector.Unit, transform.UpVector.Unit)
        local scaledValue = ratio * clampedValue
        local scaledValue2 = ratio * clampedValue2
        if scaledValue ~= scaledValue or scaledValue2 ~= scaledValue2 or scaledValue == 0 or scaledValue2 == 0 then
            return
        end
        part.CFrame = resultValue2 * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0, scaledValue, 0, 0, 0, scaledValue2, 0, 0, 0, 1)
    end)
end
RunService:BindToRenderStep("VD_CameraStretch", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, updateRenderFrame);
(function()
    local options = {
        Cyan = Color3.fromRGB(0, 240, 255),
        Red = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50),
        Green = Color3.fromRGB(50, 255, 50),
        Yellow = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 50),

        Orange = Color3.fromRGB(255, 125, 0),
        Pink = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 200),
        White = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Blue = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 255),
    }
    local options2 = { gui = nil, frame = nil, corners = {} }
    setupTargetBoxGui = function()
        if options2.gui and options2.gui.Parent then
            return
        end
        local vdSilentAimTargetGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        vdSilentAimTargetGui.Name = "VD_SilentAimTargetGui"
        vdSilentAimTargetGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        vdSilentAimTargetGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        vdSilentAimTargetGui.DisplayOrder = 999

        local targetBox = Instance.new("Frame")
        targetBox.Name = "TargetBox"
        targetBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        targetBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
        targetBox.Visible = false
        targetBox.Parent = vdSilentAimTargetGui
        options2.frame = targetBox
        local numberValue = 14
        local numberValue2 = 2.5
        local function handleAction(name, anchorPoint, position, size)
            local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
            frame.Name = name
            frame.AnchorPoint = anchorPoint
            frame.Position = position
            frame.Size = size
            frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
            frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
            frame.Parent = targetBox
            return frame
        end
        options2.corners = {
            TL_H = handleAction(
                "TL_H",
                Vector2.new(0, 0),
                UDim2.new(0, -1, 0, -1),
                UDim2.new(0, numberValue, 0, numberValue2)
            ),
            TL_V = handleAction(
                "TL_V",
                Vector2.new(0, 0),
                UDim2.new(0, -1, 0, -1),
                UDim2.new(0, numberValue2, 0, numberValue)
            ),
            TR_H = handleAction(
                "TR_H",
                Vector2.new(1, 0),
                UDim2.new(1, 1, 0, -1),
                UDim2.new(0, numberValue, 0, numberValue2)
            ),
            TR_V = handleAction(
                "TR_V",
                Vector2.new(1, 0),
                UDim2.new(1, 1, 0, -1),
                UDim2.new(0, numberValue2, 0, numberValue)
            ),
            BL_H = handleAction(
                "BL_H",
                Vector2.new(0, 1),
                UDim2.new(0, -1, 1, 1),
                UDim2.new(0, numberValue, 0, numberValue2)
            ),
            BL_V = handleAction(
                "BL_V",
                Vector2.new(0, 1),
                UDim2.new(0, -1, 1, 1),
                UDim2.new(0, numberValue2, 0, numberValue)
            ),
            BR_H = handleAction(
                "BR_H",
                Vector2.new(1, 1),
                UDim2.new(1, 1, 1, 1),
                UDim2.new(0, numberValue, 0, numberValue2)
            ),
            BR_V = handleAction(
                "BR_V",
                Vector2.new(1, 1),
                UDim2.new(1, 1, 1, 1),
                UDim2.new(0, numberValue2, 0, numberValue)
            ),
        }
    end
    getSilentAimTarget = function()
        if not hasPremiumAccess() then
            return nil, nil
        end
        local characterValue = localPlayer.Character
        local camera2 = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera2 or not characterValue then
            return nil, nil
        end
        local ratio = camera2.ViewportSize / 2
        local characterValue2 = nil

        local text = nil
        local spearSilentAim = featureSettings.SpearSilentAim
            and featureSettings.SpearSilentAim.Enabled
            and featureSettings.SpearSilentAim.TargetHighlightEnabled
        local revolverSilentAim = featureSettings.RevolverSilentAim
            and featureSettings.RevolverSilentAim.Enabled
            and featureSettings.RevolverSilentAim.TargetHighlightEnabled
        if not spearSilentAim and not revolverSilentAim then
            return nil, nil
        end
        local text2 = nil
        pcall(function()
            for _, child in ipairs(characterValue:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Tool") or child:IsA("Model") then
                    local lowercaseText = child.Name:lower()
                    if
                        lowercaseText:find("twist")
                        or lowercaseText:find("fate")
                        or lowercaseText:find("revolver")
                        or child:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
                        or child:FindFirstChild("gun", true)
                    then
                        text2 = "Twist of Fate"
                        break
                    elseif lowercaseText:find("spear") or lowercaseText:find("veil") then
                        text2 = "Veil Spear"
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        local text3 = nil
        if (text2 == "Twist of Fate" or revolverSilentAim) and not spearSilentAim then
            text3 = "Revolver"
        elseif text2 == "Twist of Fate" and revolverSilentAim then
            text3 = "Revolver"
        elseif (text2 == "Veil Spear" or spearSilentAim) and not revolverSilentAim then
            text3 = "Spear"
        else
            if spearSilentAim then
                text3 = "Spear"
            elseif revolverSilentAim then
                text3 = "Revolver"
            end
        end
        if not text3 then
            return nil, nil
        end
        local fovRadius = text3 == "Spear" and (featureSettings.SpearSilentAim.FOVRadius or 240)
            or featureSettings.RevolverSilentAim.FOVRadius
            or 200
        local target = text3 == "Spear" and "Both Teams" or featureSettings.RevolverSilentAim.Target or "Both Teams"
        local items = {}
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= localPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:IsA("Model") then
                local team = player.Team and player.Team.Name or ""
                local matchesCondition = text3 == "Spear"
                    or target == "Both Teams"
                    or target == "Survivors" and team == "Survivors"
                    or target == "Killer" and team == "Killer"
                if matchesCondition then
                    local characterValue = player.Character
                    local humanoidRootPart = characterValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        or characterValue:FindFirstChild(targetPartName)
                        or characterValue:IsA("Model") and characterValue.PrimaryPart
                    local humanoid = characterValue:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if humanoidRootPart and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                        local vectorValue, resultValue = camera2:WorldToViewportPoint(humanoidRootPart.Position)
                        if resultValue and vectorValue.Z > 0 then
                            local dist = (Vector2.new(vectorValue.X, vectorValue.Y) - ratio).Magnitude
                            if dist <= fovRadius then
                                table.insert(items, {
                                    player = player,
                                    character = characterValue,
                                    part = humanoidRootPart,
                                    dist = dist,
                                    health = humanoid.Health,
                                    maxHealth = humanoid.MaxHealth or 100,
                                })
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local priority = text3 == "Spear" and (featureSettings.SpearSilentAim.Priority or "Nearest")
            or featureSettings.RevolverSilentAim.Priority
            or "Nearest"
        local resultValue = selectPriorityTarget(items, priority, fovRadius)
        if resultValue then
            characterValue2 = resultValue.character
            text = text3
        end
        return characterValue2, text
    end
    get2DBoundingBox = function(resultValue)
        local camera2 = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera2 or not resultValue then
            return nil
        end
        local head = resultValue:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local humanoidRootPart = resultValue:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or resultValue:IsA("Model") and resultValue.PrimaryPart
        if not humanoidRootPart then
            return nil
        end
        local head2 = head and head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.7, 0)
            or humanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0)
        local difference = humanoidRootPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
        local vectorValue, _ = camera2:WorldToViewportPoint(head2)
        local vectorValue2, _ = camera2:WorldToViewportPoint(difference)
        local vectorValue3, resultValue4 = camera2:WorldToViewportPoint(humanoidRootPart.Position)
        if not resultValue4 or vectorValue3.Z <= 0 then
            return nil
        end
        local magnitude = math.abs(vectorValue2.Y - vectorValue.Y)
        local clampedValue = math.clamp(magnitude * 0.6, 12, 350)
        if magnitude < 6 then
            return nil
        end
        return vectorValue3.X - clampedValue / 2, vectorValue.Y, clampedValue, magnitude
    end
    updateSilentAimTargetHighlight = function()
        local premiumAvailable = featureSettings.SpearSilentAim
            and featureSettings.SpearSilentAim.Enabled
            and hasPremiumAccess()
        local premiumAvailable2 = featureSettings.RevolverSilentAim
            and featureSettings.RevolverSilentAim.Enabled
            and hasPremiumAccess()
        if not premiumAvailable and not premiumAvailable2 then
            if options2.frame and options2.frame.Visible then
                options2.frame.Visible = false
            end
            return
        end
        setupTargetBoxGui()
        local silentAimTarget, silentAimTarget2 = nil, nil
        pcall(function()
            silentAimTarget, silentAimTarget2 = getSilentAimTarget()
        end)
        if silentAimTarget and silentAimTarget2 and options2.frame then
            local value2DBoundingBox, value2DBoundingBox2, value2DBoundingBox3, value2DBoundingBox4 =
                get2DBoundingBox(silentAimTarget)
            if value2DBoundingBox and value2DBoundingBox2 and value2DBoundingBox3 and value2DBoundingBox4 then
                local spearSilentAim = silentAimTarget2 == "Spear" and featureSettings.SpearSilentAim
                    or featureSettings.RevolverSilentAim
                local targetHighlightColor = spearSilentAim.TargetHighlightColor
                    or silentAimTarget2 == "Spear" and "Red"
                    or "Cyan"
                local backgroundColor = options[targetHighlightColor]
                    or silentAimTarget2 == "Spear" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
                    or Color3.fromRGB(0, 240, 255)
                options2.frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, value2DBoundingBox, 0, value2DBoundingBox2)
                options2.frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, value2DBoundingBox3, 0, value2DBoundingBox4)
                options2.frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                local clampedValue = math.clamp(math.floor(value2DBoundingBox3 * 0.25), 6, 16)
                local corners = options2.corners
                if corners.TL_H then
                    corners.TL_H.Size = UDim2.new(0, clampedValue, 0, 2.5)
                end
                if corners.TR_H then
                    corners.TR_H.Size = UDim2.new(0, clampedValue, 0, 2.5)
                end
                if corners.BL_H then
                    corners.BL_H.Size = UDim2.new(0, clampedValue, 0, 2.5)
                end
                if corners.BR_H then
                    corners.BR_H.Size = UDim2.new(0, clampedValue, 0, 2.5)
                end
                if corners.TL_V then
                    corners.TL_V.Size = UDim2.new(0, 2.5, 0, clampedValue)
                end
                if corners.TR_V then
                    corners.TR_V.Size = UDim2.new(0, 2.5, 0, clampedValue)
                end
                if corners.BL_V then
                    corners.BL_V.Size = UDim2.new(0, 2.5, 0, clampedValue)
                end
                if corners.BR_V then
                    corners.BR_V.Size = UDim2.new(0, 2.5, 0, clampedValue)
                end
                for _, guiObject in pairs(corners) do
                    if guiObject then
                        guiObject.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor
                        guiObject.BackgroundTransparency = 0
                    end
                end
                options2.frame.Visible = true
                return
            end
        end
        if options2.frame and options2.frame.Visible then
            options2.frame.Visible = false
        end
    end
    registerConnection(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if updateSilentAimTargetHighlight then
            updateSilentAimTargetHighlight()
        end
    end))
end)()
